izzyondroid:me.danb.retherm.name: Retherm
izzyondroid:me.danb.retherm.summary: Retherm converts RTD and thermocouples sensors to temperature.
izzyondroid:me.danb.retherm.description:
Retherm is a simple application that converts resistances from RTD sensors to temperature. This app can currently convert Pt100, Pt500 and Pt1000 resistances to degree Celsius or Fahrenheit. The standard equations are done to the popular European/DIN standard for the temperature range of -200°C to +850°C with an average margin of error of about 0.02°C. An option is available for calculations to the less used American standard for the range 0 to 100°C with an average margin of error of about 0.2°C.
 Retherm has the option to convert thermocouple voltages to degrees. The calculations are based on a 0°C reference junction temperature and use NIST polynomial values to make conversions. Types B, E, J, K, N, R, S and T are supported with outputs showing in both centigrade and Fahrenheit depending on your preference.
 Retherm also features handy links to useful websites with vital information about RTD sensors.
 This app is for built for quick reference use. There may be errors, although I try my best to make sure there are none. Me, The application creator, will not be held liable for any problems caused due to errors within the application. If any problems are found, or you have a suggestion for the app, please contact me either by the “contact developer” link on this page or through the “email developer” link found in the extras menu within the application.

fdroid:app.mcevoy.syncrecordapp.name: SyncRecord
fdroid:app.mcevoy.syncrecordapp.summary: Create synchronised ad-hoc microphone arrays using multiple smartphones.
fdroid:app.mcevoy.syncrecordapp.description:
SyncRecord is an open-source Android application designed to transform a group of spatially distributed smartphones into a single, synchronised, ad-hoc microphone array. This tool addresses the high cost and scalability limitations of traditional hardware microphone arrays, offering a low-cost solution for acoustic research, sound source localisation, and multi-device audio acquisition.
Core Functionality The system achieves temporal alignment and spatial localisation by utilising audible pseudo-random binary sequence (PRBS) signals. Devices emit these sequences, and the system employs cross-correlation techniques on the captured audio to extract propagation delay information. Under test conditions, this approach reduces temporal misalignment across recordings to within 52 samples at 48 kHz (approx. 42 µs) and estimates inter-device distances to within 14mm.
Key Features:
- Ad-hoc mic array creation: Easily initiate a session with a master device and invite other participants via a unique alphanumeric session ID (UID).
- Synchronised Recording: Captures raw, unprocessed audio (using MediaRecorder.AudioSource.UNPROCESSED) from all devices simultaneously.
- Automatic calibration: Performs server-side signal processing to estimate inter-device distances and correct time offsets automatically.
- Flexible deployment: Connects to a cloud-based demonstration server or allows users to deploy their own locally-hosted server instance. Local deployment minimises latency and provides full control over data handling.
- Privacy first: Prioritises transient data handling. In cloud mode, audio data is deleted immediately after the session ends. No user logins are required.
Operational modes:
1. Synchronised recording: Combines localisation and recording, delivering time-aligned, multi-channel audio archives ready for further analysis.
2. Localise array devices: Determines the geometric layout of devices without storing continuous audio streams.
3. Unsynchronised recording: Standard multi-channel capture without automatic synchronisation.
Technical details and requirements:
- Server architecture: This app requires a backend server component for signal processing and session management. You can use the public demonstration server (syncrecord.eu:3000) or deploy your own local instance using the Node.js and Python scripts available in the repository. A docker container is also available.
- Hardware: Requires support for unprocessed audio capture. Note that built-in smartphone microphones are directional; for optimal performance, position devices within audible range and orient them towards the centre of the array.
- License: Source code is available under the MIT License.
Learn more: For detailed methodology, signal processing equations, and evaluation results, please read our pre-print research paper: https://zenodo.org/records/20398119
Repository with server-side files: https://github.com/PadraicMCE/SyncRecord

fdroid:com.notcvnt.rknhardering.name: RKNHardering
fdroid:com.notcvnt.rknhardering.summary: Detects VPN and proxy usage on Android using RKN methodology
fdroid:com.notcvnt.rknhardering.description:
RKNHardering is an Android application that detects VPN and proxy usage on a device, implementing the Russian Federal Service for Supervision of Communications (RKN) methodology for identifying circumvention tools.
The app runs nine independent detection modules in parallel and produces a combined verdict:
- GeoIP — checks the public IP against GeoIP databases and hosting/proxy signal providers
- IP Comparison — compares responses from RU and non-RU public IP checkers
- Direct Signs — inspects NetworkCapabilities, system proxy settings, and installed VPN apps
- Indirect Signs — analyzes network interfaces, routing table, DNS, dumpsys VPN output, and localhost proxy listeners
- Location Signals — reads MCC/SIM/cell/Wi-Fi data and queries BeaconDB for geolocation
- Bypass Check — scans localhost for open SOCKS5/HTTP proxies, Xray gRPC API endpoints, and detects underlying network leaks
- CDN Pulling — sends HTTPS requests to trace endpoints to determine the apparent public IP
- Call Transport — checks STUN and MTProto availability to detect traffic tunneling
- Native Signs — performs JNI-level checks of interfaces, routes, /proc/self/maps hook markers, and root indicators
The final verdict (NOT DETECTED / NEEDS REVIEW / DETECTED) is calculated by VerdictEngine using a weighted combination of the module results.
Minimum Android version: 8.0 (API 26).
Source code: https://github.com/xtclovver/RKNHardering

fdroid:com.nsheremet.filmlab.name: FilmLab
fdroid:com.nsheremet.filmlab.summary: Edit photos on your device with film-inspired looks
fdroid:com.nsheremet.filmlab.description:
FilmLab is a focused photo editor with ten film-inspired looks. Choose a photo, preview the looks on your own image, adjust the strength, and save a JPEG copy. Processing happens on your device, and your original photograph is never changed. No account is required.
 Choose colour or black-and-white looks inspired by classic films.
 Adjust exposure, warmth and grain, with highlight glow for the CineStill look.
 Crop, straighten and rotate; compare with the original and undo or redo edits.
 Save favourite looks and named recipes, or continue a recent edit.
 Save to your gallery or share through Android's sharing sheet.
Edits, privately retained source files, favourites and recipes stay in app storage. Recent edits are limited to 20 photos and 512 MB of retained assets. Removing an edit does not remove your original or exported gallery copies.
The editor adapts to phones, wide screens and foldable devices. It follows your device's light or dark appearance and supports larger text.
Editing previews are limited to 2,048 pixels on the long edge. Largest available exports render from the retained source, up to 32 million pixels and the device's rendering budget. Crop and straightening reduce the output dimensions. Smaller copy exports use the editing preview; images are never enlarged.
RAW files use a genuine embedded JPEG preview or Android's supported decoder. FilmLab does not develop RAW sensor samples or provide high-bit-depth RAW export. Unsupported files fail to open. Photo info explains which decoding path was used.
Film looks are artistic simulations, not measured equivalents of physical film or laboratory scans. JPEG edits cannot recover detail already lost to clipping.

fdroid:com.piotv.keytab.name: KeyTab
fdroid:com.piotv.keytab.summary: Keyboard (IME) with tabbed file manager, offline word prediction and TAB key.
fdroid:com.piotv.keytab.description:
KeyTab is a privacy-first keyboard (IME) for Android, 100% Kotlin and free software (MIT).
 File manager in the keyboard 
Browse folders in tabs, navigate with back-stack and parent-navigation. Tapping a file inserts its path or opens it via a VIEW intent. Each tab remembers its own directory. Listing runs asynchronously, so large folders never freeze the UI.
 Offline word prediction 
An n-gram model (FrequencyWords de_50k, CC-BY-SA-4.0) with bigrams for next-word prediction, a self-learning user dictionary, prefix autocomplete, fuzzy correction (Damerau-Levenshtein) and case matching — all on-device. Export/Import lets you optimize suggestions with a local LLM. Your data never leaves the device.
 Dynamic key sizing 
Likely-next keys scale up to 1.21x (second grade 1.15x), unlikely neighbours down to 0.812x, driven by the current suggestion scores. Toggleable in settings.
 Notes & clipboard 
An editor tab with save/load plus a persistent clipboard history (up to 50 entries) — tap an entry to insert it directly into the target field.
 Keyboard features 
Dedicated TAB key (great for Termux/SSH), shift/caps-lock, long-press popups for umlauts and special characters, accelerating backspace on long-press (250ms down to 30ms).
 Privacy 
No network permission. No analytics, no tracking, no data collection.

flathub:net.warsow.Warsow.description:
Warsow is set in a futuristic cartoonish world where rocketlauncher-wielding pigs and lasergun-carrying cyberpunks roam the streets. It is a completely free, fast-paced first-person shooter for Windows, Linux, and Mac OS X.
 Speed and movement is what Warsow is all about. Like a true cyberathlete you jump, dash, dodge, and walljump your way through the game. Grab power-ups before your enemy does, plant a bomb before anyone sees you, and steal the enemy’s flag before they know what is going on!

flathub:org.pjbroad.EternallandsClient.summary: A free to play, graphical MMORPG
flathub:org.pjbroad.EternallandsClient.description:
Eternal Lands is a free 3D fantasy MMORPG (massively multiplayer online role playing game)
 that can be played on Windows, Android, Linux and OSX.
 There are 12 skills in the game: Attack, Defense, Harvest, Alchemy, Magic, Potion,
 Summoning, Manufacturing, Crafting, Engineering, Tailoring and Ranging. There are no fixed
 class restrictions, so you can develop your character in any way you wish.
 You, as a player, determine exactly how you develop your character. If you make mistakes,
 or decide to change or adjust your build, you can do so. Eternal Lands is not just about
 combat. Many players focus on more peaceful activities such as collecting resources,
 creating items, summoning monsters and so on. But if you like combat, there is plenty of it

 Eternal Lands is owned and run by Radu Privantu. This package is built and maintained by
 one of the client developers known in game as bluap.

firefox-addons:855258.name: PassLok Privacy
firefox-addons:855258.summary: High security asymmetric encryption for text, files and chat. You keep the Key secret and give out the matching Lock
firefox-addons:855258.description:
TAKE PRIVACY INTO YOUR OWN HANDS
End-to-end secure encryption, plus steganography for email and real-time chat.
PassLok does not use servers that might compromise your information. Everything is done offline. 
PassLok stores nothing secret, not even in your device.
This app is compatible with PassLok for Email (especially in Email mode). Use it if your email service is not yet supported by PassLok for Email, or if you need more capability.
With PassLok, you can: 
- Write messages than only the intended recipient can read. 
- Do this without having established a secret password. 
- Lock files and images as easily as text.
- Establish a real-time peer-to-peer chat involving text, files, audio, and video
- Digitally sign text, images, and files so others can be sure they come from you. 
- Convert your favorite email or texting app into a secure communication channel. 
- Hide private information as apparently innocent text, or inside images. 
- Use Hidden message mode, so your true message is not what it appears to be. 
- Create messages that can only be read once. 
- Communicate across platforms. 
- Send confidential mailings to several people at the same time. 
- Use a borrowed device, in case yours is bugged. 
- Be as paranoid as you like. We are really paranoid, and this is why we developed PassLok. 
PassLok uses 255-bit standard elliptic curves, which have been vetted against weaknesses by experts. On top of that, PassLok uses 256-bit XSalsa20 encryption and 512-bit hash functions to complete the locking process. XSalsa20 is a high-performance, open source cipher, which has been scrutinized by experts for nearly a decade without any practical weaknesses being found.
The first time you run PassLok, it helps you to come up with a strong text-based secret Key, which can be whatever you want it to be. PassLok places no restrictions to make sure that you can always remember your Key without ever having to write it down. 
From your secret Key, PassLok creates a Lock, which is like a phone number that you give to the people you wish to send messages to you. They will "put your Lock" on those messages, and only your Key, which you have given to no one, will be able to unlock them. Optionally, you can post your Lock on the PassLok general directory, adding a video so people know the Lock is genuine. 
This is the Firefox addon version of PassLok, essentially identical to the versions released for PCs and mobile platforms. In addition, there is an identical Chrome extension, plus a pure html version of PassLok at the following mirrors: 
 https://passlok.com/app 
 https://www.autistici.org/passlok 
 https://passlok.site44.com 
If you want to check them out, you should get the source by doing ctrl-u or cmd-opt-u, get its SHA256 with an external program or web page, and compare it with the value below. This is not necessary for app store versions like this one, which are code-signed by the app store.
Checksum for web sources (single html file) of version 2.6:
SHA256: 7032-4213-5320-3420-550a-ef09-d42d-3510-adaa-f3a9-f6e0-6ec0-24eb-cea4-264d-b89e

firefox-addons:3035466.name: Knockoff - Amazon Shopping Filter
firefox-addons:3035466.summary: Hides junk brands like SZHLUX and HORUSDY from Amazon search, so real brands stand out. Can hide sponsored listings too. Brand checks run locally; features that send seller or product data switch off. No accounts.
firefox-addons:3035466.description:
Amazon search is full of made-up brands. Names like SZHLUX, HORUSDY, and LATTOOK have no real company, no warranty, and no reputation behind them. Knockoff spots them in your search results and dims or hides them, so real brands stand out.
As featured in Fast Company, CNET, The Verge, Gizmodo, 404 Media, PC Gamer, Yahoo, Lifehacker, Digital Trends, Boing Boing, BGR, Windows Central, Family Handyman, Techwalla, and TechAeris.
LOOKING FOR A FAKESPOT ALTERNATIVE?
Mozilla shut Fakespot down on July 1, 2025. Knockoff works differently. It flags brands, not reviews. It won't grade a product's reviews. It checks whether the brand behind each listing is an established brand or a throwaway name.
WHY THESE BRANDS EXIST
Sellers register random strings like these as trademarks at the USPTO to unlock Amazon Brand Registry, then sell cheap commodity goods under them. When something breaks, there's no one to call.
WHAT IT DOES
• Every listing's brand is appraised right in your results, and the junk is hidden, dimmed, or labeled.
• Brands are checked against a curated register of 5,500+ established brands, refreshed daily. Unknown names are scored on the linguistic signature of pseudo-brands: all-caps squat-length strings, vanishing vowels, unpronounceable consonant runs.
• Three filter levels: Relaxed, Standard, Strict. Your allowlist and blocklist override everything.
• Trust or block any brand in one click, right from the results, with one-click misclassification reporting that improves the shared lists for everyone.
• Optionally hide Amazon's paid "Sponsored" listings too (off by default).
• Also optional: hide Amazon's Alexa promos, from the homepage banners and "just ask Alexa" prompts to the self-opening assistant sidebar. Products that work with Alexa are untouched, and a panel holding your cart is never hidden.
• See where each seller is based, and hide listings from countries you pick.
WHAT THE PERMISSION PROMPT MEANS
Firefox's install prompt says Knockoff collects "website content" and "browsing activity". Here is exactly what each one is.
• Website content is what the extension reads to do its job: product titles, brand names, and seller IDs on the Amazon pages you shop. The brand appraisal itself runs locally in your browser; the seller country feature sends seller IDs so it can show where a seller is based.
• Browsing activity is one feature: Help pick US alternatives sends the Amazon product pages you open, so we know which products people want US alternatives for and can spot new junk brands on marketplaces the filter can't read yet. A stored row records that a product was viewed N times, never who viewed it.
Both features are on by default, and both switch off in settings.
PRIVACY
Knockoff runs only on Amazon: its host permissions cover the 23 Amazon retail sites and nothing else, and it carries no code for anywhere else. The brand appraisal runs locally in your browser. No accounts, no profiles, nothing tied to you.
Two features send data. Both are on by default, and both can be switched off in settings: seller country sends seller IDs, so it can show where a seller is based; and Help pick US alternatives sends the product pages you open, so we know which products people want US alternatives for and can spot new junk brands on marketplaces the filter can't read yet. A stored row records that a product was viewed N times, never who viewed it. Never sent: your searches, your orders, or anything you type into a page, unless you write feedback yourself. Reports stay opt-in and anonymous. Full detail: knockoff.co/privacy 
Free. Works on 23 Amazon marketplaces worldwide, including amazon.com , .ca, . co.uk , .de, .fr, . co.jp , .in, and . com.au .

firefox-addons:3070715.description:
Inertia.js DevTools adds a panel to Firefox DevTools for inspecting your Inertia applications. Every visit lands in a live timeline (initial loads, navigations, partial reloads, deferred props, polls, prefetches, and redirects), with follow-up requests grouped under the visit that triggered them. Select any entry to see its props, request and response bodies and headers, the matched route and handler, and the page state at that moment.
Render calls, shared props, and route actions resolve to a file and line and open in your editor, including PhpStorm, VS Code, Cursor, Sublime Text, and Zed. Authorization and cookie headers, CSRF tokens, and secret fields are redacted before anything is shown, and nothing leaves your machine.

• Can you collect all the unique birds?
So, what are you waiting for? Put your walking skills to the test and embark on an unforgettable adventure!

bluejetty:00019071:ios.description:
DUELITO - Endless Arcade TapFight Duel
Prepare to tap it! An intense arcade tapfight designed to test your skills and reflexes to the max. Fight your way through the leaderboard and become a DUELITO master!
Unlock a lot of awesome TAPBUDDIES, featuring Papito the grumpy, Shombi the zombie, Peekeeper (no comments) and many more!
Grab coins and try your luck on the SPIN2WIN. Find your perfect TAPBUDDY and break through to the top of the leaderboard!
Keep ahead of your friends and check your ranks on the global leaderboard, or challenge them head-to-head in a local multiplayer game.
Features
Tap your way through the exciting endless arcade mode
New Worlds: Play levels with different kinds of buttons per world (Poker, Shapes, Gray, ...)
Online: Play against other cowboys in the Tourney Mode (SiXPistoLs)
DUELITO is a universal game app, compatible with most iPhone and iPad models.
For best performance we recommend iPhone 5 or later.
Support
Having issues? contact hello@juan.ma
HEADS UP: DUELITO is free to download and play, however characters can be purchased with real money. If you prefer not to use this feature, just disable in-app purchases in your device settings (Settings > General > Restrictions).

bluejetty:00091203:ios.description:
Stay on top of your favorite teams and competitions with Fixtured. It's the ultimate tool for sports fans, letting you track and follow multiple sports in one powerful calendar view (football, basketball, soccer, hockey, baseball, rugby, motorsports, golf, tennis, cycling, volleyball, cricket, darts, snooker and more).
• Your Watchlist: Discover and follow your favorite teams and competitions across 600+ leagues worldwide.
• More Than Just a Calendar: Access live scores, lineups, standings, stats, team form, match timeline, etc. right from your feed.
• Calendar Sync: Automatically sync your Fixtured events into your favorite calendar apps.
• Live Activities: Follow live scores and leaderboards right from your Lock Screen or Dynamic Island
• Check In: Build a journal of every game you watch. Earn Fixtured-branded tickets and points.
• Share: Generate visuals and overlays to share games with friends
• Widgets: Track your next games at a glance from your home screen.
• Custom Notifications: Receive a morning summary and alerts before your favorite teams kick off. Stay updated with real-time schedule changes and reminders so you never miss a game.

bluejetty:00068719:ios.description:
Introducing our enhanced distance measurement app! With added features such as area measurement and custom coefficients, this app takes accurate measurements to a whole new level.
Usage:
Measuring distance is now a breeze. Simply touch the screen to draw a route on the map and instantly calculate its length. Our magnifier tool ensures precise drawing and measurement.
◆ Easily switch between Move and Measure modes to choose the starting point or begin measurement right away.
◆ Need to measure longer distances? Just drag the map to explore further areas.
◆ Switch effortlessly between Area and Distance calculations.
◆ Customize your display units by tapping the "Unit" button.
◆ Made a mistake? No problem. Use the "Undo" button to reverse any changes.
◆ Want to share your results? Hit the "Share" button to export screenshots to Twitter, Camera roll, Email, and more.
◆ Looking for a specific location? Simply use the "Search" button to enter coordinates, place names, cities, states, or countries.
Note: Distance and Area calculations take into account the Earth's curvature for utmost accuracy.
Custom Coefficients
Take your measurement experience to the next level with our advanced distance and area calculator. Now you can set your own custom units (limited to two units in the free version).
Example Use Cases:
◆ Track gasoline usage for a given distance.
◆ Estimate calories burned during a run.
◆ Calculate travel time for a specific distance.
◆ Determine the amount of insecticide needed for a farm area.
◆ Find out how many cars can fit in a given parking area.
◆ And so much more!

bluejetty:00175218:ios.description:
Find shortest routes and directions to any destination in the world using GPS Live Navigation, Voice Navigation & Directions app.
It’s never easy to get to the desired destination fast and easy. Without the right Driving Directions it can be very easy to get lost in the city, which is why GPS Live Navigation app is here to help you. This app provide you Live Maps, Voice Navigation, Traffic Alerts, accurate Driving Directions needed to reach your destination.
Comprehensive Driving Directions, Voice Navigation:
If you want to use GPS Live Navigation while driving you can totally do that. You can obtain Driving Directions with simple voice commands using GPS Voice Navigation feature. Voice Navigation will help you to find any shortest driving directions with simple voice commands. 
GPS Navigation:
With GPS Live Navigation comes you can easily see where you are located and how to reach desired location by using GPS Navigation on Map. Live Street View Navigation Map will help you to find Street Views to easily understand your current location. Satellite Earth view is best to explore new famous places & draw routes on Map with travel information, safe & fastest route. Real-time GPS transit map is best journey assistance, free navigation and GPS direction maps. 
Traffic Alerts: Learn the Traffic conditions.
Before you leaving your current location its better to understand traffic around you so that you can reach your destination on time in shortest route. Traffic alerts will help you to understand live traffic conditions around your current location.
Near By Places: 
With the help of GPS Live Navigation app you can explore various neighborly places on Map like Hotels, Restaurants, Hospitals, Pubs, Clubs, Fuel Stations, Airports, Public Transport, Schools, Theaters, Temples, Church and many more. You can also see neighborly place and their Comments, User Ratings and location details.
Travel History or Mobile Location History:
With help from GPS Live Navigation you can also see your Travel History and Mobile Location History on regular basis. You get to see what place you have explored.
Digital Compass:
Digital Compass can be accessed on your Maps, Camera and Satellite Maps to have clear view on Directions of GPS. 
Live 3D Maps:
GPS Live Navigation gives you stunning 3D maps and live maps using Maps that you can see right away. 3D Maps will help you to track your exact location around your near by place so that you can track your current location on 3D Maps with pinpoint accuracy. 3D Maps are always a great option to view any location in 3D view. 
Street View:
Since GPS Live Navigation app gives you access to Maps, you also get to see Street View. This way you get to connect with your local area before visiting it. You get a feel for that place and you can access it as well as enjoy it as you see it. Street View is amazing for 3d View.
Share your location 
Be it for safety purposes or not, you can easily share your location with others using GPS, Maps, Voice Navigation & Directions app. This way people will know where you are and they will come to you as fast as possible.
Features:
* GPS Navigation
* Voice Navigation
* Driving Directions
* Live Maps
* Traffic Alerts
* Near By Places.
* Street View
With help from GPS Live Navigation app you finally get to find routes and directions in any city. You won’t ever get lost again, as GPS, Maps, Voice Navigation & Directions has live maps, 3D maps and routes to any location.

bluejetty:00022299:ios.description:
Point your iOS device at the mountain and you'll see the name, altitude, and distance of the mountaintop.
You can identify the names of all the mountain peaks in the 360-degree panoramic AR view.
All features are free to use.
Thanks to your support, we have reached 2.5 million downloads across all platforms, both domestic and international.
Features
- It has data from nearly one million peaks around the world.
- It uses three-dimensional coordinates and a gyroscope to display the name at the peak, even if you tilt the camera. The display makes it easy to check.
- The three-dimensional terrain is displayed semi-transparently, so it is easy to compare it with the actual shape of the mountain and check the location of the peak.
- When you point your iOS device downward, the view switches to a 3D view looking down from the sky.
- You can check the names of the terrain and mountains that can be seen from any location specified on the map.
- You can take a photo with the name of the peak and share it via SNS or email.
- Swiping the AR display up, down, left, or right allows you to adjust the position of the peak name display.
- It is possible to adjust the position of the peak name display after the picture is taken.
- You can import photos taken with another app and add the peak name.
※ If the direction is not correct (e.g. it always shows North), if your iOS device has a cover on it If there is a sensor in the case, please remove it. The metal or magnet on the cover may interfere with the sensor and cause it to malfunction.

bluejetty:00088093:ios.description:
Find verified European suppliers, send RFQs and manage B2B sourcing, all in one app. Search 2.2 million manufacturers, wholesalers and exporters across 45 countries. Get quotes in 26 languages, contact suppliers directly, and stay notified of new matches. Trusted by 1 million+ buyers every month. 
SEARCH SMARTER, SOURCE FASTER 
Find the right supplier in seconds. Search across 670,000 products and 111 industries, from industrial machinery and raw materials to packaging, textiles and electronics. Filter by country, product category or certification. Results translate automatically into your language so there are no barriers, wherever your next partner is based. 
SEND RFQs IN MINUTES 
Tell us what you need and receive tailored quotes from verified suppliers. No cold outreach, no chasing contacts - suppliers come to you through the Request Hub. Review offers, compare quotes and respond directly inside the app. 
CONTACT SUPPLIERS DIRECTLY 
Message manufacturers, wholesalers and service providers without leaving the platform. Full conversation history, real-time notifications and a shared inbox that keeps your sourcing organised, whether you are managing one project or twenty. 
WHY EUROPEAN SOURCING? 
Sourcing from Europe means shorter lead times, easier compliance, lower shipping risk and suppliers who meet EU quality and safety standards. europages gives you direct access to 2.2 million verified European manufacturers and service providers - the same network used by procurement teams at companies across 26 countries. Whether you are reshoring your supply chain, reducing dependency on distant markets or simply finding a local partner who ships reliably, europages connects you with the right European supplier for your industry and your budget. 
BUILT FOR B2B PROFESSIONALS 
europages is used by procurement managers, purchasing directors, import and export coordinators, supply chain teams and SME owners who source across Europe and beyond. If you manage supplier relationships, run tenders, send purchase orders or need to expand your supplier base with verified, certified partners — europages gives you the tools to do it from your phone. Available on iPhone and iPad. Free to download. No subscription required to search and contact suppliers. 
THE NUMBERS BEHIND THE NETWORK 
2,200,000+ verified suppliers and manufacturers 
45 countries covered across Europe and beyond 
670,000+ products across 111 industries 
26 languages supported with automatic translation 
1,000,000+ buyers sourcing every month 
europages is Europe's leading B2B marketplace, built to help businesses find the right partners, faster. Start sourcing for free today.

bluejetty:00115004:ios.description:
Yugen offers a natural approach on motivation and purpose. Instead of to‑do lists that feel like chores, you’ll live your life as a narrative: chapters, arcs, and meaningful turning points that are unique to you. 
Tell us your goals and preferences, and Yugen builds a personalized story arc that integrates your daily tasks and challenges into a plot you actually want to follow. 
The result? Clear direction, sustained motivation, and a deeper sense of purpose—because it’s your story, and you’re the main character.
FEATURES OF YUGEN
 **Live through Story Arcs**
More than 20 story arcs are ready to be tailored to you—each with its own vibe, milestones, and outcomes.
**Turn Daily Life into Chapters**
Daily tasks and arc‑specific challenges transform your routine into chapters of your evolving story.
**Improve with Focused Arcs**
Arcs are built to help you grow where it matters. Each one is designed to guide better habits and decisions—not overwhelm you.
**Fully Personalized**
Your goals, your preferences, your pace. Yugen customizes your story based on your goals.
**Find Purpose & Motivation**
Your story gives you direction and meaning—helping you become your truest self. It’s your story, after all—step into it.
**WI‑FI & DATA CONNECTIVITY**
Yugen requires an active internet connection to function and does not work offline. The app operates over Wi‑Fi or cellular data (3G/4G/5G). Data charges may apply from your provider. If your connection is unstable or restricted (e.g., by a firewall/VPN), some content may not load—reconnect to continue using Yugen.
**SUBSCRIPTION AND TRIAL**
A Yugen subscription is required to use the app and enjoy full access to all features and content. Yugen offers a 7‑day free trial for yearly subscriptions; access requires starting the free trial. For weekly subscriptions, free trial is not offered. If you choose a Yugen subscription, payment will be charged to your Apple ID (iTunes) account at confirmation of purchase.
Your subscription automatically renews unless you turn off auto‑renew in your iTunes/App Store Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends.Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.You can manage your subscription and turn off auto‑renew at any time in Account Settings.
If you subscribe before your trial ends, any remaining free‑trial period will be forfeited when your purchase is confirmed.
DISCLAIMER: Yugen provides educational and self‑improvement content for general wellness and personal development. It is not a medical, mental‑health, or crisis service and does not provide diagnosis, treatment, or therapy.

bluejetty:00036257:ios.name: Perfect OCR
bluejetty:00036257:ios.summary: Perfect OCR gives you both a general purpose OCR app and a document scanner. Now you can scan and OCR your letter-size or A4 documents with an accuracy of 90% or more, edit, copy and store the recognized text, and e-mail your documents as P
bluejetty:00036257:ios.description:
Perfect OCR gives you both a general purpose OCR app and a document scanner. Now you can scan and OCR your letter-size or A4 documents with an accuracy of 90% or more, edit, copy and store the recognized text, and e-mail your documents as PDF files with text, SINGLE page image, or both together!
NOTE: To ensure the advertised results it is important that you follow the OCR TIPS below (or in the app's help). 
Perfect OCR scans your documents using advanced image-processing algorithms to eliminate uneven lighting and shadows and improve contrast. The result is the clearest and most readable scans possible from the iPhone's camera. Perfect OCR also offers SureScan, our proprietary scanning mode that delivers sharper images with less jitter or smear. 
Our unique "Email to myself" feature lets you send documents to a predefined address, or even upload them to an online storage service like Evernote or Box.net, with a single tap. Uploading documents to online services via email is fast, secure, and can be done even if you're temporarily off line. Refer to app help for details.
All processing happens on your iPhone, and the confidentiality of your data is never compromised. There is also no subscription fee, and no Internet access is needed to scan documents or run OCR.
PERFECT OCR FEATURES:
• Letter-size or A4 page OCR with accuracy of 95% for model 3GS, 98% for iPhone 4, and up to 90% for 3G
• OCR languages: English, French, Spanish, German, Dutch, Italian, Portuguese, Swedish, Russian, Polish, Hungarian, Czech and Ukrainian.
• Email multipage PDFs with text, SINGLE page image, or both
• Automatic document edge detection and perspective correction
• Multipage text recognition with accuracy indicator
• Text editing and copy-to-clipboard operations
• Built-in OCR text archive with file sharing via iTunes
• "Email to myself" feature
• Email text and image files (.TXT + .JPG), or save image to library
• Searchable PDFs with document images (single page)
• Preserves simple text formatting
• Option to auto-remove line breaks
• SureScan mode for jitter-free scans
• Simple yet powerful user interface
• Instant brightness, rotation, and color controls
• Compact attachments with adjustable size
IMPORTANT TIPS FOR OCR:
• Make sure your document is flat and well lit. Hold your iPhone still while shooting. 
• Always scan documents using "SureScan 3x" mode.
• Glossy paper may not work well (avoid glare).
• When scanning books keep the pages as flat as possible and your iPhone parallel to the surface.
• Perfect OCR cannot recognize handwritten, very large text or spreadsheets correctly.
• Make sure to select the right language for OCR in app settings.
We're constantly improving Perfect OCR, and we value our customers' opinions and feedback. Please contact us at support@turboscanapp.com. If you have a problem with our software, please contact us before submitting a comment to the app store. We can solve most of the problems, but we cannot respond to comments.

bluejetty:00043459:ios.description:
Zen Prep is the #1 app for passing your exam, WITHOUT stress and anxiety. You will experience better exam practice, lower stress, and less anxiety with our step-by-step training, motivation programs, exam simulators, exam resources, and tips and tricks. 
Zen Prep is recommended by top teachers and mental health experts.
ONE APP - ALL YOU NEED TO PASS YOUR EXAM
You will find all the information you need to pass the CNOR exam. All in one app. This study app directly aligns with the CNOR exam blueprint, giving you the preparation you need to achieve the highest score possible. 
"THE CNOR BIBLE"... ?!
You will see why this app is referred to as "The CNOR Bible" - It's so comprehensive! It will teach you everything you need to pass your exam.
WHAT WILL YOU MASTER?
• All the CNOR exam sections. 
• How to learn. 
• How to practice. 
• How to behave on the exam day.
• How to motivate yourself. 
PRACTICE QUESTIONS
Any test prep guide is only as good as its practice questions and answer explanations, and that's another area where Zen Prep stands out. The practice questions are similar to the actual exam. Each answer is explained in-depth to make the principles and reasoning behind it crystal clear.
PRACTICE TESTS
Choose to train in a particular subject or topic. You will get access to over a dozen practice tests.
REAL EXAM SIMULATOR
Practice in conditions similar to the real CNOR exam. Check your knowledge and get a sense of your predicted score.
FLASHCARDS
Swipe the cards to quickly review CNOR concepts without the need to go through the whole test, complete the right amount of questions for you, and get some quick studying in.
INCREASE MOTIVATION & REDUCE EXAM STRESS
Positive reminders are one of the simplest and most powerful tools for exam preparation. It's all about your mindset and keeping the right thoughts. You are a winner and you will ace the exam! The app will motivate you on those hard days when motivation is needed the most.
SCORE PREDICTION
Get your CNOR score prediction based on how you pass the real exam simulator, and study the topics you need to revisit to improve your score.
TIPS AND RECOMMENDATIONS
Get to know how to successfully get prepared and pass the exam, learn all the strategies, tips, and tricks useful to ace the CNOR exam.
Zen Prep will be your most valuable study resource – helping you prepare, stay motivated, and pass the exam with flying colors.
• More Than 3000+ Exam-Style Practice Questions.
• In-depth rationales created by industry leaders.
• A full CNOR exam simulator.
• Practice Tests.
• Motivation techniques.
• Positive reminders.
• Custom exam builder to focus on your weak areas.
• Progress tracking to keep you moving toward your study goals.
• Dozens of study methods, from practice tests, real exam simulators, custom quizzes, study resources and more.
• An entire library of up-to-date resources that will help you pass your exam.
• Full suite of revision material.
• Latest Content Update: Practice Materials ready for 2026.
• And much more!
In short, it's everything you need to succeed with a bunch of hugely valuable extras sprinkled on top.
ON EXAM DAY... YOU WILL THANK US!
On the exam day, you will feel confident. 
You will see how similar the exam questions are compared to Zen Prep's training materials.
**Our content has been updated to the latest 2026 guidelines.**
If you have questions or comments, email us any time: contact@zenprep.co

bluejetty:00079786:ios.description:
Kotodama AI: Clone Your Voice. Speak Any Language.
-
-
YOUR VOICE. YOUR LANGUAGE. POWERED BY AI. - 
- Kotodama AI lets you clone your voice, generate natural speech in 30+ languages, and create lifelike audio in seconds. Turn text into speech, transform your recordings, and produce professional-quality voiceovers. All from your phone.
- 
- 
CREATE VOICES THAT SOUND REAL - 
- Kotodama AI is an advanced AI voice generation and text-to-speech app built for creators, businesses, and curious minds. Whether you’re making a podcast, producing voiceovers, creating ads, or just experimenting with AI voices, Kotodama gives you the freedom to bring your words to life instantly. No studio required.
-
-
AI-POWERED TEXT TO SPEECH
- Type or paste your script in any of 30+ supported languages, and Kotodama AI will generate human-like audio in seconds. Adjust the tone, speed, and emotion to match your style, from casual conversation to cinematic narration.
- 
- 
SPEECH TO SPEECH TRANSFORMATION
- Record or upload your own voice and let Kotodama AI re-speak your words in another voice or language. Preserve your natural flow and emotion while transforming your speech into something completely new.
-
-
VOICE CLONING TECHNOLOGY
- Upload a short voice sample to clone your voice in minutes. Once your model is ready, you can make it speak in any language or emotion. Perfect for content creators, brands, and storytellers who want their projects to sound truly personal.
-
-
STUDIO-QUALITY AI AUDIO
With Kotodama AI v2.0 generation, every track sounds crisp, expressive, and production-ready, ideal for YouTube, ads, e-learning, audiobooks, and more. All voices you create are royalty-free, so you can use them confidently anywhere.
- 
- 
VOICE CREATION FOR EVERYONE
- Kotodama AI brings professional voice tools to your pocket. Whether you want to localize your content, build a multilingual podcast, or simply explore what AI speech can do, Kotodama helps you create stunning audio in minutes.
- 
- 
DATA & CONSENT
- By using Kotodama AI, you agree that your voice inputs, text prompts, and generated AI audio may be securely processed to improve Kotodama’s voice cloning, speech synthesis, and language generation technologies.
-
-
Privacy Policy: https://kotodama.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://kotodama.app/terms

bluejetty:00125870:ios.summary: Does building your PC seem like an impossible task? PC Building Simulator aims to teach even the most novice PC user how their machine is put together with step-by-step instructions explaining the order parts should be assembled and providi
bluejetty:00125870:ios.description:
Does building your PC seem like an impossible task? PC Building Simulator aims to teach even the most novice PC user how their machine is put together with step-by-step instructions explaining the order parts should be assembled and providing useful information on what each part is and its function.
In this simulation game, you will assemble a Home PC for yourself. Build your pc teaches you to build an empire and how you can repair different PC's. With real-world components to assemble and comprehensive hardware and software installation, you can be the Best Pc Architect and learn a lot from this game.
How To Play:
- In the game, you will receive orders from customers to build various computers. 
- Accept these orders and drag CPU on the table.
- Change the CPU color according to your imaginations and place all important accessories in the cpu by tapping on the items.
- Install your favorite operating system, turn on the power button.
- Login and install browsers, drivers, wallpapers, and deliver orders as soon as possible.
- Accept new orders while assembling your home computers.
Features:
- Be the architect of your PC.
- Build a PC empire with assembling your customers PC's.
- Real-world components and software installation.
- Time management to increase your customers.
- Show your customers a great variety of components you have.
- Run your own business.
A complete system builder app in which you can show your customers a greater variety in pc building components and software installation.

bluejetty:00131795:ios.name: B-hyve Pro
bluejetty:00131795:ios.summary: The B-hyve Pro App provides landscape irrigation professionals with an easy way to manage and operate B-hyve Pro controllers from anywhere with the convenience of a smart phone or tablet. With the intuitive layout and design of the app, it
bluejetty:00131795:ios.description:
The B-hyve Pro App provides landscape irrigation professionals with an easy way to manage and operate B-hyve Pro controllers from anywhere with the convenience of a smart phone or tablet. With the intuitive layout and design of the app, it is fast and easy to connect to any B-hyve Pro controller through WiFi or, if WiFi is not available, directly through Bluetooth right at the timer location. Once connected to WiFi, B-hyve can be set up in smart mode to assist in delivering the right amount of water to plants, saving clients water and money.
This is the companion App for award-winning B-hyve Pro irrigation controllers. Homeowners can download the non-Pro version of the B-hyve App at no charge.
***KEY FEATURES***
WIFI and BLUETOOTH – Because WiFi is not always available on a job site, the B-hyve app and controller allow you to set up and operate the controller using Bluetooth. Once a WiFi connection is established at a site, the owner of the WiFi router can provide a permission code that enables off-site management of the controller from anywhere in the world.
EPA- AND SWAT-CERTIFIED – Having passed the rigorous EPA WaterSense and SWAT certifications, the B-hyve Pro Controller with Smart Watering is certified to use water more efficiently and is eligible for rebates in many cities or water districts across the country.
FLEXIBLE SCHEDULING – You can set the controller to water in two basic ways: 1) on a fixed schedule, such as during a new landscape grow-in period; 2) with Smart Watering, and let local weather conditions determine the schedule.
MULTI-SITE MANAGEMENT – You can manage and control an unlimited number of B-hyve controllers from the convenience of one application. Once the timer is connected to the Internet, secure access can be shared in a number of different combinations using an app-generated code.
CATCH CUPS – With various water savings options integrated right into the app, there are multiple ways to achieve optimum water savings with the B-hyve Pro Timer. In addition to Smart Watering, it incorporates the award-winning catch-cup feature right into the app to deliver up to 25% more water savings over other smart controllers.
ALEXA – Works with Alexa. For a list of Alexa commands visit bhyve.hydrorain.com.

bluejetty:00037780:ios.description:
Easily track your work hours, overtime, and earnings with atWork — the simple time tracker and timesheet app for freelancers, contractors, and hourly employees. See where your time goes, how much you’ve earned, and manage jobs, shifts, and clients all in one place. Create custom timesheets with all the details you need and take control of your productivity and income.
EASY TIME TRACKING
• Clock in and out with a few taps, or just ask Siri. atWork is your personal time clock for work or any activity.
• Forgot to start the timer? Add or edit hours later. No more lost time.
• Export timesheets (CSV, Excel, or PDF) for clients or payroll, complete with pay and overtime details.
• Track multiple jobs and optionally organize work by client, project, or task for detailed records.
• Automatic location tracking lets you set workplaces to clock you in or out when you arrive or leave, and receive notifications.
• Sync with Apple Watch to start or stop timers or dictate notes on the go.
• Record vacation days, sick days, and public holidays to keep your timesheet accurate and complete.
FLEXIBLE & CUSTOMIZABLE
• Add notes of any length, define automatic breaks and regular working hours to display your overtime and pay.
• Customize your time entries and track as much detail as you want with custom fields — from expenses such as travel or mileage to payment status (paid or pending).
• Set daily, weekly, or monthly income goals and watch your progress.
• Choose automatic rounding rules for start and end times to simplify reporting and keep entries consistent.
• Keep your data safe with automatic backup to iCloud or manually via email.
RELIABLE SUPPORT
• We’re a small, dedicated team offering 24/7 support. Reach us anytime at support@atworkapp.com.
• We read every review and keep improving atWork based on your feedback.
With atWork, tracking your hours and pay has never been easier — accurate, flexible, and built for the way you work.
Join thousands of professionals who rely on atWork every day:
“Easy to use, lots of customizations, export data in multiple file types and it’s FREE! I use it to keep track of time spent on multiple clients and projects.” – sherisworld24 (App Store review)
“As a small business, I love being able to track time for each of my clients either live or retroactively. Have used the app for years and been very happy with it.” – Britchick70 (App Store review)
Download atWork today and start managing your time like a pro. No more wondering “Where did the time go?” atWork puts you in charge of every hour and every dollar earned.

bluejetty:00184906:ios.description:
New Real Madrid App, the place where you can find all the football and basketball information with match pre-match coverage, live scores, post-match coverage, standings, exclusive news, and much more!
Hello, Madridrista! This is the new and improved Real Madrid App, your window into exclusive news from the football and basketball world. 
What does the Real Madrid App have to offer?
1. The pre-match coverage: find out the squads and line-ups before anyone else.
2. Follow the game live: our live coverage combined with real-time statistics, commentary from our team, and exclusive views of the pitch.
3. Post-match: relive the best moments with videos, reports and quotes from players and coaching staff.
4. News: everything about the club and the players, from Bellingham, Modric, Vinicius, etc.
5. Fixtures and league tables: men's and women's football and basketball. Follow any competition: LaLiga, Champions League, Copa del Rey...
6. Real Madrid TV on your mobile: all the programming for the next few days.
7. Official Integrated Shop: with a 5% discount on your first purchase as a Madridista.
8. Your Private Member or Madridista Area: with exclusive benefits such as discounts, draws, and priority ticket purchases.
9. Dark Mode: you choose how to experience the Madridista emotion!
And so much more!
How much does the Real Madrid App cost?
It's totally free. Enjoy your favorite content at no cost.
Which Apple devices is it available for?
You can use it on iPhone and iPad.
Is it available in other languages?
The app is available in both English and Spanish.
Download the App now and enjoy every moment with your white heart, Hala Madrid!
Privacy Policy: https://www.realmadrid.com/en-US/legal/privacy-policy
Support: rmapp@corp.realmadrid.com

bluejetty:00036947:ios.name: The Bible and Book of Mormon
bluejetty:00036947:ios.summary: The Church of Jesus Christ, headquartered in Monongahela, PA, presents the Bible and the Book of Mormon in a single mobile app. This app represents the Restored Gospel having the two scripture volumes together, fulfilling Ezekiel 37:17 wher
bluejetty:00036947:ios.description:
The Church of Jesus Christ, headquartered in Monongahela, PA, presents the Bible and the Book of Mormon in a single mobile app. This app represents the Restored Gospel having the two scripture volumes together, fulfilling Ezekiel 37:17 where the Lord declares that he will take the stick (book) of Judah and the stick of Joseph and make them one in His hand. The Bible is the Stick of Judah and the Book of Mormon is the Stick of Joseph.  
The Bible and Book of Mormon app, from The Church of Jesus Christ, treats the two volumes of scripture as one, and makes it easier than ever to read, study and share the Word of God. The Bible text is the Authorized King James Version from 1611 and The Book of Mormon text is carefully consistent with 1830 version, and is available in both English and Spanish.  
Features of the app include:
• English and Spanish language support 
• RED LETTER EDITION: Words of Jesus Christ in red letter 
• Verse of the Day: each day a new verse is given and is easy to go to chapter, and share via Facebook, Twitter, text message and email 
• Browse: browse through the scriptures by book and chapter; drop down menus make it easy to find any book and chapter easily 
• Search: simple search to look for words or phrases; compound search allows search of any two words or phrase and returns the verse that contain both; search words are bolded in the results, sort traditional or alphabetical, filter on Old Testament, New Testament and Book of Mormon results
 • Highlight: highlight your favorite verses, either individual or several together 
• Bookmark: bookmark verses with descriptive titles to easily find what you’re looking for 
• Notes: the perfect study tool, select verses and write detailed notes 
• Reading Settings: select low light setting for nighttime reading, small medium and large fonts 
• History: see your reading history and easily find previous places you’ve been 
• Share: share the app with friends or share single or multiple verses through social media, text or email  
The Bible and Book of Mormon app also includes resources to provide feedback and to learn more about The Church of Jesus Christ.

Welcome to Mahjong Cash, where the elegance of classic Mahjong meets the excitement of real rewards. Step into a serene oriental garden filled with floating lanterns, drifting bamboo leaves, and gentle guzheng melodies. Whether you are relaxing for a short break or enjoying longer play sessions, Mahjong Cash brings both calm focus and meaningful satisfaction.
Art Style
The game is crafted in a refined Eastern aesthetic, with ink-brush patterns, carved jade textures, and smooth transitions. Every detail creates a gentle, poetic world that feels soothing and inviting — a tranquil retreat within your day.
Game Value
In Mahjong Cash, fun and rewards go hand-in-hand. The gameplay is simple to learn yet rich with depth, making every round fulfilling. Enjoy your time, sharpen your thinking, and win real cash prizes — all in one graceful, calming experience.
Here, each victory is more than success — it's a moment of peace rewarded.

bluejetty:00090934:ios.name: SiteCam Construction Photo App
bluejetty:00090934:ios.summary: If the location context of your site photos matters, choose SiteCam. The SiteCam mobile app is an easy-to-use camera app that streamlines photo collection from the field, with location context. Pin photos to plans/blueprints and maps to imp
bluejetty:00090934:ios.description:
If the location context of your site photos matters, choose SiteCam. The SiteCam mobile app is an easy-to-use camera app that streamlines photo collection from the field, with location context. Pin photos to plans/blueprints and maps to improve your photo documentation records, better communicate defects, and produce more insightful project reports to stakeholders.
Discussing a site issue and it gets buried in the chat? In SiteCam you can Tag people in comments linked directly to the photos, their notes, and location context to better communicate job updates, requests for info, required tasks, etc. Our notification system takes them straight to the conversation, with context so they can understand what you’re talking about, and get you answers quickly. 
SiteCam is built to help with your field documentation so you have the records you need for project scoping, condition assessments, site updates, photo evidence, and issue flagging. Photos are automatically timestamped and GPS-stamped to improve your evidence records. 
Add value to your site records. Tag, describe and categorize photos as you capture them to ease reference, search and reporting. Photos that your team adds are synced online and instantly accessible on the computer via the SiteCam web app.
Cover yourself with photos of before, during, and after work is completed. Track changes through time by adding update photos to a Capture Group Timeline. 
Turn a selection of your site records into a detailed photo report in minutes, not hours. Photos in SiteCam can be sent to our report template, ready to edit, share via a URL, or download as a PDF. Reports include photo locations on your plans, GPS information, timestamps and your notes.
View your team’s photos by location, using map or plan views, or scroll through the gallery. You can search through photos by date, tags, record type, description text, and more. The AI search within the app allows you to search using the contents of a photo that has been analyzed and auto-tagged. 
Capture construction defects or snags, with markups and descriptions of what needs to be done. Pin each defect to the plan to show exactly where work is needed, all clearly shown in your report. Add update photos to a pin to record evidence of how an issue has been fixed. 
What is SiteCam good at?
Creating a centralized construction photo database for your team, instead of everyone having their own system. 
Showing the location of your photos on a plan and map
Helping you show before, during, and after update photos in a location through time 
Producing better records with timestamped and GPS-stamped photos
Improving your photo record security with all photos backed-up safely online and not filling-up your phone (optional on-phone duplicates). 
Giving you field upload options, from storing optimized photos to high-res originals, with timestamps and GPS.
Streamlining work from field to office with mobile and web platforms. 
Saving time when creating reports and easing access via a sharable report URL or PDF. 
Helping you create a photo organization system that matches your project structure
SiteCam is a great app for:
Project managers
Site engineers
Architects
Building Inspectors
Surveyors
Building consultants
Site managers
Foreman
Structural engineers
Builders
Contractors
Subcontractors

bluejetty:00141681:ios.description:
Mahjong Match: Classic Tiles for Ultimate Relaxation
Experience the timeless appeal of mahjong tiles in this beautifully crafted solitaire game designed specifically for adult players seeking mental stimulation and stress relief. Our premium mahjong tiles feature oversized designs and crystal-clear graphics that make matching effortless and enjoyable.
Why Mahjong Match Excels with Superior Mahjong Tiles
Enhanced Visibility Design
Our mahjong tiles utilize large-format displays with high contrast borders, ensuring comfortable gameplay during extended sessions. Each tile showcases intricate traditional symbols alongside modern artistic variations, creating visual appeal that keeps players engaged.
Cognitive Enhancement Through Strategic Matching
Research shows that matching mahjong tiles regularly improves pattern recognition, spatial reasoning, and memory retention. Our game leverages these benefits by presenting increasingly complex tile arrangements that challenge analytical thinking without overwhelming players.
Diverse Tile Collections
Choose from multiple mahjong tiles themes including classic Chinese characters, seasonal motifs, and contemporary geometric patterns. Each collection maintains authentic proportions while introducing fresh visual elements that prevent gameplay monotony.
Adaptive Difficulty Progression
The game intelligently adjusts mahjong tiles placement complexity based on your performance metrics. Advanced algorithms ensure optimal challenge levels that promote skill development without causing frustration.
Professional Gaming Features
• Smart hint system highlights available mahjong tiles matches
• Shuffle function reorganizes tiles when progress stalls
• Progress tracking across thousands of unique layouts
• Multiple game modes from relaxed exploration to timed challenges
Technical Excellence
Optimized for smartphones and tablets with offline capability ensuring uninterrupted access to your favorite mahjong tiles anywhere. 
Therapeutic Gaming Experience
Unlike fast-paced mobile games, our mahjong tiles matching promotes mindfulness and relaxation. The absence of timers creates a pressure-free environment perfect for meditation and stress reduction.
How Strategic Matching Works
Tap exposed mahjong tiles with identical patterns to remove them from the board. Victory occurs when all tiles are successfully matched and cleared. Strategic thinking becomes essential as tile positions affect accessibility of remaining pieces.
Advanced Player Support
Professional-grade assistance tools help navigate complex mahjong tiles arrangements. Hint systems provide subtle guidance without revealing complete solutions, maintaining the satisfaction of independent problem-solving.
Transform your leisure time with authentic mahjong tiles gameplay that combines traditional wisdom with modern convenience. Download today and discover why millions choose our sophisticated approach to classic tile matching.

bluejetty:00120057:ios.summary:

Discover thousands of places, events, and self-guided au
bluejetty:00120057:ios.description:
Experience Canada and the USA from a new perspective with the free Driftscape App. Whether you're a traveler or a curious local, this app is your key to unlocking hidden gems nearby.
Discover thousands of places, events, and self-guided audio tours from over 70 Driftscape partners across Canada and the USA, all conveniently accessible in one place.
Immerse yourself in Augmented Reality (AR) mode now in 3D! Imagine seeing historical figures as you tour a museum, animals as you wander a park, long-lost buildings, and historical artifacts as you pass by! Explore alternate and past worlds - you’ll discover 3D artifacts when you get close to key locations. Take a selfie in a fantasy environment, or with an imaginary beast! View captivating models from all angles, with this new enhancement to your site-specific experience in Driftscape. Watch as 3D markers overlay the streetscape, revealing intriguing stories, local businesses, exciting tours, and much more.
Search for hidden gems in Augmented Reality mode with Driftscape #Quests, our innovative scavenger hunt feature. Challenge friends and family or embark on a unique solo adventure—Driftscape Quests give you a new way to explore whether you’re onsite or browsing from home.
Plan your next outing, discover nearby attractions, restaurants, accommodations, parks, museums, and vacation getaways, all within minutes using Driftscape. It's the ultimate app for travelers and curious locals alike.
Download Driftscape now and start uncovering the wonder around you in a whole new way.
Other Features:
Tour Autoplay: Easy-to-follow handsfree experience that allows you to see and hear the next stop on your tour as soon as you’re near it.
Trip Itineraries: Easily organize must-see sites into shareable itineraries!
Multilingual Interface: supports English and French
Site-Specific Notifications: Discover hidden gems on the go! No matter where you are, Driftscape can notify you about cool historic landmarks, tours, local businesses and so much more around you.
Tailored to your Interests: Customize your app view to show only the content that you’re most interested in, with the help of Driftscape’s intuitive preference selection menu.
Audio & Video: Explore your favorite point of interest by browsing through an immersive collection of audio & video associated with specific stories and locations. 360 images and tours are also supported.
Driftscape Trivia: Play Driftscape Trivia today to learn about unique places across the country and test your knowledge. A new challenge each week!
Social Media Sharing: Share what you discover, with your friends and family, on Facebook, Twitter or by email.
Map & List Mode: Navigate using the map, or see a list of things to explore across Canada.
Searchable: Navigate the application with ease using our intuitive search and hashtag features.
Offline mode: Perfect for areas with limited cell service. Download the content for the area you’ll be visiting before you go.
So what are you waiting for? Start exploring and discover new sites, stories and more everyday!

bluejetty:00041617:ios.description:
HOW WE HELP
Spiritune believes the future of music revolves around you. Your needs, your goals, your emotions, your health. We are reimagining music to address deeper human needs -- such as stress reduction, emotional regulation, productivity and performance. With a scientific, data-driven approach, Spiritune delivers audio and music content to help you manage emotional health. So you can feel well, perform better, and live your best life. Hear what others have to say:
"Spiritune is my new sanctuary on my phone. I think this app is a game changer in self-care." - Ella
"I've often felt that my regular playlists weren't 'in tune' with the way I wanted to feel, especially when I needed them to help me destress. Spiritune's ability to seamlessly propel me into my desired state of mind never fails." - Kaitlyn
WHAT WE DO
- Playlists for work flows, productivity and relaxation
- Music to help you wake up or go to sleep
- Improve your mood and regulate your emotions
- Increase overall wellness and mental health 
- Leverage the latest in neuroscience research to reduce stress levels and heart rate through sound
- Use the HeathKit API to track Mindful Minutes
WHY IT MATTERS
Sound has a direct impact on our physiological and psychological well-being. Our auditory system is very sensitive, and artificial and distracting sounds can increase our heart rate and stress levels, whether we actively notice this or not. In a world of constant distractions and bombardment of auditory stimuli, an auditory solution has become more important than ever.
Whether you're trying to get into a focused and purposeful work flow or winding down from a long day at work, stress should not get in the way of achieving your goals. Spiritune music is personalized around your needs, your goals, and your health.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Spiritune offers multiple subscription options for access beyond our 7-day free trial period:
$5.99 per month for month-to-month subscriptions
$4.99 per month for annual subscriptions (less than $59.99 per year)
$299 for lifetime access
Note that corporate sales offer discounted rates, and that subscriptions will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings before the current period ends. 
Read our Privacy Policy here:
https://app.spiritune.com/docs/privacy_policy
Read our Terms & Conditions here:
https://app.spiritune.com/docs/terms_of_use

bluejetty:00032499:ios.description:
Welcome to Royal Sort, where sorting's the name and fun's the game! Drag, match three goods and build your own kingdom!
Ad-free and no wifi needed, puzzlers are free to show off their sorting skills!
Your mission is simple: Find the perfect 3-match and merge them to clear the level! Merge the toys, teacups, crowns, goods – anything you see! They're gone, making room for more. But watch out! Mismatched stuff gets in the way, slowing you down. Think fast, plan ahead, and use cool tricks to clear the board your own way.
Join the world of sorting puzzle games, boredom will never bother you anyways! Cross the board, collect materials to build your kingdom after passing levels, and receive massive boosters to help you achieve new records. You’re able to join and create your clan to support each other and defeat millions of opponents to have your name on the world's top rank.
Key differences:
- Gameplay: Match the three identical stuff, suitable for both sorting master and newbie!
- Focus: Shifted from decorating the castle to solving sorting challenges in different castle areas.
- Obstacles: Be aware of mismatched goods and the time pressure
- Unlockables: Unlocking new castle chambers and sorting challenges with thousands of new items and boosters!
- 3D Graphics: Stunning 3D worlds that satisfy your artistic soul and gaming experiences.
- Area: Build your kingdom, start from the castle to different rooms.
- Community: Join clans, and invite your friend, family, and your other significant other to share the fun!
- King of the hills: Show them whose name will be placed on top of the world’s leaderboard.
Unlock fancy new rooms in the castle, each with its own sorting surprises. Ready to tackle the colorful chaos?
Download Royal Sort and dive into a sorting adventure fit for a master!

bluejetty:00062765:ios.summary: Times Table ! ! is a great way to learn the multiplication table. You can quickly and easily select the factors you need to customize your practice session. Press the "All" button to quickly select or deselect all the factors. Press one of
bluejetty:00062765:ios.description:
Times Table ! ! is a great way to learn the multiplication table. You can quickly and easily select the factors you need to customize your practice session. Press the "All" button to quickly select or deselect all the factors. Press one of the other red buttons on the first column to select or deselect the row of factors associated with that button. For example, pressing the "7 x" button will select or deselect all the factors on that row.
Selected factors are shown in blue. Pressing a blue factor button will deselect it (make it gray), and pressing a gray factor button will select it (make it blue).
Features:
1) Select the individual factors to practice
2) Multiple choice option (instead of keypad)
3) Horizontal or vertical problem orientation
4) Show/hide time used
5) Select number of problems 
Selecting "Custom" for the number of problems will generate the number of problems based on the selected factors. For example, if one selects the individual factors 4, 5, and 6 for the "9 x" row, then three problems will be generated: 9 x 4, 9 x 5, and 9 x 6.
If you like this app, please consider giving it a rating. Your support will help keep the updates coming! Thank you for your support!

Every passen
bluejetty:00166576:ios.description:
Step into the world's busiest terminal and become the officer every flight depends on. Airport Security Simulator 3D puts you in charge of scanning luggage, checking passports and stopping criminals before they reach the gate.
Every passenger is a puzzle. Every decision keeps the airport safe. Fun, immersive and easy to pick up whenever you have a few minutes.
YOUR SHIFT STARTS NOW
Run the X-ray scanner to spot weapons, drugs and banned items. Match passport photos, catch fake IDs and question suspicious travelers. When an alarm goes off, respond fast and lock down restricted zones.
CORE FEATURES
• Realistic 3D airport with detailed terminals, gates and customs halls
• X-ray luggage scanning and cargo inspection
• Passport and ID document checks - spot the forgeries
• Criminal patrol: chase and arrest smugglers
• Trained police dogs to sniff out contraband and explosives
• Emergency 911 response and checkpoint control
• Rank progression from rookie officer to Chief of Airport Police
• Daily missions and unlockable scanners and gear
• Play offline - no internet required
HOW IT PLAYS
Your job changes with every mission. One moment you are verifying documents at customs, the next you are chasing a smuggler across the terminal or coordinating a K9 unit during an emergency. Each level brings tougher challenges, smarter criminals and fresh surprises, so no two shifts feel the same.
RISE THROUGH THE RANKS
Start as a rookie and earn promotions by clearing missions. Unlock advanced scanners, new tools and access to bigger terminals. Prove your leadership, supervise teams and take command as Chief of Airport Police across the entire network.
WHAT'S INSIDE
This is more than a game - it is a complete airport law enforcement experience with authentic security role-play. Detailed graphics, smooth controls and gameplay you can enjoy anywhere.
TIPS FOR SUCCESS
Watch body language, double-check every passport photo and never rush a scan - the smartest criminals hide in the details. Keep your checkpoints moving to keep flights on time.
Stay sharp, stay alert and protect every flight from takeoff to landing. Download Airport Security Simulator 3D now, secure the busiest terminals and prove you have what it takes to run the airport.
Your city, your airport, your responsibility.

- 艺术家个人主页/作品集，展示作品：艺术家发表各类当代艺术作品和潮流艺术作品，包含油画、丙烯、国画、水彩、综合材料、雕塑、陶瓷、书法、篆刻、摄影、装置、岩彩、漆画、壁画、插画、版画、素描、数码作品、摄影、行为艺术等艺术类
bluejetty:00084598:ios.description:
Artand是全球领先的青年艺术家社区和艺术品交易平台之一，这里聚集着数十万名真实的从事绘画、雕塑、影像创作的美术家、当代艺术家、收藏家、艺术品从业者及艺术爱好者们。大家可以直面艺术家了解创作背后的故事，在线下单和艺术完美邂逅。
APP功能介绍    
- 艺术家个人主页/作品集，展示作品：艺术家发表各类当代艺术作品和潮流艺术作品，包含油画、丙烯、国画、水彩、综合材料、雕塑、陶瓷、书法、篆刻、摄影、装置、岩彩、漆画、壁画、插画、版画、素描、数码作品、摄影、行为艺术等艺术类别；
- 青年艺术家在线申请创作者或者签约艺术家，开通作品出售权限，自2023年起签约免年费；
- 画廊/美术馆/艺术机构入驻：发布最新展览作品，推广优秀艺术家，完成作品在线收藏；
- 社交与互动：艺术爱好者和收藏家关注喜欢的艺术家，和艺术家在线沟通，交流艺术创作的背后的故事，给喜欢的艺术作品、文章、帖子等内容点赞、评论；
- 在线收藏艺术品：支持一口价购买，也可以通过拍卖、闪购、极速拍、议价等，以合理的价格收藏到心仪的作品；
- 拍卖：可以关注无底价起拍、1元拍、热拍、即将结拍作品，也可以在竞价中心管理自己的订阅拍卖和出价拍卖和付款情况；
- 拍卖专场投稿：官方每周组织多场精品拍卖专场，树立收藏风向标，挖掘有潜质的艺术家和优秀藏品，艺术家可在线直接投稿；
- 定制艺术作品：满足设计师、软装公司定制需求，在线支付定金后进行创作，在线支付尾款后进行作品交付；
- 藏家秀：藏家分享开箱体验，拍摄收到作品实拍图片或者视频，对于作品和整体购买体验进行点评；
- 艺术家榜单/作品榜单：可以看到新畅销艺术家榜单、畅拍艺术家榜单、粉丝增长最快的人气艺术家榜单、最受欢迎的新作榜单；
- 线上展：甄选百位优秀青年艺术家，联合策展人、学者、评论家，组织线上个展或者联展，对刚毕业的美术生和青年艺术家进行深度推广；
- 版权交易：艺术家可在线发布版权交易，满足品牌跨界合作或者版权授权等；
- 搜索：可根据作品类别、价格区间、尺寸区间、出售类型、价格排序等进行艺术品的复合搜索，也支持搜索艺术家姓名；
- 分享：将作品分享到社交媒体网站平台，如微信、微博等；
- 收藏证书：唯一编码、可追溯；
- 数据中心：记录每个人主页访问次数，粉丝数量与构成，出售作品数量和交易金额，系统进行收入分析，并智能化作出商业价值趋势分析等；
联系方式：
官网网站：www.artand.cn
官方微博：weibo.com/artand
电子邮箱：info@artand.cn
站内搜索：Artand官方账号

bluejetty:00060806:ios.description:
myGEMconnect mobile app puts management of your GEMpay account at your fingertips. It’s convenient, secure, fast, and it's free*! All you need is a GEMcloud username and password from your GEMpay provider. 
What you can do
• Using the Dashboard, view account balances and your last charge at a glance
• View actual charges by cycle, including payroll deduction and meal plan accounts
• View individual charge receipts 
• Print, share, or download any charge receipt
• Automatically login using TouchID or FaceID (available on TouchID or FaceID-capable devices)
• Personalize the Dashboard by adding your friendly name or nickname 
• Place meal orders and pay with GEMpay® or credit card directly from your mobile device.
• Signup directly from the app at facilities that allow it.
• Make payments to a GEMpay account using a credit card.
How to get started
• Download the app 
• Contact your GEMpay provider for myGEMconnect account access
Questions? Contact Common CENTS Support @ 888-932-3687
*Requires your GEMpay provider to have the myGEMconnect service.

Get your dream body with MAKEOVER, powerful and handy photo editor app. Enhance your natural beauty and make your portraits flawless with the set of cool instruments for body and face retouch. — Body reshape tool. Tune your body with bigger chest, biceps and shoulders.
— Abs pack. Easily get strong 6 and 8 pack abs. Get realistic-looking muscles with just a few taps.
— Tattoo designs. Prank your friends with cute & saucy tattoos.
— Hairstyles & hair color. Try on that trendy haircut you’ve dreamed of, change hair color easily!
— Beard & mustache editor. Don’t worry, you will conquer the girl with that hot “tough guy” look.
— Colorful collection of stickers. Spice up your photos with hats, glasses, masks, earrings and other stylish accessories.
— Artistic filters. Bring a bit of magic to your snaps with dozens of nice photo filters.
— Easy to share: save photos without watermarks and share them to social networks.
Photo editing has never been so easy! Whether you want to build your muscles, try on new hairstyle, emphasize your stomach or correct any part of your body, MAKEOVER will make it happen.
There are so many styles: hot, romantic, funny, glam. Choose the one that suits you best. MAKEOVER will inspire you to bring changes into real life! We are sure you will try on new images not only on photos.
