bluejetty:00080351:ios.name: US Bus Simulator Coach Games
bluejetty:00080351:ios.summary: Welcome to the immersive world of bus driving in different cities with rugged terrains. With meticulous attention to detail, realistic driving dynamics, and diverse challenges, this game offers an unparalleled experience for enthusiasts of
bluejetty:00080351:ios.description:
Welcome to the immersive world of bus driving in different cities with rugged terrains. With meticulous attention to detail, realistic driving dynamics, and diverse challenges, this game offers an unparalleled experience for enthusiasts of bus simulation games. From navigating bustling streets to conquering untamed paths, players will test their skills as they command a fleet of coach buses in various scenarios. With constant updates and new features, Coach Bus Games ensures a dynamic and engaging journey for every player.
Introduction:
Step into the driver's seat and embark on an unforgettable adventure. From the heart of American cities to the rugged terrains beyond, experience the thrill of navigating massive coach buses through challenging scenarios. With realistic weather conditions, day and night cycles, and dynamic traffic system, every trip offers new challenges and opportunities to showcase your prowess as a bus driver. Whether you prefer the excitement of city streets or the ruggedness of offroad terrain, US Bus Simulator promises an authentic and immersive bus driving experience like never before.
Features:
-> Providing a comprehensive bus driver experience
-> A fleet of coaches with unique features and realistic driving physics
-> HD Graphics with realistic sounds
Exciting Game Modes:
1. Ultimate Road Trip:
Navigate bustling streets and master every turn as you transport passengers through various cities.
2. Danger Road:
Conquer rugged terrains and showcase your ability to handle all types of paths and conditions.
3. Open World Driving:
Experience the thrill of driving across scenic routes focusing on the journey as much as the destination. Drive freely in the open world to play in your way.
4. Transport Mode:
Fulfill your job by transporting passengers timely from one stop to another. You have to show your bus driving skills to avoid traffic on roads.
5. Parking Mode:
Enhance your coach driving skills by parking it in the difficult routes to become a real bus driver.
6. Mini Game Modes:
If you are tired of driving different coaches & buses, then try Mini games including Circle Crash, Jam busters & Bus Taxi Rush to kill your free time.
Buckle up and prepare for an authentic bus driving adventure where every decision counts and every trip is an opportunity to prove your skills behind the wheel. Your ultimate bus driving journey begins now!

bluejetty:00127263:ios.description:
ES File Explorer is a local and network file management tool that can help you manage files easily.
【The main function】
-File management
You can create new directories, rename, move, delete files, etc.
Support file sorting by name, date, size
The iPad version supports features such as split screen, picture-in-picture, and drag-and-drop operations between apps
- file transfer
WiFi transmission function: support the transfer of files between the mobile terminal and the computer terminal
Face-to-face fast transfer function: support for transferring files between mobile phones
-Compress and decompress
Support the compression and decompression of ZIP, RAR, 7Z format files
Support Chinese password
-Built-in audio and video player
Support functions: double-speed playback (0.5～2.0), background playback, small window playback, etc.
Can directly play audio and video resources in the network disk, local area, and local area network
-Netdisk aggregation
No need to download, you can access and use the files in the network disk
Support simultaneous login with multiple accounts on the same network disk
Support mainstream network disks such as Baidu network disk, google drive, OneDrive, dropbox, etc.
-Remote service access:
SMB, FTP, WebDAV
-Built-in PDF editor
Support PDF file browsing
PDF file editing: supports highlight, underline, strikethrough, pen and other functions
-Built-in novel reader
Support TXT, EPUB format, continuous optimization
-Built-in code editor
Supports browsing and editing of 47 code formats such as json, js, log, java, php, swift, xml, net, etc.
Support code theme switching, font size adjustment, encoding format adjustment
-Other functions
Automatic backup function: support incremental backup of system albums and ES local files to Baidu network disk, SMB, FTP, WebDAV
Recycle bin function: support ES local files to be temporarily stored in the ES recycle bin after deletion to prevent file loss
Browser: Support web browsing
Application lock: protect user privacy and safety
ES PRO
- When you purchase ES PRO, you will Unlock all premium features. 
- ES PRO is billed monthly or annually at the rate corresponding to the selected plan. 
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. 
- According to the Apple Store policy, your subscription will be automatically renewed after the free trial ends. 
- Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of current period. 
- Your account will be charged according to your plan for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID account settings at any time after purchase.

bluejetty:00184029:ios.description:
Foresight Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Foresight Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Foresight Bank Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a Foresight Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00126691:ios.description:
今日校园，是一个面向高校师生的校内协作办公学习和移动服务接入平台，旨在帮助师生提升沟通、办公、学习的效率，降低办理校内业务的成本，实现高校和校内组织的数字化。
今日校园主要哪些功能：
【高校专属协作群组】
支持校内私聊、群聊即时通讯，并可一键开启群组消息查收功能，快速了解消息查收情况。
支持消息类型分类功能，一键区分普通消息和应用消息，重要通知不再被海量的聊天消息覆盖
提供多样的群组类型，打造适用高校特殊场景的协作方式，包括：行政班群、办公群、课程群等
【校内文化思政平台】
公域流量：专属校园文化广场，创建属于本校的公域流量阵地，可管可控的校内一站式学生社区新形态；
组织矩阵：自动推荐校园号，校园号、校园号内容有序聚合，形成本校专属的校园文化及组织矩阵；
资源接入：对接外部优质资源，省厅、思政等内容统一资源，聚合展示；
线上线下：线上线下融合社区，弥补学校投入不足、丰富度不够、参与度不高的问题
师生参与：咨询、互动方便快捷，形式多样，师生参与度高，用的好玩的更好，便于学校开展各类业务
【智能服务平台】
以围绕师生个体全生命周期服务的主动规划和设计为基础的价值实现逻辑，代替之前以异构系统简单互联互通为核心的技术实现逻辑。

以用户服务述求（服务科目要求和服务体验要求）反向梳理校、院两级基于师生用户服务的责任清单，并持续跟踪建设、服务和优化状态。
【终端组织服务平台】

拉新简单：组织管辖内师生强制关注，不用费心推广拉新；
安全：校内师生实名访问，干净安全，可管可控；
权限灵活：可以分多角色权限管理，各管各，互不干扰；
个性化：每个组织还能做个性化配置，建立自己特色校园号；

bluejetty:00065904:ios.description:
Keep the game rolling with Count The Pigs - the scorekeeper for your Pass The Pigs game nights.
Skip the mental maths and enjoy playing with friends and family. Just tap the positions your pigs land in, and Count The Pigs calculates the scores for you.
Less counting. More oinking.
• Easy scoring: Tap each position to add up your score automatically.
• Room for everyone: Play with two players for free, or unlock unlimited players with a simple one-time in-app purchase.
• Play your way: Adjust the game settings to suit how you like to play.
• Remember every roll: Keep a history of the positions you throw and the points you earn.
• Picture every position: Use photos of the pigs to help identify each throw.
• Keep your regulars: Activate or deactivate players while preserving their results history.
Grab your pigs, gather your friends, and let Count The Pigs handle the numbers.
Count The Pigs is a companion scoreboard for the physical Pass The Pigs game. You’ll need your own game to play; the app does not include a digital version.

bluejetty:00086077:ios.description:
Brown is a foodie who also loves to cook, and he dreams of opening his own restaurant! Team up with Brown and Sally, who've started a food truck business in order to make their dreams come true, and become a top chef!
LINE CHEF is a new type of super-cute cooking game you'll definitely enjoy! Playing is as simple as tapping the screen! Chef Brown is mega busy serving all those cute, charming, and...well, let's just say, "unique" customers, so he needs your help! Lend Brown a hand serving delicious meals to customers and make his dream come true!
LINE CHEF Features
・ A variety of shops appear in the game, and they're all really cute!
・ Prepare cuisines from a variety of countries! You'll feel like you're traveling around the world!
・ Tons of cute customers will come to your Shop to eat!
・ Many kinds of ways to play, such as Like, Serve, and Score stages!
・ Just tap the screen to play! Basic play is free and is fun for everyone, from children to adults!
・ Collect Coins to upgrade your meals and kitchen!
・ Get big Combos for crazy Coins!
・ Your cute Buddies will use their skills to help you in the kitchen!
・ Send Chocolates to friends and you'll get little gifts!
・ Pancakes, pasta, cafe meals, steak... New shops with new dishes keep on coming!
・ Play with your favorite characters, including Brown, Sally, Cony, and Choco! Have fun with LINE characters!
LINE CHEF is for you if:
・ You like cooking games
・ You like tasty dishes such as hamburg steaks and omelet rice
・ You like LINE characters such as Brown, Sally, and Cony
・ You like LINE games such as PokoPoko, Pokopang, Rangers, Bubble 2, etc.
・ You like cooking
・ You're a foodie
Aim to become a top chef in this cooking game with cute LINE characters!
Download the cute and exciting LINE CHEF now!

bluejetty:00156927:ios.name: WA DOL Driver's License Test
bluejetty:00156927:ios.summary: Are you looking for a practice material to prepare for the learner’s license test or driver’s license knowledge test for the Washington state? Use our Washington DOL Permit Practice Test to prepare for the Driver’s License test and get your
bluejetty:00156927:ios.description:
Are you looking for a practice material to prepare for the learner’s license test or driver’s license knowledge test for the Washington state? Use our Washington DOL Permit Practice Test to prepare for the Driver’s License test and get your driver’s permit with ease.
Our app provides questions based on the official manual from the Washington Department of Licensing (DOL). The app includes driver’s permit module for the car, motorcycle and Commercial Driving License CDL. The app is a ready to use study guide material for those who want to prepare for their driver’s license test. Our app can be used to practice for the Car, Motorcycle and CDL Drive’s license.
Followings are the features of Washington DOL Permit Practice Test app.
QUESTIONS FROM OFFICIAL REFERENCE MATERIAL 
The Washington DOL Driver’s Manual served as the inspiration for all of the content and questions that have been included in the app. Prepare yourself for the questions that will be on the test by going over them in advance. 
PRACTICE CATEGORY WISE QUESTIONS
The app includes a practice module that allows to get familiar with questions that fall under different categories like Traffic Rules, Road Signs and Rules of Safe driving. It also keeps track of the progress you have made in each category. It contains questions from following categories:
* Traffic Laws
* Road Signs
* Rules of Safe Driving
* CDL endorsements : Hazardous Materials, Schools Bus, Passenger Vehicle, Combination Vehicle, Tankers, Double/Triples
* Pre-trip Inspections
* Air Brakes
MOCK TEST (TEST SIMULATOR)
The application also includes a module that gives you the opportunity to take a test consisting of questions drawn at random from different categories. This section will give you an idea of what to expect from the actual exam that you will be taking.
TEST RESULT
You will get the test result based on the official criteria to pass the Driver’s License Test. You will also be able to find out what questions you've done wrong after taking the test.
TEST HISTORY
The application keeps history of how you have performed in the previous mock tests so that you get an idea of your progress.
CUSTOM TEST CREATER
You can generate speedy, short quizzes with the help of this application by picking questions from a list of unpracticed questions or by selecting questions that you have previously gotten wrong. You also have the option to choose the total number of questions on the practice test.
QUESTION CHALLENGE
This is a unique feature of our application. It allows you learn while playing a challenge game. Your score will go up by one point each time you correctly answer a question up until the point where you get it wrong. It keeps record of your high score. 
WHY Washington DOL Permit Practice Test app?
- Over thousands questions designed from the official Washington DMV manual.
- Practice questions category wise and keep track of how you are progressing.
- Go through the questions you answered wrong.
- Real time test simulator.
- Bookmark questions that you think you want to refer them later on.
- Question Challenge - Learn by playing game.
*Disclaimer:
We are not associated with any government state agency. This app is not intended to be relied upon in any dispute, claim, action, proceeding or for legal advice. For official law descriptions and administrative centres, please consult the respective state body. It is also highly recommended that new drivers take an approved driver education course to learn the rules and laws of the road, and to develop responsible driving habits. We have developed this app to help you to pass the DOL permit test with ease. The questions are designed based on the latest official Driver's handbook. But we do not claim the accuracy of information and this information can not be used in any legal case.

bluejetty:00173096:ios.description:
Reconnectez-vous à votre essence et révélez votre plein potentiel !
Gaia Meditation est l’une des applications les plus complètes pour transformer votre être dans sa globalité. Méditation, relaxation, sommeil, musiques vibratoires, reprogrammation du subconscient, respirations guidées, vidéos de motivation et d’éveil, tout est sur Gaia Meditation !
Plus de 600000 personnes profitent déjà de nos contenus au quotidien.
Gaia Meditation est accessible à tous. C’est une ressource unique, un véritable guide holistique, permettant d’améliorer votre bien-être physique, d’équilibrer votre corps émotionnel et mental, et d’accroître votre dimension spirituelle. 
Les principaux avantages de l’application :
- Contenus exclusifs
- Sans publicité
- Nouveautés régulières
- Mode avion : Écoute hors-ligne
- Diffusion sur tous vos appareils (smartphone, tablette, ordinateur, TV)
- Possibilité d’écoute avec écran de veille
- Playlist de favoris
- Recherche avancée par titre ou par mot-clés
- Notifications instantanées des nouveautés et contenus mis en ligne
- Citations inspirantes quotidiennes
- Communauté de partage avec un groupe privé in-app
- Timer de mise en veille automatique (bientôt)
Augmentez votre niveau vibratoire et alignez-vous avec vos aspirations les plus hautes grâce à notre catalogue de plus de 500 audios et vidéos:
- Méditations guidées : relaxation et sommeil, gestion du stress et de l’anxiété, lâcher prise, confiance en soi, pleine conscience, ancrage, chakras, ouverture du 3ème œil, gratitude, énergétique, connexion au Moi Supérieur, rituels de lune…
- Musique pour dormir (sommeil profond et réparateur)
- Mantras
- Fréquences sacrées et vibratoires : 432Hz, 528Hz & autres fréquences du Solfège Sacré, résonance de Schumann, musiques chamaniques et bains sonores, sons de nature 
- Guides respiratoires : cohérence cardiaque, respiration carrée, 4-7-8, respiration holotropique…
- Sophrologie et hypnose
- Reprogrammation du subconscient : affirmations positives, musiques subliminales, Kaléidoscope/Mind Movies… – Thèmes : attirer l’abondance et l’amour, perte de poids, renforcement du système immunitaire…
- Technologies sonores : synchronisation des ondes cérébrales (battements binauraux et sons isochrones) permettant d’accéder aisément et rapidement à des états de conscience précis, technologie 8D pour une immersion profonde.
- Vidéos éducatives : voyage astral, sortie de corps et rêve lucide, loi de l’attraction…
- Émissions et interviews avec des personnalités motivantes et inspirantes : éveil et conscience, développement personnel et spirituel, capacités extra-sensorielles…
Les formules d’abonnement proposées sont renouvelables automatiquement et vous offrent un accès illimité au contenu de l’app Gaia Meditation tant que votre abonnement est actif.
Concernant les abonnements, le débit pour le paiement sera effectué depuis la carte bancaire rattachée à votre compte iTunes dès lors que confirmerez l’achat de l’abonnement initial. Le renouvellement d’abonnement est automatique et votre compte iTunes sera débité dans les 24 heures précédent la fin de la période d’abonnement en cours. L’abonnement se renouvelle au même prix, automatiquement, à moins que l’option « renouvellement automatique » n’ait été désactivée au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période d’abonnement en cours. Pour gérer votre abonnement et désactiver le renouvellement automatique, vous devez accéder à votre compte iTunes. Toute partie inutilisée d’un essai gratuit, s’il a été offert, sera perdue lorsque vous souscrivez à un abonnement.
Profitez dès maintenant des puissants bienfaits de Gaia Meditation avec votre essai gratuit de 7 jours.
~ Maîtrisez votre esprit. Maîtrisez votre vie. ~

What
bluejetty:00095653:ios.description:
Your Music, Your Way
Transform your listening experience with a music app designed for real music lovers. Whether you're discovering new artists or revisiting old favorites, we've built the perfect companion for your musical journey.
What Makes Us Different : 
+Endless Discovery : 
Access millions of songs across every genre imaginable. From trending hits to underground treasures, there's always something new waiting to be found.
+ Your Personal Collection : 
Save songs, follow artists, and create playlists that match your vibe. Whether you need pump-up tracks for the gym or chill beats for studying, organize your music exactly how you want it.
+ Smart Suggestions :
Our recommendation engine learns what you love and introduces you to music you'll actually want to hear. No more skipping through songs that don't fit your taste.
+Simple & Smooth : 
Clean design meets reliable performance. Just tap and play – no complicated menus or laggy loading. Your music starts instantly, every time.
+ Quick Access
Bookmark your go-to songs and artists for instant access. Your favorites are always one tap away.
Ready to Upgrade Your Music Experience?
This isn't just another music player – it's your gateway to a richer, more personalized way of enjoying music. Download now and start building the soundtrack to your life.
Privacy Protection

bluejetty:00186210:ios.summary: Singscope is a tool for checking the pitch of your singing. It analyzes the singing voice and shows the pitch in the music scale (C, D, E, F, G, A, B) as function of time. You can visualize your pitch and singing features, such as vibrato,
bluejetty:00186210:ios.description:
Singscope is a tool for checking the pitch of your singing. It analyzes the singing voice and shows the pitch in the music scale (C, D, E, F, G, A, B) as function of time. You can visualize your pitch and singing features, such as vibrato, in the scope.
Simply tap on the microphone button and sing to your iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch, and watch the pitch curve showing in the scope as you sing.
Features:
- Computes and draws pitch graphs in real-time
- Supports pan and zoom for the pitch graph and waveform display
- Supports playback of singing voices on the pitch graph
- Keeps recent singing voices for reviewing later
- Optimized for 64-bit CPU, for faster pitch analysis and smoother graph display
Please note that there are limitations in this app. It can not handle more than one singing voice or polyphony. It may not recognize voices for certain singing styles. For more information, please visit us at www.singscope.com.
Inside the app, we offer an In-App Purchases item "Sheet Music Support Pack". It is a feature pack that adds sheet music functionality to Singscope:
- Include a set of sheet music for vocal warm-up exercises
- Support importing of a subset of MusicXML lead sheet files
- Play back musical notes in sheet music while recording your singing voice
- Can set tempo (bpm) and do music transposition on the lead sheets.
- Highlight the positions of the musical notes in your pitch graph
For more information about "Sheet Music Support Pack", please download this free app and see the introduction in the app.

bluejetty:00091548:ios.description:
Trusted house help in minutes. Tap, book, done.
Pronto sends a trained Pronto Pro to your home for the chore you need handled: sweeping, mopping, dishes, laundry, a sharp clean before guests show up. House help took the day off? Friends coming over in an hour? Open the app, pick a slot, and a Pronto Professional shows up at your doorstep in 15 minutes for instant bookings, or at the time you've scheduled.
What you can book
20 services across home help. Pick one, or stack a few into a single visit so one Pro handles everything in one trip.
Hourly help: Book a Pro for 30 minutes, 1 hour, 1.5 hours, 2 hours, or up to 3 hours. They take on whatever you point them at during the slot.
Cleaning by room: Bathroom Cleaning, Kitchen Cleaning, Kitchen Cabinet Cleaning, Fridge Cleaning (interior and exterior), Balcony Cleaning, and Fan Cleaning. We bring the equipment for the fan.
Floor and dust care: Sweeping & Mopping, Dusting & Wiping, and Window Cleaning (interior side; exterior depends on access).
Kitchen and dishes: Utensils for the dishes, and Kitchen Prep for chopping, marinating, and basic prep work when you're racing the clock before guests.
Laundry and wardrobe: Laundry, Ironing & Folding, and Complete Wardrobe Cleaning, which empties the wardrobe, cleans it, and refolds and rehangs everything so it looks reset.
One-off help: Pre-Party Express Clean for a sharp tidy before guests, After-Party Express Clean for the morning after, and Packing or Unpacking when you're moving in or out.
How it works
Pick the services you need. Pick a time. Choose Instant for a Pro within 15 minutes, Scheduled for any future slot, or Recurring for daily, weekly, or a custom cadence. Pause, reschedule, or cancel any visit before it starts, right from the app.
Why Pronto instead of hiring directly
Every Pronto Pro is trained and background-verified. Pricing is transparent and shown live in the app for your address: per task or per hourly bundle, no per-bedroom multipliers, no advance deposits, no hidden fees. If a Pro can't make it, the system reassigns automatically so you're not left without help.
Where Pronto is live
11 cities across India: Bangalore, Delhi, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Gurgaon, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Noida, Pune, and Thane. Open the app, enter your address, and we'll confirm availability at your exact location.
Trusted by homes across India
Every Pronto Professional completes a formal training programme and a background check before their first booking. Service quality is monitored continuously through ratings and feedback after every visit. 10,00,000+ homes served. 13,000+ Pronto Pros on the platform.
Support and policies
Customer support is open 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. on +91 9910483315 or help@withpronto.com. Pay in-app via UPI, debit or credit cards, or wallets. No cash payments. Cancel any booking from the app before the Pro arrives. Cancellations made well in advance are at no charge; cancellations close to the booking time may carry a small charge to cover the Pro's reserved slot. If a visit falls short, contact us and we'll send a replacement Pro or refund where appropriate. You only pay per visit, and there is no setup charge for recurring bookings.
Open the app and tell us what your home needs.
Privacy Policy: https://withpronto.com/privacy-policy
Terms and Conditions: https://withpronto.com/tnc
Cancellation Policy: https://withpronto.com/cancellation-policy

Looking to manage your workplace benefits? Download our NetBenefits® app.
DISCLOSURES
Before investing, consider the funds’ investment objectives, risks, charges, & expenses. Contact Fidelity for a prospectus or, if available, a summary prospectus containing this information. Read it carefully.

Fidelity Investments & its affiliates, the fund’s sponsor, is not required to reimburse the fund for losses, & you should not expect that the sponsor will provide financial support to the fund at any time, including during periods of market stress.

Whether a Fidelity advisor provides advisory services through Strategic Advisers for a fee or brokerage services through FBS will depend on the products & services you choose.
Fidelity Crypto® is offered by Fidelity Digital Assets®. Investing involves risk, including risk of total loss. Crypto is highly volatile, can become illiquid at any time, & is for investors with a high risk tolerance. Crypto may also be more susceptible to market manipulation than securities. Crypto is not insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, the Securities Investor Protection Corporation, or any other government agency, & is not an obligation of any bank. Investors in crypto do not benefit from the same regulatory protections applicable to registered securities. Fidelity Crypto® accounts & custody & trading of crypto in such accounts are provided by Fidelity Digital Assets, National Association, which is a national trust bank. Brokerage services in support of securities trading are provided by Fidelity Brokerage Services LLC (FBS), & related custody services are provided by National Financial Services LLC (NFS), each a registered broker-dealer & member NYSE & SIPC. Neither FBS nor NFS offer crypto as a direct investment nor provide trading or custody services for such assets. Fidelity Crypto & Fidelity Digital Assets are registered service marks of FMR LLC.

bluejetty:00168839:ios.name: The Alphabet : Learn to Write!
bluejetty:00168839:ios.summary:
Welcome to 'ABC Alphabet: Learn to Write!', where learning the alphabet is an exciting adventure! Perfect for young learners, our app provides a fun and interactive way for kids to master writing the alphabet in three unique steps.
Step ab
bluejetty:00168839:ios.description:
Welcome to 'ABC Alphabet: Learn to Write!', where learning the alphabet is an exciting adventure! Perfect for young learners, our app provides a fun and interactive way for kids to master writing the alphabet in three unique steps.
Step aboard the alphabet train as you embark on a journey through the letters! In Step One, children will be delighted by captivating animations accompanying each letter they write. Watch as the train chugs along, making learning letter formation an enjoyable experience.
Moving on to Step Two, children will engage in hands-on learning as they use apples, balloons, or other fun objects to trace and write each letter. This interactive approach not only reinforces letter recognition but also encourages fine motor skills development.
In Step Three, children will have the opportunity to practice writing independently, with helpful guidance and feedback provided along the way. Whether they're tracing letters or writing them freehand, our app ensures that every stroke is a step closer to mastering the alphabet.
Key Features:
Three engaging steps to learn letter formation: Animation, Interactive Tracing, and Independent Writing.
Vibrant visuals and captivating animations keep kids entertained while they learn.
Interactive tracing activities with fun objects make learning the alphabet a hands-on experience.
Progress tracking and feedback ensure continual improvement and mastery.
Make learning the alphabet a joyous journey for your child with 'ABC Alphabet: Learn to Write!'. Download now and watch as they embark on an adventure that will lay the foundation for a lifetime of literacy!
App subscription:
You can subscribe for access to the full list of 'ABC Alphabet: Learn to Write!'. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. You will be able to do all exercises for the duration of the subscription. Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original "one month" package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting though your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the
subscription period to avoid being charged. 
Please visit: http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098 for more information.
You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period.
Any unused portion of free-trial period, will be forfeited when the user purchases an app subscription.
Links to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy can be found below.
Privacy Policy: http://kida.app/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://kida.app/terms-and-conditions.html
* Prices are equal to the value that "Apple's App Store Pricing Matrix" determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in $ USD

FAST & EASY SIGN UP
Sign up in minutes
No credit check or minimum balance
No minimum balance or monthly maintenance fees
BUSINESS BANKING

Organize, budget, and save with pockets
Create multiple virtual cards for flexible spending

See your tax estimate and auto-save for taxes
Find write-offs for easy tax savings
Auto-fill tax forms like Schedule C and 1099
Pay taxes right from the app³

Automatically track and categorize your expenses
Save receipts digitally and add notes

“You can practice listening, shadowing, learn from commen
bluejetty:00015645:ios.description:
“Don’t take expensive English classes. With RedKiwi, I’ve made studying English into a fun habit.” - Y***
“This app reminds me of how I studied English when I studied abroad.” - M***
“You can practice listening, shadowing, learn from commentary and check the dictionary all in one app!” - I***
Practice listening, shadowing, and even expressions, all in one app.
Want to start studying English? You won't regret downloading RedKiwi!
# Study from thousands of YouTube videos
You don't need to give up. Just have fun! Choose from TV shows, movies, animations, BBC News, celebrity interviews, and more. We've got everything ready for you to study. Learn English without even realizing it by watching your favorite videos. Is a video you want to study unavailable? Request it to the RedKiwi Team! (Caution! You might stay up all night studying) 
# Specialized in Listening. Start understanding English
Have you ever tried watching a TV show without subtitles, but ended up spacing out? Not on RedKiwi! Repeat listening and complete the expression by choosing the right words. Have fun practicing and improve your listening skills! You'll need to understand first if you want to communicate in English!
# Know the words, know the expression! Learn with our Word Map
Solve the listening quizzes, study mission words and collect them in your Word Map. Have fun studying and collecting vocabulary for your Word Map! See your Word Map fill up with words and stay motivated~ Study how words you've collected in the Word Map are used in actual expressions. You don't need to look up for examples, review vocabulary using the Word Map!
# Learn 'real' English from the Commentary of native speakers
'What's the difference of everyone and everybody?' Nobody in school teaches you about tricky expressions or how natives speak English. The native speaker teachers in the RedKiwi Team are here to help. Their commentary will help you learn English used in 'real-life'! It's the cheat code for RedKiwi users who have questions while studying.
# Get RedKiwi now if you...
- Tried almost every English app, but always get bored in 3 days
- Think that you need to 'study' to learn English
- Want to study from TV shows, movies, songs but tired of searching
- Want to study English on the bus, subway, or before going to bed
- Dreamed of understanding BBC or TED without subtitles
- Don't want to take expensive English classes
Always feel free to contact us by leaving a 1:1 inquiry if you'd like to request a new feature, or ask for help. RedKiwi strives to communicate with our users.
==================================

bluejetty:00094273:ios.description:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
Cross over into the world of "Black Mirror" and experience "Thronglets," the retro virtual pet simulation at the center of the Season 7 episode "Plaything." These pixel art critters won't just take over your phone; they could take over your life. 
"Thronglets" was originally developed in the 1990s as experimental software by legendary Tuckersoft programmer Colin Ritman ("Metl Hedd," "Nohzdyve," "Bandersnatch"). This isn't a game; it's a life-form whose biology is entirely digital. No emulator required.
MORE THAN A PET SIMULATION
Hatch and evolve hundreds of cute creatures: Thronglets! Feed, bathe and entertain them to watch them multiply. One becomes two, two becomes four, and so on. Soon there will be so many you'll call them a Throng. 
VIRTUAL EVOLUTION
As Thronglets evolve, so does the simulation, unlocking new tools, abilities, items and buildings — and much, much more. You may be surprised by your Thronglets! Evolve Thronglets at your own risk.

bluejetty:00178073:ios.name: Artleap by Lightricks
bluejetty:00178073:ios.summary: It used to take a whole lot of effort and time to get a beautiful double exposure or a fragmenting dispersion effect, or to even be able to imagine these results. Now, they’re at your fingertips with Artleap by Lightricks (formerly Quickart
bluejetty:00178073:ios.description:
It used to take a whole lot of effort and time to get a beautiful double exposure or a fragmenting dispersion effect, or to even be able to imagine these results. Now, they’re at your fingertips with Artleap by Lightricks (formerly Quickart).
The whole world of photo editing and digital art is now encapsulated in single tap edits. So if you’ve always wanted to create imaginative, surreal, or just plain funky art, but have struggled to learn or simply don’t have the time, here’s a tool made just for you. 
We’ve made self-expression effortless with technology that helps you reach some of the most popular and visually stunning effects without any necessary experience, and without any struggle. 
With Artleap, the art of popular effects like double exposures, dispersion, tiny planet, and many, many more will be at your fingertips, while still maintaining the ability to make each result uniquely your own. 
GET BEAUTIFUL DOUBLE EXPOSURES
- Choose a portrait of yourself or someone else, and then select one of our handpicked overlays for your double exposure
- Adjust placements and other details to get exactly the look you’re searching for
APPLY ACTION PACKED DISPERSIONS
- Tap once to see the edges of a person or object shatter and disperse in your digital art
- Choose the shapes, spread, and more to personalize the look
MAKE FUN AND UNIQUE COLLAGES
- Pick your favorite images, and have them intelligently placed into a beautiful collage
- Play around with the amount of pics
REIMAGINE THE SKY
- The sky is no longer the limit - choose what your sky looks like according to your imagination
- Explore the abstract and completely surreal options
TRY AN ENDLESS AMOUNT OF COMBINATIONS
- With a wide selection of art filters that can be used together, the possibilities are endless
- From traditional art filters made modern to the most cutting edge effects in the art world, anyone can be a digital artist!
UNLIMITED ACCESS SUBSCRIPTION
- Subscribe for unlimited access to all features and content offered for purchase within Artleap.
- Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan. Alternatively, a one-time payment plan is available (this is not a subscription).
- Subscriptions auto-renew at the cost of the chosen package, unless canceled 24-hours in advance prior to the end of the current period. The subscription fee is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Per Apple policy, no cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
- Terms of use: https://static.lightricks.com/legal/terms-of-use.pdf
- Privacy policy: https://static.lightricks.com/legal/privacy-policy.pdf

bluejetty:00083976:ios.description:
Experience cutting-edge AI technology that brings your ultrasound images to life! Powered by advanced AI-based Nub theories, NubX predicts your baby’s gender and provides detailed insights into your ultrasound scans. With seamless sharing options and access to our AI assistant or live expert support for in-depth analysis, NubX makes every moment of your pregnancy journey truly unforgettable.
【How It Works】
1. Upload Your Ultrasound: Upload a photo of your ultrasound taken at 12 weeks or later (recommended for best results).
2. Prepare the Image: Adjust the alignment to ensure the baby’s back is visible and choose the direction of the baby’s head. Crop the image carefully for the best analysis.
3. Nub Theory Analysis with AI: Our advanced AI-powered Nub theory analysis calculates and reveals your baby’s gender with high accuracy and zero human error.
4. AI Chatbot Support: Use our custom-built AI chatbot to analyze your ultrasound image in detail or ask specific questions for further understanding.
5. Live Expert Support (Optional): Get personalized insights and guidance through live support for in-depth ultrasound image analysis.
6. Share & Celebrate with Friends and Family: Share your predictions and results instantly with friends and family on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and more

► Accurate Gender Predictions
Discover your baby’s gender with high precision using advanced Nub theory calculations. Get detailed confidence percentages to stay informed every step of the way.
► AI Chatbot Assistant
Ask detailed questions and receive precise answers about your ultrasound with our chatbot, specifically trained for ultrasound analysis.
► Live Support Options
Access live expert assistance for personalized guidance and deeper ultrasound insights.

Find the perfect baby name with our name generator, offering unique and meaningful suggestions.
► Nub Measurement Calculator
Use the Nub measurement tool for precise alignment and calculations to ensure the most accurate gender predictions.
► Secure Library
Store all your ultrasound images, reports, and predictions in a secure, easy-to-access library.
► AI Precision, No Human Error
Enjoy consistent, reliable results powered by cutting-edge AI technol

bluejetty:00146829:ios.summary: KAYA is your ultimate climbing guide—built by climbers, for climbers. Use KAYA to discover new climbs, watch beta videos, log your sends, and track your progress over time. Whether you're projecting your hardest grade or exploring a new are
bluejetty:00146829:ios.description:
KAYA is your ultimate climbing guide—built by climbers, for climbers. Use KAYA to discover new climbs, watch beta videos, log your sends, and track your progress over time. Whether you're projecting your hardest grade or exploring a new area, KAYA helps you climb smarter with GPS maps, offline topos, and real-time updates from trusted guidebook authors. Connect with friends, share your beta, and celebrate every send with the most psyched community in climbing. 
-Guide-
All the data, beta, and resources in one place. KAYA PRO makes outdoor climbing more accessible and convenient than ever before with verified GPS coordinates, interactive topos, and detailed climb descriptions. Official KAYA Guides are available for classic areas like Bishop, Joe’s Valley, and more — all available offline for when the service gets rough. 
- Track Progress -
With thousands of gyms and climbing areas in our database, KAYA offers a superior logging experience. Videos, ascents, comments, and star ratings are all available within each climb page. If you’ve kept a logbook with another app or website in the past, you can easily upload it into KAYA through your profile page.
- Connect -
KAYA is community-focused. You’ll be notified when your buddy breaks into a new grade so you can leave ‘em a fist-bump and a comment. In-app messenger allows you to connect with other climbers, and, if your gym is on KAYA, receive new set notifications when the routesetting team finishes slinging the freshies.

Santa Tracker App - Your Magical Christmas Companion!
Get ready for the most magical adventure of the year!
Santa Tracker is the perfect fun app for kids who can't wait to follow Santa's every move—LIVE! It’s not just for Christmas Eve, but an exciting way to track Santa's journey in real-time, anytime, anywhere!
Santa tracker is an app Where learning meets fun, as kids join Santa in exciting tasks!
Where is Santa?
With the Santa Tracker app, you can see his exact location on the map and find out when he’ll be delivering gifts right to your home! Just enable location permissions, and watch as Santa’s sleigh gets closer and closer.
Fun Daily Tasks for Kids
Santa has a new surprise everyday that will keep the kids entertained and engaged:
* Santa’s Journey to Deliver Gifts: Watch as Santa travels around the world to spread holiday cheer!
* Help Santa Identify Animal Sounds: Can you guess which animal made that sound?
* Discover Santa’s Busy Day: See what Santa is up to as he prepares for his big night!
* Identify Helpers of Community: Join Santa to complete his task to identify community helpers.
* Watch Santa’s Elves at Work: Peek into the North Pole Workshop to see how gifts are being made.
* Inspirational Messages from Santa: Enjoy heartwarming video messages from Santa himself, teaching kids how to be kind and spread goodness every day.
With Santa Tracker, your little ones will enjoy hours of fun, joy, and surprises!
Other Exciting Features
* Where is my Gift: Keep track of when your gifts are on their way with a countdown to delivery!
* Naughty or Nice?: Take the fun questionnaire to find out if your little one is on the Naughty or Nice list!
So, what are you waiting for? Download Santa Tracker now and start an unforgettable holiday adventure with Santa!
Subscription Terms:
Santa Tracker: Where is Santa? is free to download and use. Full exciting journey of Santa can be unlocked by Weekly Subscription or One Time purchase only.
Subscription will be renewed as per subscription plan. To avoid automatic renewal you must turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the current subscription period. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. You can manage your subscription and disable auto-renewal at any time through your Account Settings.
Privacy Policy: https://santatrackerapp.web.app/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://santatrackerapp.web.app/terms.html

bluejetty:00036797:ios.description:
BodBot – Better AI, Better Workouts. 
Your Own AI-Powered Personal Trainer
BodBot delivers hyper-personalized workouts tailored to your goals, equipment, fitness level, and schedule. Whether you're training at home, in the gym, or on the go, our cutting-edge AI adapts every workout in real time to maximize progress, efficiency, and results.
Train Smarter, Progress Faster
- AI-driven customization: Your workouts evolve based on performance, recovery, and even skipped sessions.
- Results on your terms: Build muscle, gain strength, boost endurance, or burn fat with workouts designed for your unique body.
- Anytime, anywhere: No gym? No problem. Train with bodyweight or equipment and get expert-level programming wherever you are.
Intelligent Adaptation & Real-Time Adjustments
- Adaptive progression: Your training plan intelligently adjusts reps, sets, weight, and intensity to keep you progressing.
- Lifestyle-aware workouts: Your plan adapts to your daily activity levels, sleep, and real-world schedule.
- Seamless structure: Get balanced programming with circuits, supersets, and strategic recovery for maximum efficiency.
Personalized Coaching & Exercise Guidance
- Step-by-step instruction: Every movement is explained in detail with detailed instructions and demo videos.
- Smart mobility & strength assessments: Unlock better movement patterns and target weak points with precision.
- Your plan, your feedback: No cookie-cutter workouts. Adjust difficulty and focus areas as you train.
BodBot: The AI Trainer That Works For You
You don’t need to figure out what to do—BodBot does it for you. Whether you’re a beginner or advanced lifter, every workout is optimized for maximum impact.
Tight hamstrings? Shoulder mobility issues? Specific muscle imbalances? BodBot identifies, adjusts, and helps you improve.
And if you miss a session or add extra activity, your plan will automatically update to keep you on track.
Your fitness, reimagined. Ready to train smarter? Download BodBot today.
- BodBot Plus - 1 month: USD $19.99
- BodBot Plus - Annual - 1 year: USD $59.99
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. You can manage your BodBot Plus subscription settings: you can turn off auto-renewal from your iTunes account settings after purchase, but refunds will not be provided for the unused portion of the term. Your account will be charged $19.99/$59.99 (depending on the product) for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Terms of Use: https://www.bodbot.com/Terms.html
- Privacy Policy: https://www.bodbot.com/Privacy.html
- Apple Health: BodBot will ask to read some of your health data - date of birth, heart rate, height, sex, steps, and weight - so that it can more closely tailor its recommendations to you. It also saves your workout, height and weight data to the Apple Health app for use in your other apps that utilize that information.
Please email feedback@bodbot.com with any requests, account issues or bugs

Welcome to Word Link Puzzle, an exciting word game that combines the fun of solving puzzles with the challenge of discovering clever combinations.
In this game, you will form word chains by connecting familiar compound words or well-known phrases, perfect for those who love creatively linking words.

Each level is designed to be challenging, keeping your mind engaged and allowing you to enjoy the satisfaction of building word chains.

 Vocabulary Expansion: Explore various categories in the game, discover new words, and expand your dictionary.
 Easy Operation: The game can be easily operated with clicks.
 Immersive Gameplay: Enjoy fewer ads and focus on the fun.

Whether you want to improve your language skills or find a relaxing pastime, Word Link Puzzle offers a delightful experience for players of all skill levels.
With intuitive gameplay and endless possibilities, it’s a word game you’ll keep coming back to.
Don’t wait any longer! Dive into the world of Word Link Puzzle, enjoy the fun of connecting words, and start your word adventure now!

This ensu
bluejetty:00096111:ios.description:
Authenticator App: 2FA is a powerful tool that adds an extra layer of security to your online accounts. This app generates unique, time-sensitive codes that you must enter alongside your password when logging into your accounts. 
This ensures that even if your password is compromised, unauthorized access is prevented. The 2FA Authenticator App is user-friendly, easy to set up, and can be used for multiple accounts. 
It provides peace of mind knowing that your sensitive information is well-protected.
Once you set up the app, you simply scan a QR code or enter a secret key provided by the website or service you are trying to secure. 
From then on, whenever you log in, you will be prompted to enter the code generated by the app.
Using a 2FA Authenticator App is a simple and effective way to enhance the security of your online accounts. 
It is highly recommended for anyone who wants to safeguard their information from cyber threats and hackers. 
By adding this extra layer of protection, you can be confident that your accounts are secure and your personal data remains private.
The app is built to work seamlessly across the Apple ecosystem. Authenticator App: 2FA is available on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and can also be used on Mac with Apple silicon, allowing you to access your authentication codes wherever you are. View your codes directly on your Apple Watch, enjoy an optimized experience on iPad, and manage your accounts comfortably on your Mac. 
Home Screen widget provide instant access to your codes without opening the app.
Your security is further enhanced with Face ID protection, ensuring that only you can access your authentication codes. Biometric authentication adds an extra safeguard for your sensitive data while keeping the experience fast and convenient.
A built-in Help section explains what 2FA is and how to set it up. Step-by-step guides and instructions for popular services make it easy to secure your accounts quickly and confidently.
iCloud synchronization for a 2FA Authenticator app allows you to store your 2FA codes securely in the cloud, making it easier to access them across multiple devices. 
With iCloud synchronization, you can easily backup and restore your 2FA codes if you change or lose your device. It also provides added security in case your device is lost or stolen, as you can still access your 2FA codes from another device.
Overall, iCloud synchronization for a 2FA Authenticator app offers convenience and peace of mind, ensuring that your online accounts remain secure and protected.
For Terms of Use, please visit
https://sites.google.com/view/authenticator-app2fa/terms-conditions
For Privacy Policy, please visit
https://sites.google.com/view/authenticator-app2fa/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00177332:ios.description:
Want to own a city? Now you have a chance to become an owner of a city! Come to Baby Panda's City where everything is decided by you. Explore cities, run stores and create fun stories! 
PRINCESS CITY
There are hundreds of makeup props, decorations and costumes for you to choose from in Princess City. You can put on a beautiful princess dress and makeup, go to all kinds of balls, and even take a ride on a float!
CUISINE CITY
Welcome to Cuisine City! It is a place where you can taste food from all over the world! Cakes, bread, fruit juice, noodle, jelly and chocolates are all available here! You can also make food with your own hands. Get creative and enjoy the fun of DIY!
LOVELY CITY
There are lots of cute pets and friends living in Lovely City! Come here to feed, take care of, dress up, treat pets, or go camping, picnicking, and adventuring at sea with your friends. Have a fun and sweet time together!
SAFETY CITY
In this city you can take part in various interesting exploration activities, including simulated earthquake rescue, fire escape, and crossing the road safely. As you explore, you can learn a lot of safety knowledge and learn how to protect yourself and stay out of danger.
CAREER CITY
What do you want to be when you grow up, a chef, a firefighter, a vet, an astronaut, an architect, a photographer, or other professions? Come to Career City where you can play as anyone you want to be and do anything you like!
CREATIVE CITY
Hi, creative artists! Do you want to design crystal tiaras, gem necklaces, or even dreamy princess dresses, birthday cakes and surprising gifts? Come and play in Creative City, make your dream handicrafts, and turn your imagination into reality!
More cities will be added in the future. Unlock new cities and create your own world now! 
FEATURES:
- Explore 12 different and vibrant cities.
-Nearly 60+ games to keep you entertained all day in Baby Panda's City.
- Over 500 types of items including lipsticks, eye shadows, musical instruments, paintbrushes, and more.
- Run different stores, take on the roles of chef, dessert chef, designer and more.
- Dozens of fun tasks: shopping, cooking, baking, designing clothes, hairdressing, makeup and more.
- More new cities to come.
-Play this city game without any pressure! No competition! Just fun for you.
Supports offline play!
About BabyBus
—————
At BabyBus, we dedicate ourselves to sparking kids' creativity, imagination and curiosity,and designing our products through the kids' perspective to help them explore the world on their own.
Now BabyBus offers a wide variety of products, videos and other educational content for over 600 million fans from ages 0-8 around the world! We have released over 200 children's apps, over 2500 episodes of nursery rhymes and animations, over 9000 stories of various themes spanning the Health, Language, Society, Science, Art and other fields.
—————
Contact us: ser@babybus.com
Visit us: https://app.babybus.com

bluejetty:00162156:ios.summary:
OnTaxi is a Ukrainian service for taxi orders and parcel delivery available in over 100 cities across Ukraine. In the app, you can place an online order, see the taxi fare before confirming, and track your ride on the map.
Why OnTaxi:
• F
bluejetty:00162156:ios.description:
OnTaxi is a Ukrainian service for taxi orders and parcel delivery available in over 100 cities across Ukraine. In the app, you can place an online order, see the taxi fare before confirming, and track your ride on the map.
Why OnTaxi:
• Fixed taxi price — after confirmation, the fare does not change.
• Choose a car class: Standard, Comfort, Business, Wagon, or Minivan.
• Parcel delivery up to 20 kg — when you need transport for things, not only passenger rides.
• Pay by cash, card, and Apple Pay.
• See where the car is on the map and how it moves to the address.
• Track your cab on the map, follow trip status, and see driver and vehicle details in the app.
• Driver details and 24/7 support are available during the order.
Useful OnTaxi features:
• Schedule a ride for a specific time.
• Order a cab for another person.
• Add up to 5 stops for more complex routes without extra calls.
• Multi-rides — up to 5 rides at the same time.
• “My Addresses” for frequent locations.
• “Plus or Minus” to adjust the trip price.
• “Sober driver”, intercity taxi, corporate taxi, and cab options for everyday mobility.
Use cases
OnTaxi works for daily city rides, work routes, trips to a station or bus stop, night routes, intercity routes, and document or parcel transfers. Use it for a longer drive between cities or a late drive home. For regular rides, the main driver is predictability: you get the fare and route details before confirmation.
Where OnTaxi works
Taxis and courier deliveries are available in more than 100 cities in Ukraine. Among them are Kharkiv, Poltava, Sumy, Cherkasy, Kropyvnytskyi, Nikopol, Kramatorsk, Dnipro, and Pavlohrad. UA coverage is broad, so choose an address in your city to check availability.
How to order a taxi:
In the OnTaxi app, set your route points, choose a car class, payment method, and desired options. When the details look right, confirm the cab order and go.
OnTaxi is a cab service for everyday rides and parcel deliveries: simple, clear, and predictable. Manage your taxi order, track its status, and keep trip details in one place through the app.

bluejetty:00121340:ios.description:
Blast bubbles, challenge your friends and enjoy bubble matching fun with penguins and reindeer in Frozen Pop! 
Frozen Pop is the next ultimate bubble shooting saga from the makers of Gummy Pop and Bubble Farmer! Put on your warm clothes and get ready to shiver as you pop the bubbles in a land filled with snow. 
Match three or more bubbles and pop them in bubble bursting madness. Team up with animals to rescue Pingoos from the Yeti in thousands of fun, frozen levels. 
Join Bender the dog with his friends and teachers on a school trip. Blast bubbles to rescue animals and stop the evil Yeti using your bubble shooting skills! 
With more than 2000 bubble bursting levels (and more added every month), the frozen fun never ends. 
Connect to Facebook and discover thrilling destinations with your friends like the Snow Forest, Rocky Snow Mountains, Winter Carnival and many more. Compete in tournaments to be the best bubble blaster around. 
Put your bubble matching and blasting skills to the test and rescue Pingoos in Frozen Pop. 
Frozen Pop features: 
Bubble Shooter 
- Burst colorful bubbles by simply matching any 3 of them 
- Aim, shoot and pop the bubbles. 
- Use amazing powerups like the bomb, lightning ball and more. 
Animal Game 
- Rescue cute little penguins from the evil Yeti and his partner, Howler the Wolf 
- Play as unique and cute animal characters, like Husky and Reindeer 
- Find different birds and animals on your journey 
Frozen Fun 
- Lots of free rewards to be won daily 
- Over 2000 free levels, with more added every month 
- Travel across frozen areas filled with adventure, like Valley of Frozen Flowers, Snow Lake & more. 
Connect and Compete 
- Compare your progress with your Facebook friends 
- Play in online tournaments and climb the leaderboards 
Stay cool and blast bubbles in Frozen Pop today

bluejetty:00157610:ios.description:
Checklist helps you organize what needs to be done, start from ready-made templates, build better lists with helpful suggestions, share with family or friends, and follow each step in guided mode.
Use Checklist for everyday tasks, shared lists, repeatable routines, reminders, habits, and work procedures.
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH CHECKLIST
• Start from ready-made checklist templates
• Use checklist builders for groceries, routines, packing, and more
• Get helpful task suggestions when building a list
• Create task lists for everyday life
• Share lists with family, friends, or teammates
• Follow each checklist step by step in guided mode
• Add reminders so important tasks do not slip
• Turn repeated checklists into routines
• Track progress and stay consistent
• Use checklists for SOPs, procedures, and repeatable work
USE CHECKLIST FOR
• Grocery lists and shopping
• Packing lists and travel checklists
• Cleaning checklists and chores
• Home maintenance
• Morning routines and night routines
• Daily habits and weekly resets
• Workout and stretch routines
• Family tasks and personal projects
• Event planning
• Work checklists, SOPs, and business procedures
START FROM TEMPLATES, BUILDERS, OR SUGGESTIONS
Do not start from a blank page every time. Browse ready-made public checklist templates, use a checklist builder, get helpful task suggestions, or create your own list from scratch.
FOLLOW CHECKLISTS STEP BY STEP
Guided mode helps you move through a checklist one step at a time, so you know what to do next and nothing important gets missed.
Use guided lists for routines, packing, cleaning, workouts, family tasks, SOP execution, procedures, and any checklist where order matters.
SHARE, REPEAT, AND TRACK PROGRESS
Share checklists with family, partners, friends, or teammates. Use shared lists to plan a trip, coordinate chores, manage groceries, prepare for an event, or keep everyone aligned on a repeatable process.
Turn repeated checklists into routines, schedule them, reuse them, and track progress over time. Use routines for morning habits, night routines, cleaning schedules, workouts, family tasks, weekly resets, and recurring work processes.
FOR LIFE, FAMILY, AND WORK
Checklist is useful for everyday checklists, guided routines, shared household lists, SOPs, standard operating procedures, and step-by-step business processes.
Create a checklist, start from a template, build the list you need, share it, follow each step, and repeat it as a routine.
Terms of Use: https://www.checklist.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.checklist.com/privacy

bluejetty:00073964:ios.summary: Prkn is an easy and simple app that uses SMS to pay for your parking tickets in the UAE. Each emirate has its SMS number and a unique format to pay parking fees through SMS. This app will facilitate the process for you. You don't need to re
bluejetty:00073964:ios.description:
Prkn is an easy and simple app that uses SMS to pay for your parking tickets in the UAE. Each emirate has its SMS number and a unique format to pay parking fees through SMS. This app will facilitate the process for you. You don't need to remember any methods or SMS numbers. Select emirate, select parking zone, a number of hours, then tap to pay.
Easy to use: 
Add your car or more
Select Emirate
Select the area
Select Parking Zone
Select the number of hours and Pay
This App Supports: 
Abu Dhabi Parking
Sharjah Parking
Ajman Parking
UAE Parking
MAWAQIF Parking
Receive a reminder 15 minutes before ticket expiry 
You need to use your Etisalat or Du mobile number to use this app. 
* Share your location on WhatsApp.
Supported car plates: 
Abu Dhabi 
Dubai
Sharjah 
Ajman
Umm Al Quwain
Ras Al Khaimah 
Fujairah
Saudi Arabia 
Bahrain
Kuwait 
Oman 
Qatar
Save your locations (such as your home or office) in one place. 
You can share saved locations later with any WhatsApp Number without saving the number. 
To send to WhatsApp, enter the mobile number or copy it from the phone app and return to Prkn App. 
You can create a QR code for your business card and allow others to scan it.
Disclaimer:
The application does not deduct any amount from any payment for parking. Through the app, you send a text message to the government entity responsible for paid parking in each Emirate, which deducts the tariff of the parking and SMS charges if applicable.

bluejetty:00041500:ios.summary:

Your smartphone is the key to your padlock and lockbox – no more forgotten combos!
Enjoy speed & ease of use, share access, have greater control with te
bluejetty:00041500:ios.description:
Master Lock® Vault eLocks has been enhanced and redesigned as Master Lock® Vault Home
Your smartphone is the key to your padlock and lockbox – no more forgotten combos!
Enjoy speed & ease of use, share access, have greater control with temporary keys/codes, low battery notifications and a 90-day history log. With a Bluetooth Smart-enabled device, you and your guests can unlock & lock your Master Lock Bluetooth Smart-enabled padlock using digital, encrypted “keys”. If you don’t have your phone with you, or you need to share temporary access with someone, the lock can be opened using a code entered on the lock keypad. In default Wake Mode, the lock unlocks upon pressing any button on the lock when your phone is with you. Optional Wake + Tap Mode, adds security by requiring the user to wake the lock and press a button on their phone to unlock the lock. The lock owner can easily add and remove guests and schedule guest access to 24/7 or time-limited access. Disabled Mode allows for maintaining a locked state while the phone is stored inside of a locker. The lock history log captures lock registration; unlock, open and relock activity; unlock method (via Bluetooth Smart-enabled device or directional code); date, time and user (if known); guest invitations, acceptances, access revocations; lock keypad tamper alerts; low battery alerts; Primary Code changes; settings changes (Automatic Relock Time, Unlock Mode, Time Zone); reset keys activity and firmware updates. The lock batteries are replaceable and can be jumped with an external battery if the battery dies in the locked position. 
Migrate your locks from your Master Lock Vault eLocks account to your new Home account using the Master Lock Vault Home app.

bluejetty:00139975:ios.description:
Welcome to Blue Swirl, the ultimate endless swimmer game that immerses you in a thrilling journey through mesmerizing ocean depths. Dive into a visually stunning underwater world filled with procedurally generated levels, ensuring every play-through is a unique and surprising experience. Test your reflexes as you navigate an infinite abyss, avoiding chasing sharks, diverse corals, treacherous rocks, and gigantic starfish lurking beneath.
Key Features of Blue Swirl:
- Immerse yourself in a visually stunning underwater experience with vibrant graphics that bring the ocean to life.
- Enjoy infinite replayability with hundreds of randomly generated obstacles, ensuring every swim is exciting and fresh.
- Tailor your challenge level with a choice between relaxing or adrenaline-pumping gameplay, accompanied by a captivating musical score.
- Hone your dash and reflex skills in the Campaign mode, preparing for the ultimate test of abilities in the hardcore infinite mode.
- Compete against friends locally and globally on leaderboards, earn achievements, and conquer challenges to showcase your mastery.
- Dive deep and collect various fish skins and gold coins as you explore the ocean and its intricate underwater subway tunnels.
- Maximize your rewards with daily bonuses from the lucky wheel and strategically use power-ups to extend your underwater journey and gracefully dodge obstacles.
Embark on a thrilling underwater adventure with Blue Swirl, the ultimate infinite runner game that promises endless fun and excitement.

Fantastical is the award-winning calendar app with powerful features including intuitive natural language text parsing, beautiful full calendar day, week, month, quarter and year views, tasks, time zone support, and much, much more.
TRY FA
bluejetty:00014078:ios.description:
Fantastical is the award-winning calendar app with powerful features including intuitive natural language text parsing, beautiful full calendar day, week, month, quarter and year views, tasks, time zone support, and much, much more.
TRY FANTASTICAL FOR FREE
• Beautiful, clean, and easy to use calendar app allowing you to manage basic events
• The DayTicker and calendar makes your schedule look the nicest it ever has
• Full screen day, week, month, quarter, and year views
• Full task support including Todoist and Google Tasks
• 3 day weather forecast (powered by AccuWeather)
• 14 day free trial for Flexibits Premium
UPGRADE TO FLEXIBITS PREMIUM FOR EVEN MORE (requires subscription)
• Includes Fantastical on all devices: Mac, iPhone, Apple Watch, and iPad
• Openings: Schedule events based on your availability
• Proposals: Create meeting polls
• Add Zoom, Google Meet, Webex, and Microsoft Teams calls
• Extended 10 day weather forecast with RealFeel and MinuteCast up-to-the-minute weather data (powered by AccuWeather)
• Browse and instantly subscribe to interesting calendars, including sports, TV shows, holidays, and much more (powered by SchedJoules)
• Calendar sets - quickly toggle multiple calendars on or off with a simple click or automatically when you leave or arrive, based on location
• Event and task templates
• Sync calendar sets and templates across devices
• Apple Watch app with Up Next and Weather (and works over LTE)
• Parser autocomplete recommendations for invitees, locations, and calendars/task lists
• Propose multiple times to easily ask people when they can meet
• Combine duplicate events across multiple calendars
• Invitees and availability lookups
• Respond to event invitations
• Default alerts
• Time zone override
• Favorite time zones
• Push updates for Google and Exchange
• Set event travel time and receive time to leave notifications
• Custom event colors
• Custom home screen icons
• Custom alert sounds
• Hide events without deleting them
• Add attachments to events on iCloud, Google, and Exchange
• Priority email support
ADDING NEW EVENTS OR TASKS IS FAST AND FUN
• The easiest and fastest way to add new events or tasks
• Type in your details or use dictation and watch your words magically turn into an actual event or task!
• Powerful parser features, including:
 - Create tasks by starting your sentence with “task” ”reminder", "todo", or "remind me to"
 - Powerful and expressive repeating events such as third Thursday of every month, every weekend, last weekday of the month, and more
 - Create alerts with phrases like "remind me tomorrow at 3PM", "alert 1 hour before", or "alarm 3PM"
THE BEST TASKS APP, TOO
• See your events and dated tasks together in the main list
• Add tasks directly from the Tasks list or new event screen - just flip the switch to toggle between events and tasks
• Set dates, times, and geofences (when I arrive/when I leave)
• Support for iCloud Reminders, Todoist, and Google Tasks
WORKS THE WAY YOU DO
• Connects to your favorite calendar services including iCloud, Google, Exchange, Office 365, Todoist, and more
• Automatically add alarms to your new events
• Fantastical is fully localized in English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Spanish, and Portuguese
• Start typing your event or task in any of these languages and Fantastical will automagically understand!
EVEN MORE FANTASTICAL
• Lots and lots of iOS and iPadOS widgets
• Background app updating enables events, tasks, and alerts to be pushed to Fantastical even if you don't launch the app often
• Birthdays and Anniversaries - see your contact’s details or send a quick birthday or anniverary greeting
• Handoff support between Fantastical for Mac, iPhone, and iPad
• Time zone support including floating time zone support
• Dark and light themes
• Stickers
• Accessibility support
• And much, much more!

bluejetty:00124023:ios.description:
Ludo the most played dice board game with both multiplayer and offline mode.
Ludo game has the longest history for dice game and board game! 
Ludo game is a classic multiplayer board game played by people all around the world. Ludo game winning requires both skill and luck. 
Ludo game is widely played by all age groups, kids, young and adult.
Ludo game is the king of all childhood board games.
Don't feel Sorry! or Get Mad in Ludo Game.
Ludo game other name is Parchís, "Parxís", "Parqués",
Ludo ( लूडो )
Ludo (飞行棋，飛行棋，飞机棋）
Get crazy in Ludo Mania and become the king of Ludo, enjoy never-ending fun anywhere, anytime! Start playing now to find out all the unique and exclusive functions!
Unprecedented Freebies
Daily Bonus: Sign in every day to get up to 2000 coins daily. Watch video can double your daily bonus!
Spin Bonus: Spin the lucky wheel to try out your luck and get extra coins! Add more spins by watching video to earn numerous bonuses. 
Video Bonus: Watch video to get up to 450 coins. Every 4 hours you can watch 5 times! 
Level-up Bonus: Once you level up, bonus coins will be given immediately. The higher level you reach, the more coins you will get.
Exclusive Game Features
Massive Bonus: Various ways are listed above to offer abundant coins that can keep you enjoying free games in Ludo mania. 
Social System: Chat with other players and send emojis to each other to make the game more joyful and interactive. 
Online/Offline: Choose to play Ludo mania either online or offline! Fight against computer or compete with local and online ludo masters, it’s all your choice!
Quick Match: Opponents will be assigned automatically and the game will begin right away or you can create private room and invite your friends.
Global Ranking: Challenge thousands of worldwide real-time players and get thrills of the ranking entertainment! Check out your position in the global ranking and be a ludo king. 
Multiple Game Modes
VS Computer：No internet connection required! Play with the computer when you are offline. It will give you incomparable immersive experience just like playing with real friends.
Local Multiplayer: In this mode, you can play Ludo mania with real friends. 2-4 players sit together and play in one device. Face to face match makes the game more thrilling and exciting! 
Online Multiplayer: Get connected to players all around the word. No matter where you are, challenge them and become the champion of Ludo!
Play with Friends: Need privacy? We’ve got special private room for you! Invite Facebook friends to your created room or share room code to your friends so they can join you. 
Simple Rules to Play
Ludo Mania is a perfect time pass strategy board game for two to four players, in which the players race their four tokens from start to finish according to the rolls of a single dice. It’s suitable for people of all ages. 
Furthermore, a player must roll a 6 to move out the yard and enter a token into play. However, if the opponent’s token lands on the same square where your take is, your taken will be returned to the yard.
Sound interesting? Having a fever for our Ludo mania? Let’s take actions now! Roll the dice, make your moves, and become the ludo champion throughout the world!

bluejetty:00090989:ios.description:
AI Lens Photo Scan – Object Identifier, Reverse Image Search & Photo Translator
What's that plant? What does this sign say? Just point your camera and find out instantly. AI Lens is the smartest visual search tool on your iPhone.
Identify any object, translate text in photos, search by image, and ask AI follow-up questions — all in one app.
IDENTIFY ANYTHING WITH YOUR CAMERA
Point your camera at any plant, animal, landmark, food, product, or gadget. AI Lens tells you what it is — with names, details, and fun facts.
TRANSLATE TEXT IN PHOTOS

REVERSE IMAGE SEARCH
Find where an image comes from or discover visually similar photos across Google, Bing, and Yandex.
EXTRACT TEXT FROM IMAGES (OCR)

TEXT TRANSLATOR

All your past scans, searches, and translations are saved for easy reference.

- Travelers decoding foreign signs and menus
- Students and researchers identifying objects or extracting text
- Shoppers looking up products instantly
- Nature lovers discovering plants, bugs, and animals
- Anyone who's ever asked "What is this?"
Download AI Lens now and turn your camera into the smartest tool in your pocket.

bluejetty:00041709:ios.name: Sésame secure Password Manager
bluejetty:00041709:ios.summary:
Tired of never finding your passwords? Have you ever dreamed of a simple, tidy and accessible notebook to organize your passwords at any time?
Sesame is the application you really need! This manager will allow you to retrieve all your pass
bluejetty:00041709:ios.description:
Tired of never finding your passwords? Have you ever dreamed of a simple, tidy and accessible notebook to organize your passwords at any time?
Sesame is the application you really need! This manager will allow you to retrieve all your passwords in an instant in a secure space. Its simple and uncluttered design makes it the simplest tool available to everyone to stay safe in the digital world.
Sesame is easy to use but also very secure; the AES-256 encryption ensures a high level of security for your data. Sesame also respects your privacy by storing your data locally on your phone. Finally a tool that doesn't try to take advantage of your data!
In this privacy-friendly approach, Sesame uses your iCloud Drive documents (which belong to you) to implement backup and synchronization features. Once again, we work to preserve your privacy while keeping an application of excellent quality.
Sesame will make your digital security stronger and simpler:
- Register your accounts, login and passwords in seconds in Sesame.
- Automatically fill out login forms with Sesame integration in Safari and applications
- Find your accounts easily with Smart Search
- Copy and paste your identifiers in a few clicks
- Protect Sesame with FaceID or TouchID
- Automatically find secure passwords with the Sesame generator
- Compatible with passkey identification keys
- Automatically back up your accounts in an encrypted way so you never forget them again.
- Access your data on your iPhone, iPad, iPod, AppleWatch and Mac!
- Synchronize your devices while still owning your data
- Export your data in clear text for free if necessary
- Get organized with the sorting feature: keep or archive your login credentials with just one swipe
Sesame premium: Enjoy it for life without a subscription!
Are you overwhelmed by subscriptions? Sesame offers you to buy the premium mode once and enjoy the premium Sesame experience for life!
Sesame Premium allows you to save as many passwords as you want but also to synchronize all your devices. You continue to enjoy the simplest password manager in unlimited!
Sesame Premium features :
- Register as many passwords as you want in the application (Limited to 40 in the free version)
- Sync your accounts to your compatible Apple devices
- Customize the Sesame icon on your iPhone/iPad/iPod to adapt it to your desires
$1.49/month with the self-renewable monthly subscription
Or $29.99 to unlock this feature for life on all your devices connected to the same Apple account.
Compatible devices :
- iPhone, iPad, iPod (iOS 11 and later versions)
- MacBook, iMac (Catalina 10.15.0 and later versions)
- Apple Watch (WatchOS 6 and later versions)
If you choose the subscription method: a monthly subscription for Sesame Premium in the amount of $1.49 will be applied to your iTunes account at the end of the free trial period (1-month free trial period).
Subscriptions will be automatically renewed unless cancelled within 24 hours of the end of the current period. You can cancel your subscriptions at any time in your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be lost if you purchase a subscription.
Sesame cannot be held responsible for any loss of data.
For more information, see our terms of use: https://sesame.romainpenchenat.com/assistance/termsOfUse.php
Our confidentiality agreement: https://sesame.romainpenchenat.com/assistance/confidentialite.php
