bluejetty:00114254:ios.summary:
Tune your mind with frequency-verified binaural beats and isochronic tones. Unlike other apps, every NeuroPulse track is engineered with real frequencies—crafted by audio engineers and grounded in neuroscience.
WHY NEUROPULSE?
We analyzed
bluejetty:00114254:ios.description:
Tune your mind with frequency-verified binaural beats and isochronic tones. Unlike other apps, every NeuroPulse track is engineered with real frequencies—crafted by audio engineers and grounded in neuroscience.
WHY NEUROPULSE?
We analyzed popular binaural beats on YouTube and Spotify. Most contain no real binaural frequencies! NeuroPulse is different. Every soundscape is frequency-verified, layered with authentic brainwave entrainment technology.
WHAT YOU GET
• 300+ Soundscapes — Nature, ambient, music, pure tones, and therapeutic audio
• Frequency-Verified — Every track contains real, measured binaural frequencies
• Two Beat Modes — Binaural beats (headphones) or isochronic tones (speakers)
• Adjustable Intensity — Control frequency strength from subtle to immersive
• Personalized For You — Curated playlists based on your goals and preferences
DESIGNED FOR YOUR GOALS
Sleep Better
Delta waves (0.5-4 Hz) guide your brain into deep, restorative sleep. Fall asleep faster and wake up refreshed.
Sharpen Focus
Beta and gamma waves (12-40+ Hz) enhance concentration, productivity, and mental clarity. Perfect for work, study, or creative projects.
Calm Your Mind
Alpha waves (8-12 Hz) reduce stress and anxiety. Find relaxation without drowsiness.
Deepen Meditation
Theta waves (4-8 Hz) unlock deep meditative states, creativity, and insight. Ideal for beginners and experienced meditators.
Boost Energy
Gamma frequencies (30+ Hz) increase alertness and mental energy—a natural alternative to caffeine.
POWERFUL FEATURES
• Sleep Timer — Drift off as audio gently fades
• Session Timer — Track your meditation practice
• Custom Playlists — Build your perfect sound journey
• Offline Downloads — Listen anywhere, no connection needed
• Backdrop Mode — Layer NeuroPulse under Spotify, podcasts, or audiobooks
• Lock Screen Controls — Full playback control without unlocking
THE SCIENCE
For thousands of years, humans have used sound to shift mental states—from drumming circles to sacred chanting. Modern neuroscience confirms what ancient cultures discovered: specific frequencies influence brainwaves.
Binaural beats work by presenting slightly different frequencies to each ear. Your brain naturally synchronizes to this difference, gently guiding you into the desired mental state. Isochronic tones use rhythmic pulses to achieve similar results—no headphones required.
Privacy is fundamental. We don't collect personal identification, health data, or location information.
Note: NeuroPulse is a wellness tool, not a medical device. For medical concerns, consult a healthcare professional.
Join thousands who have found their frequency. Download NeuroPulse and tune your mind today.
For more information and Terms of Use, please refer to the [Apple Standard Terms of Use](https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/).

bluejetty:00022692:ios.description:
Polish your kung fu karate skills in this unique offline fighting game. The karate legends will be in the ring in your opposition. Smash the rivals and be the king of this new karate fighting game. Let’s beat the kung fu king warrior & become the champion of cobra kai karate 3D fighting games.
This new karate game is letting you play the ring karate fight and become the ultimate sports fighting champion. Prepare yourself for the Chinese martial arts championship and enjoy this new action packed karate game of 2026.
ENTER THE WORLD OF REAL KARATE KUNG FU FIGHT GAME
Be ready to be the part of the most wanted street kung fu fight game. Time to be in the karate ring and beat opponents, and eliminate the karate fighting ring fighters. prove your pro kung Fu skills over cobra Karate stars. This superhero kai fighting game starts with a quick play from where a variety of different modes are waiting for you, which makes you an addict very easily.
Play the different fighting modes and be the lone warrior. This new fighting game is offering you different combat modes, continuous upgrades and daily rewards.
CAREER MODE
First you start with the career mode where 13 different belts of kungfu is locked. Start with the first white belt. Unlock it 6 levels then you can get a chance to unlock the next 12 belt levels. Do care of your belt and don’t let your powers down.
MULTIPLAYER MODE
Multiplayer mode is a mode from which you can select your opponent according to your choice. Challenge your rival and do not let them take you down.
DRAGON MODE
Unlock the 10 levels of the kung fu panda game and enter into the dragon mode. Previous levels will drill you to modify your different ninja fighting techniques and tactics. Target you ruthless atrocious dragon. Do not let it take you down. Defend yourself and flick him atrociously.
DESTRUCTION MODE
Unlock the 15 levels and enter the most interesting mode of the kungfu street fight. Freestyle no rules of hook punch, kicks, super power and deadly combos of fight will let you beat and smash the karate rivals in this karate champ game.
MULTIPLE PLAYER TO CHOOSE
Ninja fighting game offer a variety of multiple players including the ninja girls too. Choose the best stealth master player of a street kungfu fighting game and prove to others who is the best future martial shadow samurai fighter. 
ELOQUENT NINJA HD MOVES
Your rivals use different fighting styles including kumite, taekwondo, thai, Kung Fu, boxing, combat wrestling and many more. Hd street ninja has a lot of astonishing moves which includes martial arts, unique karate moves, high/low punches, high/low kicks, backward rolling, flying kicks, hook punch, wrestling moves, jab tactics, flawless 3 hit combos, grappling techniques, kung fu action and many more.
UPGRADE YOUR PLAYER
Upgrade your karate fighting skills with level rewards and coins! Stand out in the ring against mighty rivals. And enhance your samurai power, health and attacking speed to make him more powerful and furious. Defeat your players, earn coins and points and level up your players.
WEAPONS VARIETY WITH DAILY FREE SPIN
Variety of weapons for you ruthless enemies encourages you to play every time. Also get free coins or gems through the daily free spin which help you to upgrade your players health. Plus the daily free rewards will become a mood changer for your ninja kids. 
KUNG FU KARATE : FIGHTING GAMES FEATURES:
-Taekwondo in street fighting 
-Multiple modes to play
-Upgrade and daily rewards
-Sleeper hold, butterfly kick, spinning kick, samurai moves, one finger death punch.
-Detailed 3d animation with Amusing sound
-High definition graphics and 3d models
-Entertaining game-play
SUPPORT
If you like this game want to play more games like this then feel free to visit our account “Mini Sports”. And share with your friends too.
Here the privacy link:https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Ua0F9V6t_VgIB0PcYcXaJ7EeQEIsw2nK1wJAHrqf3wU/edit?usp=sharing

bluejetty:00063284:ios.name: Draft Sharks Fantasy Football
bluejetty:00063284:ios.summary:
All The Fantasy Football Tools and Advice From Our Website… On a Mobile App
“We built the tools that we want to use”
Just about every fantasy football app will leave you frustrated: Dumbed-down tools. Limited functionality. Stuff that do
bluejetty:00063284:ios.description:
All The Fantasy Football Tools and Advice From Our Website… On a Mobile App
“We built the tools that we want to use”
Just about every fantasy football app will leave you frustrated: Dumbed-down tools. Limited functionality. Stuff that doesn’t work.
We designed our app to mirror 100% of our site.
Here’s just some of what you can expect:
PRESEASON APP FUNCTIONALITY
Unlimited Live-Draft Sync
Our draft software live-syncs to your league -- in real time. That makes tracking your draft (even on our app) super easy. App technology that simply works.
Draft War Room
A dynamic draft tool that’s a crucial part of our app. As you draft, our app software re-ranks players based on 17 value indicators. So you get true player value every round.
The Draft War Room is also customizable as a (i) Dynasty War Room, (ii) an Auction War Room (iii) a Best Ball War Room, and (iv) a Keeper War Room.
3D Projections
A systemic way to create projections. We use 3 crucial data points:(i) our award-winning projections, (ii) consensus projections from 38 other sites, and (iii) ceiling/floor projections. No other app has 3D Projections.
3D Trade Values
The most comprehensive value system in the industry. We apply a cross-positional algorithm to create a "3D Value" for each scoring format. Giving you a scientific universal valuation from 1-100 for each player.
Keeper Calculator
Our specialized tool that helps you decide which players to keep from one season to the next. It weighs factors like current-year value, future-year value, overall player value, and the draft costs associated with each player.
Player Rankings For All Formats
From PPR to half-PPR, to TE premium, to auction values, best ball rankings, dynasty rankings, rookie only, and even keeper rankings. Our rankings will be locked and loaded on your app.
Mock Draft Trainer
Match wits with our mock drafting software. Complete an entire mock draft in just a few minutes on your app. You’ll get a realistic (and super quick) draft experience for virtually every format.
REGULAR SEASON APP FUNCTIONALITY
Weekly Rankings
We create weekly rankings by using a blend of data breakdown and the brainpower of our fantasy analysts. These rankings cover all positions and multiple scoring formats including standard scoring, PPR, and half-PPR.
League Synced Free Agent Finder
The most robust waiver wire tool in the industry. Once synced to your leagues, it instantly scans available players in all your leagues -- and makes free agent suggestions. In just seconds, it does hours worth of work.
Rest of Season (ROS) Rankings
On any given week, you can get forward-looking rankings on players for the remainder of the season. Crucial for your decisions regarding trades, waiver wire pickups, and starting lineups by giving a comprehensive view of player value across all positions. The ROS Rankings are tailored for various formats.
The Redraft Trade Navigator
This app tool uses the league sync to identify optimal trade partners based on your (and their) roster needs. It ranks potential trade partners, saving you time. Then gives you detailed analysis for every potential trade.
Dynasty Trade Calculator
You’ll get everything from the Redraft Trade Navigator plus… we’ve added draft pick trades, league analysis & rankings and 3, 5 & 10 year team trade impact. No other dynasty trade calculator does that for you.
Trade Value Charts
These charts give you cross-positional value, so you get accurate player trade values. They simplify your decision-making by assigning a single value to each player. That makes it easy to compare your trade opportunities.
Who Should I Keep Tool
A keeper league tool that evaluates each player’s current-year value, future-year potential, and overall player worth. It automatically reorders players, providing a Keeper Score for each one.

bluejetty:00177739:ios.description:
Introducing Piercing Photo Editor, the perfect app to explore different piercing styles without any commitment! Whether you're considering a new look or simply having fun experimenting, this app allows you to easily try on a variety of piercing designs.
Upload a photo from your gallery or take one with your camera, then browse through our collection of piercings, from nose and ear to lip and eyebrow styles. Customize each piercing by adjusting its size, position, and angle to suit your look, and share your results instantly.
Explore the Artists Section, featuring curated designs by professional piercers for inspiration. Whether you're planning your next real piercing or just trying out new styles, this section will help you discover unique designs from top artists.

• Try on piercings with a photo from your gallery or camera.
• Browse and apply a wide variety of piercing styles.
• Customize piercings with adjustable size, position, and angle.
• Save and share your photos with friends.
• Discover curated designs from professional piercers in the Artists Section.

• Renewal charges will be made within 24 hours before the end of the current period.

bluejetty:00064628:ios.description:
Bank of Bird in Hand is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It's fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here's what else you can do with Bird in Hand Mobile:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you're paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you've misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Bird in Hand Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a Bank of Bird in Hand Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Booking flights with Webjet couldn’t be easier. Filter by airline, stops, departure time, trip length or price and see everything clearly laid out—WiFi, meals, legroom, the lot. All the ways to pay
Pay your way with 17 options, including Mastercard, Visa, American Express, PayPal, Afterpay and more. Use your credit or debit card, tap a virtual wallet, split the cost with buy now pay later, or even pay with points. Got a Webjet Gift Card? You can use that too.

Get Fully Immersed in Roleplay

enemies in another). Want to change the script? Regenerate messages or rewrite

bluejetty:00061252:ios.name: Genius Fax - Faxing app
bluejetty:00061252:ios.summary:
Genius Fax is the easiest and affordable way to send and receive faxes with your iOS device.
No need to go to the dreaded fax store anymore. Faxing with Genius Fax is simple, fast and beautiful. Read below for pricing and subscription info
bluejetty:00061252:ios.description:
Genius Fax is the easiest and affordable way to send and receive faxes with your iOS device.
No need to go to the dreaded fax store anymore. Faxing with Genius Fax is simple, fast and beautiful. Read below for pricing and subscription information.
To send a fax: choose a file from your favorite cloud service (Dropbox, Google Drive, Box) or from any other iOS app (Genius Scan, Safari, Mail…)
To receive a fax: subscribe for a number and you’re all set. You receive documents as PDF and can preview them or open them with any other app.
****
Sending:
- Tap the New fax button to open the fax' details screen
- Enter your recipient's fax number
- Scan your document with the Genius Fax built-in scanner or pick a document from the Files or the Photos app.
- Alternatively, open a PDF or image file in any of your favorite apps and use their “Open with” feature to open the file with Genius Fax.
- Optionally, add a title, sender, description, recipient details and enable the cover page.
- Tap the Send button!
- Each page costs a fax credit, the cover page is free.
Receiving:
- Subscribe to a number for 1, 3 or 6 months.
- Give away your number to whoever needs to fax to you.
- Add credits to receive faxes. One page costs one credit.
- Faxes appear in your fax list as soon as they are received and paid for.
Features:
- Simple and beautiful UI. We don't understand why business apps should be ugly!
- Pick a PDF or image file to send from another app or from the cloud.
- Send a fax to select international fax numbers (see list of countries below).
- Send and forget: be notified with push notifications when your recipient successfully received your fax, or if it failed to send.
- Receive faxes.
- Free cover page that includes the sender and recipient contact details, as well as a subject and a long description.
- Conveniently buy credits and fax number subscriptions.
- History of the faxes you sent available from any of your devices with Genius Fax (using your Genius Fax account).
- Easily delete from history.
Cost:
- Each page of your PDF file costs a fax credit to send or to receive.
- When sending, the cover page appended by Genius Fax is always free.
- You can buy credits in Genius Fax. A fax credit starts at $0.99 but costs as little as $0.39 if purchased in bulk.
- You can buy a number in Genius Fax for as little as $3.49/month.
- Send your fax to any supported country. It's always one credit per page.
International destinations supported:
US, Canada, UK, Japan, France, Germany, Spain, Austria, Portugal, Italy, Belgium, Luxembourg, Switzerland, Netherlands, Cyprus, Norway, Sweden, Estonia, Latvia, Greece, Hungary, Romania, Iceland, Ireland, Malta, Morocco, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Israel, Kazakhstan, India, China, Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, Taiwan, Thailand, Mexico, Argentina, Brazil, Puerto Rico, Costa Rica, Panama, New Zealand and Australia
Genius Fax is fully compatible with Genius Scan. You can scan documents with Genius Scan and fax them with Genius Fax. Genius Fax supports documents up to 50 MB. Please share your feedback at support@geniusfax.com so that we can improve the app with the next iteration!
Legal:
- By using Genius Fax, you agree to the terms of use.
- These terms are always available from the Genius Fax' settings menu.
Terms of use: https://geniusfax.com/terms

bluejetty:00164615:ios.description:
Do you want to play in the world of screw games? Have you been searching for the ideal color matching puzzle game? Screw Color: Nuts Jam Master will be your best choice! Ready for the nuts and bolts matching challenge?
Screw Color: Nuts Jam Master trains your brain with intricate screw and bolt puzzles that test your logic, patience, and strategy. The unscrew sorting games are not only designed for those who are seeking free games for adults, but also suitable for people of all ages!
Come and dive into hundreds of levels filled with tricky layouts and rewarding gameplay! Can you outsmart the screw pin jam puzzle? Prove your skills and become the ultimate Screw Master!
HOW TO PLAY Screw Color: Nuts Jam Master 
-Remove screws in order of the color and place them in the matching nut box.
-Strategize the order in which you pull the screws until you collect all the bolts to win.
-If you get stuck in the screw jam puzzle, super fun props can help you clear the level!
-The game has no time limit, feel free and relax!
FEATURES of Screw Color: Nuts Jam Master 
-Unique and Creative Puzzle Designs: Every level features carefully crafted screw and pin puzzles inspired by famous art, animals, flowers, and everyday objects. Each layout offers a fresh challenge, ensuring no two puzzles are the same. Unscrew, sort, and match your way through bolts and jams to unlock exciting new levels.
-Easy to Play, Hard to Put Down: The simple yet addictive gameplay keeps you engaged.
-Immersive ASMR Experience: Relax with soothing ASMR sound effects and smooth animations that make every unscrewing, pin removal and bolt match satisfying.
-Innovative Match-3 Fun: Discover a fresh twist on classic match-3 mechanics with screw puzzles. Unscrew, clear, and match your way to victory!
-Thousands of Levels to Play: Enjoy endless fun with various levels ranging from easy to challenging, designed for players of all ages and skill levels.
-Tons of Rewards: Unlock generous rewards as you progress, helping you solve more complex nuts and bolts puzzles. The more you play, the more excitement and satisfaction you'll get!
-Brain-Boosting Challenges: Train your brain with puzzles that demand creative thinking, logic, and strategy. Screw your way to mastery as you solve intricate jam-packed puzzles.
-Bright, Eye-Friendly Colors: Enjoy visually appealing designs with a color palette that is easy on the eyes for long play sessions.
-Powerful Tools: Stuck on a tough puzzle? Use a variety of tools to plan your next move, unscrew tricky bolts, and sort your way through complex challenges. Strategically utilize these items to solve even the most challenging jams.
Ready to take on the ultimate screw challenge? Download Screw Color: Nuts Jam Master now! Start your screw journey and dive into a world of nuts and bolts puzzles! Test your brain, unscrew tricky jams, and sort through challenging levels to become the Screw Master. Invite your friends and see who can master the art of unscrewing, matching, and sorting faster. Thousands of puzzles await—can you handle the frenzy?
We are constantly improving the game features and optimizing the experience. If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact us！
Support email: Screw_Team@outlook.com
Website: https://sudoku.nono-games.com/
Privacy Policy: https://www.nono-games.com/privacy.html

 Precisa controlar suas vendas, solicitar atendimentos e resolver problemas? Com o app Azulzinha você consegue isso e muito mais!
 O app Azulzinha foi desenvolvido para facilitar a rotina de milhares de brasileiros empreendedores que tem o dia a dia corrido e querem praticidade na palma da mão.
 Queremos auxiliar nas vendas e gestão do seu negócio através da tecnologia e praticidade.
 Com o app, você gerencia suas vendas, acompanha pagamentos e recebimentos feitos por cartão de crédito e débito através das vendas realizadas nas máquinas da CAIXA.
 Funcionalidades do app:
- Gestão de vendas feitas por cartão de crédito e débito 
Acompanhe todas as vendas feitas a qualquer hora e em qualquer lugar. Com apenas alguns cliques você tem acesso a todas as informações
referentes às vendas feitas pela maquininha de cartão. 
- Controle de caixa e pagamento 
Faça o controle de caixa direto do seu celular. Acompanhe os recebimentos e pagamentos das vendas que foram feitas por cartão de crédito e débito.
Garanta maior controle sobre as finanças do seu negócio. 
- Relatório de vendas 
Agora fazer o relatório de vendas do seu negócio ficou mais prático. Com apenas alguns cliques você tem acesso aos dados sobre as vendas do dia, pagamentos e recebimentos. Não fique mais preocupado com seu relatório de vendas. 
- Mais Praticidade 
Solicite Antecipação de recebíveis, bobinas, mais máquinas, tire dúvidas e mais funcionalidades a poucos toques de distância.
 Tudo isso com total segurança, praticidade e tecnologia.
 Baixe agora o app Azulzinha!

bluejetty:00097728:ios.description:
Hey, we’re Hannes & Jeremy.
We’ve been there: Every game night starts with googling rules, grabbing pens and paper, or trying random apps. But there’s just no really good party app. So we decided to build one.
Our goal? Bring the best and most viral party games together in one place. For example: Who’s the Impostor? - you’ve probably seen it on TikTok or Insta.
Easy to learn. Quick to play. Perfect for 3 to 20 people.
Great for house parties, birthdays, or your next night with friends. Gather your crew - and have fun.
The app is free to enjoy with your friends! For some extra features, Splash Plus gives you full access with a weekly subscription. You can check out our Terms, EULA, and Privacy Policy here: https://cranberry.app/terms. 
Please note: This app is not intended for use as a drinking game and contains no alcohol-related content. It is suitable for all audiences seeking fun, social gameplay.
Cheers and enjoy the app!

We’ve been there: Every game night starts with googling rules, grabbing pens and paper, or trying random apps. But there’s just no really good party app. So we decided to build one.

Our goal? Bring the best and most viral party games together in one place. For example: Who’s the Impostor? - you’ve probably seen it on TikTok or Insta.

Easy to learn. Quick to play. Perfect for 3 to 20 people.

Great for house parties, birthdays, or your next night with friends. Gather your crew - and have fun.

The app is free to enjoy with your friends! For some extra features, Splash Plus gives you full access with a weekly subscription. You can check out our Terms, EULA, and Privacy Policy here: https://cranberry.app/terms. 

Please note: This app is not intended for use as a drinking game and contains no alcohol-related content. It is suitable for all audiences seeking fun, social gameplay.

Cheers and enjoy the app!

bluejetty:00031510:ios.description:
Welcome to Puzzles Daily, the ultimate jigsaw puzzle experience that brings a new challenge to your fingertips every day! Whether you're a puzzle enthusiast or just looking for a relaxing pastime, Puzzles Daily offers an engaging and creative way to unwind and challenge your mind.
Daily Puzzles, New Surprises
Start each day with a fresh puzzle! Our daily puzzles offer unique and captivating images that will keep you engaged. With a new puzzle every day, the excitement never ends.
Customize Your Puzzle Experience
Choose your challenge! With Puzzles Daily, you have the freedom to select the number of pieces for each puzzle. Whether you're in the mood for a quick puzzle or a more complex challenge, you can tailor the difficulty to suit your preference.
Create Puzzles from Your Own Photos
Turn your memories into puzzles! Our app lets you transform your personal photos into custom jigsaw puzzles. Piece together cherished moments and relive your favorite memories in a fun and interactive way.
Features:
- A new jigsaw puzzle available every day.
- Adjustable puzzle sizes - from easy to expert.
- Create your own puzzles with personal photos.
- Save your progress and continue puzzling anytime.
Perfect for Everyone
Whether you're a puzzle pro or just starting, Puzzles Daily is designed for all skill levels. It's a great way to sharpen your mind, relax after a long day, or have some fun with friends and family.
Download Puzzles Daily today and start piecing together your next puzzle adventure!

bluejetty:00028852:ios.description:
Think of NYU Safe Ride as your safe alternative to get to and from home.
Book an on-demand ride on the app and our technology will find you a ride home. We will pair you with other people headed your way. No detours, no delays.
How it works:
- Use the app to book rides to and from points on the map.
- Get picked up at your door.
- Share your ride with others.
- Save time and reduce carbon emissions. 
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency of a shared one.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride. 
FREE
Rides are totally free. Enough said.
SAFETY
Safe Ride provides you with a safe alternative to walking to/from home by yourself late at night. 
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00026644:ios.description:
Connect to your neighborhood with Nextdoor. 
With real-time safety alerts, trusted local news, neighbor-recommended recommendation, free and for sale items, events, and groups– if it’s happening in your neighborhood, it’s on Nextdoor.
Nextdoor is the essential neighborhood network with over 100 million verified neighbors. 
WHAT MAKES NEXTDOOR THE #1 APP FOR NEIGHBORS
Stay Safe and Prepared
• Get real-time weather, traffic, and public safety alerts 
• Be notified of critical power outages, severe weather, and nearby fires as they happen
• Ask for or offer help in times of crisis
See What's Happening Nearby
• Stay informed about local news and issues from thousands of trusted sources
• Find local events like garage sales, arts festivals, and community activities
• Join the conversation– from city council discussions to highway closures to hot restaurant openings
Find Local Favorites, Recommended By Your Neighbors
• Hire a local babysitter, caretaker, or dog walker
• Find hidden gems like a secret hiking trail, best-tasting coffee, or the taqueria’s secret menu
• Get something fixed fast with a trusted plumber, roofer, or handyperson
Connect With Your Neighbors
• Find local giveaways on free items, like that bike your neighbor no longer needs 
• Join a group based on your interests and find that pickleball partner
• Keep up-to-date on all the neighborhood happenings

bluejetty:00034619:ios.description:
Want to know your sleep status and snoring every night?
SleepMo is an excellent sleep status monitor. The product includes monitoring and scoring of sleep cycle status, analysis of snoring throughout the night, including snoring type, snoring frequency, and preliminary screening of apnea analysis of the situation. And it can record your dream talk, so that you can better understand yourself at night.provides you with comprehensive sleep insights and personalized sleep optimization advice.
Core Functionalities for SleepMo
Sleep Analysis - From deep sleep to REM sleep, SleepMo tracks your entire sleep cycle, helping you understand every detail of your sleep quality.
Sleep Trend Reports - Monitor changes in sleep quality over time and gain a comprehensive overview of your sleep progress.
Snoring Monitoring- Accurately analyze your snoring patterns, providing detailed data on different snoring types and frequencies, giving you insight into your nights.
Sleep Cycle Alarms - Wake up intelligently based on your sleep cycle, ensuring you rise during light sleep for a refreshed start to your day.
Meditation Practices - Offering expert meditation exercises, helping you relax your mind and body for a more serene sleep experience.
Dream Talk Recording - No more wondering about nighttime chatter. SleepMo records your dream talk, helping you better understand your nocturnal narratives.
Personalized Recommendations - Tailored sleep optimization advice based on sleep analysis, making your sleep even more fulfilling.
Whether you're seeking improved sleep quality, solving snoring issues, or aspiring to dive deeper into your sleep experience, SleepMo offers a holistic solution. Download SleepMo now to embark on a journey towards more rejuvenating nights!
Free Features:
√ Basic sleep analysis report, including sleep cycles, scores, etc.
√ Sleep efficiency assessment and sleep age estimation.
√ Basic snoring information analysis, including decibel levels, frequency, etc.
√ Snoring risk warning feature.
√ Record nighttime sleep-talking, snoring, and other audio content.
√ Some white noise sleep aid audios and albums.
√ Basic alarm and smart alarm functions.
Premium Features:
√ Analysis and display of full-night body movement data.
√ Analysis of environmental sounds throughout the night and fitting analysis of sleep conditions.
√ Analysis of snoring loudness proportion and types.
√ Analysis and classification of snoring severity data.
√ Sleep apnea analysis.
√ Analysis of snoring location types and distribution.
√ Interpretation of weekly and monthly trends in sleep and snoring analysis.
Privacy Policy: https://www.sleepmo.ai/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
about Us
SleepMo develops smartphone applications for respiratory health screening and sleep health management. The product uses sound and machine learning algorithms to detect and evaluate respiratory health issues, eliminating the need for additional accessories or hardware. It has secured multiple invention patents for its sleep monitoring and snoring screening algorithms. Consumers can assess their sleep quality and status, as well as their risk of sleep apnea, using this product.
Disclaimer:
This app is intended for general wellness and informational purposes only. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Any health-related information provided is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Please consult a qualified healthcare provider for medical concerns.

bluejetty:00015146:ios.description:
Welcome to Cute & Tiny World – a collection of fun and educational games for preschool kids! Subscribe and get access to 60+ mini games! Join fun adventures of kitty Sue, puppy Bu, bunny Blu, panda Choo and piggy Lulu! Pet care, car building, house cleanup, dress up, cooking fun and more! Cute & Tiny World - unlimited fun for toddlers and preschool kids in one app!
Main Features
· A growing collection of best games for younger kids
· Each cute and tiny character has its own world full of little games
· Helps to develop fine motor skills and sparks creativity
· Teaches about animals, shapes, crafts and more
· Created and play-tested together with preschool kids
· 100% kid-safe environment
· Simple and intuitive design
· No ads or in-app purchases
Mini Games Inside
· Baby Care: take care of tiny kitty Sue, puppy Bu, bunny Blu, panda Choo and piggy Lulu!
· Pet DIY: create and decorate cute animal houses!
· Picnic Yummies: make yummy snacks and have a fun family picnic!
· Supermarket Shopping: have a shopping spree with your animal friends!
· Food Trucks: cook tasty dishes at a food festival!
· Fashion Boutique: create cute dresses and accessories!
· Hotel Trip: have a relaxing stay at the most unique hotels!
· House Fix: repair broken things and clean up the house!
· Toy Unboxing: unpack and assemble kids’ favorite toys!
· Winter Fun: build the coolest snowman and decorate for Christmas!
· And more!
Choose Your Subscription Plan
· Cute & Tiny World is a subscription-based app. Subscribers get full access to the app’s content, including future game additions. New games are added every month!
· You can choose between monthly and annual (yearly) subscription plans.
· Each plan goes with a 3-day free trial period! Any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
· After the trial period is over, your subscription will start automatically. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account.
· Subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
· Subscription fee for renewal will be charged to your iTunes account within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscription fee will depend on your chosen subscription plan.
· If you change your mind, you can cancel your subscription or turn off auto-renewal anytime through your iTunes Account Settings.

bluejetty:00064763:ios.description:
HODL? Blockchain? NFT? Cold Storage? Exchange? If you’ve been dabbling in Cryptocurrency, chances are you’ve seen these terms repeated - and then some! With Cryptocurrency and Blockchain becoming more of a household discussion on a daily basis, it’s time to understand what these terms are all about.
Crypto Pie is a comprehensive dictionary of 200+ Cryptocurrency and Blockchain terms, all concisely written and easily explained for the average Jane and ordinary Joe. No computer science degree required! Already know the basics? Crypto Pie has an extensive term list; including General, Fundamental Crypto, Blockchain, Altcoin & Token, Web3 & Advanced Crypto. Each term is uniquely categorized to help you learn the ropes quicker.
WHO IS THIS APP MADE FOR?
◆ Crypto Pie is made for anybody who is interested in learning about the components of Blockchain and Cryptocurrency in easy-to-read definitions.
WHAT IS THE APPS MAIN PURPOSE?
◆ Crypto Pie’s main purpose is providing a high-level explanation of 200+ terms you will often hear in the world of Cryptocurrency. 
WHY IS THIS APP NECESSARY?
◆ Whether you have no idea what Cryptocurrency or Blockchain are, or if you have a decent understanding, Crypto Pie aims to fill in the blanks.
APP FEATURES:
● Clean and intuitive User Interface.
● 200+ terms organized in 6 categories: General Term, Fundamental Crypto, Blockchain, Altcoin & Token, Web3 & Advanced Crypto.
● All terms are uniquely designed according to their category.
● All term definitions are concisely written by humans to be understood by beginners.
● Audio pronunciation of all terms.
● Filter terms by difficulty level.
● Optional PREMIUM feature allows you to quickly and easily jump from relevant term to relevant term.
No more wondering why your Uncle Greg is telling everybody he's HODLing. No more confusion when your neighbor tells you about her new ASIC miner. No more assuming Blockchain is a building-block toy.
Crypto Pie.
Learn Crypto. Easy as Pie!
DISCLAIMER:
CRYPTO PIE IS FOR GENERAL INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. CRYPTO PIE IS NOT FINANCIAL, LEGAL OR INVESTMENT ADVICE. YOU SHOULD SEEK PROFESSIONAL FINANCIAL, LEGAL AND INVESTMENT ADVICE IF YOU ARE CONSIDERING AN INVESTMENT.

bluejetty:00128775:ios.description:
Available exclusively for Netflix members.
Guide Luna through hidden dungeons and mythical temples to unlock the secrets of her past in this platformer inspired by Japanese folklore.
Each level introduces new mechanics and features that open up different ways to explore. The only catch? There’s no jump button! Swipe to move Luna left and right as she plunges deeper into each evolving, treacherous environment. You'll have to take advantage of your surroundings and rely on your wits to reach what lies below and help Luna find her true path.
Features:
• Play through story mode, where you’ll explore maze-like dungeons using simple one-touch gameplay on your path to claiming Luna's destiny.
• Test yourself in endless mode as you plunge further into unpredictable dungeons where no two runs are the same.
• Discover hidden temples, secret underground passageways and special challenge rooms to collect cryptic tablets that reveal more of Luna’s story.
• Collect as many pearls and gems as you can carry to fill up your treasure room and display your progress.
• Compete for the top spot in each temple and dungeon in daily, monthly and all-time leaderboards.
• Complete all 100 achievements to collect in-game trophies for your trophy room and solidify your status as one of the most daring treasure seekers.

bluejetty:00030501:ios.name: PDF Scanner App, OCR: Docutain
bluejetty:00030501:ios.summary:
The only Scanner App you need!
1) The integrated document scanner enables fast PDF scans in HD quality. The scan is readable and searchable thanks to automatic OCR text recognition.
2) With the secure document management system and scanner
bluejetty:00030501:ios.description:
The only Scanner App you need!
1) The integrated document scanner enables fast PDF scans in HD quality. The scan is readable and searchable thanks to automatic OCR text recognition.
2) With the secure document management system and scanner, the right document is at hand in just one click. Paper chaos or going through paper folders are a thing of the past!
3) Optional cloud integration and local storage on the device for maximum security of your documents.
4) Share scannable documents directly via email or messenger.
*BENEFITS OF DOCUTAIN*
Scan in HD
With intelligent document recognition and automatic shutter in the perfect moment, perspective correction, document edge detection, blur-reduction and color correction, you achieve a perfect scan with the PDF scanner app. Create a PDF scan or photo scan, use batch scanning for multiple pages and convert to PDF.
Edit
Manually crop, color filter, add, reorder, or remove pages. Even after saving, you can still edit the scan of documents.
Organize 
Optional index information when saving a scan (e.g. name, keywords, address, tax relevance, and optical character recognition (OCR)) helps organize and retrieve your digital documents.
Index information is automatically recognized so that you receive suitable suggestions for indexing scannable PDFs.
Docutain Pro also lets you pay your scanned invoices and monitor expenses through payment providers.
You can use the PDF scanner app to manage not only scannable documents with the camera, but also existing photos and PDF documents. This also enables to convert images to PDF files (jpg to pdf).
Search & Find
Find documents with the help of the detailed search mask, your self-defined criteria or via the full text search thanks to OCR. In addition, quick searches are available, e.g. via keywords or addresses.
Share
You can export your scannable docs as PDF files and send them directly by mail or text messenger with the mobile scanner.
Security & Privacy
With optional cloud connection you can protect documents from loss and synchronize them with all your end devices. Available cloud services: GoogleDrive, OneDrive, Dropbox, STRATO HiDrive, MagentaCLOUD, Web.de, GMX MediaCenter, Box, WebDAV, Nextcloud, ownCloud.
For maximum security, you can encrypt all data in the scanner app using state-of-the-art methods and protect app access with a password or fingerprint. No external servers are connected, data is stored locally on your device.
*USE CASES*
Invoices & Contracts
Receipts, warranties, business cards, passports, insurance documents + more scannable documents can be managed securely & clearly in one place with relevant information - e.g. end of contract reminder. 
Tax return
Find all tax-related documents within one click. Save time to focus on tax return. Docutain supports you.
Rental
Documents for service charge settlements can be assigned to the rental parties by means of keywords, without duplications after scanning. This way, billing is done quickly. Apartment handover protocols, meter readings or defects can be easily stored in the DMS.
Studies, Homeschooling, Homeoffice
Exercise sheets, homework, lecture notes, book pages + more. Share transcripts with fellow students, scan books from the term paper, or send certificates to instructors as space-saving PDF scans.
Recipes
Create your own cookbook with document types + tags and browse with flexibility combining your criteria with the PDF scanner app and intuitive document manager.
Download Docutain, the scanning app, stay organized and keep track with the smart, mobile photo scanner!
Contact@Docutain.de
Terms of Use
http://www.docutain.de/AGBPrivat?Local=en

Unleash your creativity with AI. Discover the future of songwriting with Ghostwriter, the leading AI-powered lyrics and song generator. Why Ghostwriter?

Get Started Today: Ready to revolutionize your songwriting process? Download Ghostwriter AI Song Lyrics now and start creating your next hit today. Whether you're crafting lyrics for Hip-hop, Rap, Pop, or any other genre, Ghostwriter is the ultimate tool for songwriters who want to take their music to the next level.

bluejetty:00068315:ios.name: Sunset Predictions: Alpenglow
bluejetty:00068315:ios.summary:
Alpenglow helps you capture better sunrises and sunsets, not just the times, but the quality.
Whether you’re planning a photography shoot or simply don’t want to miss a great sunrise or sunset, Alpenglow tells you when it’s worth going out
bluejetty:00068315:ios.description:
Alpenglow helps you capture better sunrises and sunsets, not just the times, but the quality.
Whether you’re planning a photography shoot or simply don’t want to miss a great sunrise or sunset, Alpenglow tells you when it’s worth going outside.
Unlike other sunrise apps, Alpenglow combines accurate times with sunrise and sunset quality forecasts, so you know how good the light is expected to be before it happens.
Key Features
• Sunrise, Sunset, Golden Hour, Magic Hour & Blue Hour Times
• Sunrise & Sunset Quality Forecasts, showing how good the light is expected to be
• Flexible reminder alarms so you never miss a great moment
• Custom locations to plan shoots and trips anywhere in the world
• Quick date navigation with arrows or a calendar picker
• Sun direction map showing where the sun rises and sets
• Augmented reality sun path to visualize the sun’s movement
• Live Activities to count down to upcoming events
• Interactive Home Screen, Lock Screen & StandBy widgets
• Apple Watch support, including complications
• Light & Dark Mode and full Dynamic Type support
Improve the forecasts
Submit field reports after a sunrise or sunset — your reports help improve future color and quality forecasts for everyone.
Alpenglow uses its own continuously evolving forecast model, designed specifically for predicting sunrise and sunset light quality. The model improves over time as more data and real-world reports are added.
Available on all your Apple devices
Alpenglow works across iPhone, Apple Watch, Mac, Apple TV, and Vision Pro, so your forecasts are always close at hand.
Alpenglow Pro
Alpenglow is free to use, with optional Pro features for photographers and planners who want more control and foresight.
With Alpenglow Pro, you can:
• View quality forecasts up to 4 days ahead
• Get forecast notifications when sunrise or sunset quality exceeds your threshold
• Let Alpenglow automatically schedule alarms when a sunrise or sunset is worth catching
• Unlock interactive forecast widgets
• Access forecast Apple Watch complications
• Use more accurate location and elevation data, processed entirely on-device
• Quickly revisit recently searched locations
• Customize the app with accent colors and alternative app icons
• Share Pro features with Family Sharing
Privacy-first by design
Your location stays on your device and is never stored online.
Alpenglow Pro subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://alpenglowapp.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://alpenglowapp.com/privacy

bluejetty:00018285:ios.summary:
Smart and secure banking with the Rabo App
Whether you want to check your balance quickly, send a payment request or block your card, you can arrange

What can you do
bluejetty:00018285:ios.description:
Smart and secure banking with the Rabo App
Whether you want to check your balance quickly, send a payment request or block your card, you can arrange
all your money matters wherever and whenever you want using the Rabo App.
What can you do with the Rabo App?
• New: pay without the Rabo Scanner.
• Secure and easy login: use Face ID, Touch ID or an access code.
• Check your balance and transfer money easily.
• View your payments and look ahead: check your current situation and see what payments are coming
your way.
• Set budgets or make savings: gain insight into your expenses to keep them under control and save for
your goals.
• Paid for someone else? Send a payment request.
• Need insurance or other banking product? Manage it all in the app!
• Receive notifications: when your salary has been paid, for example.
• Direct access to all your Rabobank products: such as your Interpolis insurance policy.
• Any questions? Call or chat with us in the app for help!
Banking on the go – for entrepreneurs
Your company never stands still, so the Rabo App moves with you. Create invoices, manage your expenses,
approve payments and authorize employees. Add a business profile and easily switch between your private
and business accounts.
How safe is the Rabo App?
Banking with the Rabo App is just as secure as online banking through your browser. The app uses a secure
connection. If you would like to find out more, visit https://www.rabobank.nl/veiligbankieren.
How do you start?
Download the Rabo App and register it once with your ID or with the Rabo Scanner. Not a Rabobank customer
yet? You can open an account directly in the app.
Would you like to find out more?
Visit www.rabobank.nl for more information.

bluejetty:00178868:ios.summary:
Welcome to Woofz—our handy, all-inclusive dog training app for you and your fluffy friend!
Ever wondered what makes your dog tick? What do those barks really mean? Or how to help your dog get rid of bad habits and form good ones instead?
bluejetty:00178868:ios.description:
Welcome to Woofz—our handy, all-inclusive dog training app for you and your fluffy friend!
Ever wondered what makes your dog tick? What do those barks really mean? Or how to help your dog get rid of bad habits and form good ones instead?
Look no further! Woofz will answer all your questions and help you build a happier, more harmonious relationship with your pet.
So, what’s packed inside our puppy and dog training app?
- Training lessons — Easy video guides for everyday training.
- Behavior program — Help with barking, chewing, biting, and more.
- Tips & tricks — Simple advice and fun tricks to teach your dog.
- Care routines — Personalized grooming, hygiene, and wellness plans.
- 24/7 AI Assistant — Instant answers to your dog-related questions.
- Dog profiles — Keep track of your dog's progress and milestones.
- Doggy calendar — Manage walks, training sessions, and reminders.
- Walking tracker — Track your dog's daily activity and exercise.
And much more!
Grab a treat and set off on an exciting journey into the world of dogs. You and your furry friend will love it!
F.A.Q.
Q: How do I stop my dog from pulling on the leash?
A: Teach your dog to enjoy calm, stress-free walks with guided training from Woofz.
Q: How can I potty train my puppy?
A: Build reliable potty habits with step-by-step puppy training plans.
Q: Why does my dog bark so much?
A: Learn what triggers barking and how to encourage calmer behavior.
Q: How do I properly socialize my dog?
A: Help your dog grow into a confident companion with expert-guided socialization.
Q: How much exercise does my dog need?
A: Get personalized activity and enrichment recommendations tailored to your dog.
The app contains the following subscription options:
- Weekly with a 3-day free trial at $ 7.99; weekly with a 3-day free trial at $ 9.99; quarterly at $ 29.99; yearly at $ 29.99; yearly at $ 49.99 with a 3-day free trial; yearly at $ 59.99; monthly at $ 12.99.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- The account is charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
- The cost of renewal is equal to the value that “Apple’s App Store Matrix” determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.

bluejetty:00040603:ios.description:
Create your own immersive sound world for sleep, relaxation, focus, and satisfying ASMR tingles.
Sleep Orbit is a sleep app for calming sounds that move around your head, soft audio textures, and relaxing 3D ASMR experiences. Put on your headphones and unwind with whispers, ASMR tingles, rain, ocean waves, haircut sounds, gentle tapping, nature sounds, white noise, instruments, ambient atmospheres, and more.
Unlike ordinary sleep sound apps, Sleep Orbit lets you shape the experience around you. Mix sounds together, control how they move in 3D space, save your favorite mixes, and let your audio gently fade out with the sleep timer.
Create a soft nighttime routine, a deep relaxation session, or a fully personal ASMR soundscape. Choose from ready-made sounds, generate custom soundscapes, or upload your own audio and turn it into an immersive 3D ASMR experience.
With Sleep Orbit, you can:
• Experience 3D ASMR sounds moving around your head
• Mix whispers, ASMR tingles, gentle tapping, rain, nature, white noise, and ambient sounds
• Create custom ASMR sounds and soundscapes for sleep
• Upload your own audio and transform it into immersive 3D sound
• Layer multiple sounds to build your personal ASMR environment
• Save your favorite mixes and nighttime routines
• Use the sleep timer with gentle audio fade-out
• Create calming sound spaces for sleep, relaxation, focus, meditation, stress relief, and deep rest
If you love classic ASMR triggers, soft whispers, binaural-style sounds, rain, warm atmospheres, or your own personal recordings, Sleep Orbit helps you create a sound world that feels completely yours.
Sleep Orbit is not just another ASMR sound app.
It is your personal 3D ASMR studio for sleep.

2ULaundry is the new way to do laundry and dry cleaning. We pick up your clothes, clean them to your preferences, and bring them back so fast you’ll hardly notice they ever left. With 2ULaundry’s expert laundry service, turn your laundry day into a do-what-you-want day. Join the thousands in the Charlotte area that are saving hours of free time every week with 2U’s Laundry & Dry Cleaning services. It’s your laundry day reimagined. 
The 2U App is the best way to sign up and manage your account. Schedule pickups, track orders, manage your account, and get support all through our simple, easy-to-use mobile app. Sign up & log in to get started. 
How It Works:
1. Sign up & schedule pickups using our 2U App. Before your first service, we’ll deliver a Welcome Kit containing your new 2U Bags. 
2. Fill your 2U Bags and leave the rest to the pros! We’ll sort your laundry into lights & darks, treat stains, and clean everything according to your preferences. 
3. On your 2U Laundry Day place your bags out for pickup. We will pick up, clean, and deliver your perfectly-folded (or hung) order in just 1-2 business days.

bluejetty:00177500:ios.description:
Scan QR Codes and barcodes in seconds.
Scan codes from photos, use continuous scanning, search your history, export it as CSV, and create QR Codes—all in one app.
Show the QR Codes you create on Apple Watch too, so membership cards and check-in codes are ready without taking out your iPhone.
Choose an error-correction level. On iOS 26 or later, customize QR Codes with rounded styling and color, and choose an Apple Watch display that prioritizes reliable scanning.
【Scanning】
・Automatically recognizes QR Code, Micro QR, and common barcode formats
・Scan by simply pointing the camera
・Read QR Codes from photos and screenshots
・Continuously scan multiple codes
・Autofocus and tap to focus
・Open scanned URLs, make calls, and send email
・Add contacts; copy and share text
・Search your scan history
・Export history as a CSV file
【Creating QR Codes】
・Create from a URL, message, or any text
・Create from contacts on your iPhone
・Keep created QR Codes updated when contact details change
・Save as an image, share, and print
・Display on Apple Watch
【Great for】
・Reading a QR Code from a photo or computer screen
・Recording multiple codes with continuous scanning
・Managing scan history in CSV
・Sharing a URL or contact with a QR Code
・Displaying a membership card or check-in code on Apple Watch
No account required. Start scanning and creating right away.
URL scheme: qrcodebarcode://
Supports Dynamic Type.

bluejetty:00070264:ios.summary: R.A.C.E is an action mobile game set in a post-apocalyptic world of steel monsters and epic battles! Survival racing simulator! Online mobile game simulator of car battles and survival races! Welcome to a unique mobile game where the manage
bluejetty:00070264:ios.description:
R.A.C.E is an action mobile game set in a post-apocalyptic world of steel monsters and epic battles! Survival racing simulator! Online mobile game simulator of car battles and survival races! Welcome to a unique mobile game where the management, pumping and control of the car at the highest level! Real steel rage in survival races! Get engaged in 3D ultimate race battles, fire rockets and use the protective shield to counter the attack from the enemy. Nitro Boost is mandatory! Collect turbo while you hit that gas pedal and leave all other race cars behind. You decide the rules on the track while you drift, drag, bump, collide, fire and overtake to finish first!
FAST ACTION RACING IN 3D
Monster trucks, roaring engines, smoking tires, damaging collisions, and above all Speed! R.A.C.E. - Rocket Arena Car Extreme - is full of epic explosions, destruction and effects. Press nitro - get even more adrenaline, and let your enemies breathe dust. The change of day and night, the neon signs and tricks will never let you get bored. If you like to play with beautiful graphics and no brakes, then this is your race car game of choice! You can change the graphics settings to improve the gameplay quality and smoothness.
THE ULTIMATE RACE BATTLE EXPERIENCE
Your Monster Truck, your arena, your rules! Participate in Arena battles and get straight in to the real action. Burn out your enemies in the derby arena and race them into fire traps, huge morgensterns, chainsaws and other destructive obstacles. This race game is like a real action movie! Rocket Arena Car Extreme (R.A.C.E.) is a burning cocktail of survival races and battles on wheels.
VARIOUS BATTLE LOCATIONS
Participate in battles of different historical epochs!
THE BEST ENEMY IS THE BEATEN ENEMY
Crazy and dangerous driving is a good thing in this racing game because risks are needed to beat your enemies. Choose a weapon to your liking: missiles, bombs, machine guns, and various electric weapons.
BEST ARENA RACE VEHICLES
Win action-packed races and earn rewards to collect your ultimate off-road race car. Make the most out of the vehicles available to you. You will find American muscle cars, European classics and Japanese drift vehicles! Each car is equipped with everything you may need to inflict the maximal damage to your opponents. Those monsters on wheels will cope with any off-road conditions.
VEHICLES LEVEL-UP SYSTEM
Each vehicle may be leveled up as high as level 30. When a vehicle is leveled up to levels 10, 20 and 30, it gains unique body kits that improve race and battle performance even more.
NO GASOLINE AND OTHER HINDRANCES
Have you ever wondered if the tank is half full or half empty? The positive attitude rules in this action game - the tank is always full. No need to wait for several hours to restore energy for your car to start racing. You can always rush at full throttle without any limits!
THE BATTLE ROYALE RACING GAME - ONE AGAINST ALL
Get prepared to battle for the rank. Many players fight to become the first one and to grab the main reward - the all-time champion title. Upgrade your cars, unlock new ones, upgrade your super skills and perks, upgrade your weapons and win on the road!
MUSIC DESIGNED TO FEEL THE RACING EXPERIENCE 
Enjoy the specially designed music to feel the excitement of the spectacular speed and explosive competition during the races.
REALISTIC 3D GRAPHICS 
You can change the graphics settings to improve the gameplay quality and smoothness. Unique car skins, colorful and vibrant styles of drawings and car stickers!
FOUR RACE GAME MODES 
- Battle Arena – battle royale style racing
- Career – Race career campaign
- Battle Racing - Racing vehicles special mode
- Tournaments - Racing for the greatest rewards.
Play our racing game, upgrade your cars, crush your enemies, win prizes and become the king of survival races! Car shooter in your mobile phone or tablet, always with you!

Welcome to a unique mobile game where the management, pumping and control of the car at the highest level! Real steel rage in survival races! Get engaged in 3D ultimate race battles, fire rockets and use the protective shield to counter the attack from the enemy. Nitro Boost is mandatory! Collect turbo while you hit that gas pedal and leave all other race cars behind. You decide the rules on the track while you drift, drag, bump, collide, fire and overtake to finish first!

FAST ACTION RACING IN 3D
Monster trucks, roaring engines, smoking tires, damaging collisions, and above all Speed! R.A.C.E. - Rocket Arena Car Extreme - is full of epic explosions, destruction and effects. Press nitro - get even more adrenaline, and let your enemies breathe dust. The change of day and night, the neon signs and tricks will never let you get bored. If you like to play with beautiful graphics and no brakes, then this is your race car game of choice! You can change the graphics settings to improve the gameplay quality and smoothness.

THE ULTIMATE RACE BATTLE EXPERIENCE
Your Monster Truck, your arena, your rules! Participate in Arena battles and get straight in to the real action. Burn out your enemies in the derby arena and race them into fire traps, huge morgensterns, chainsaws and other destructive obstacles. This race game is like a real action movie! Rocket Arena Car Extreme (R.A.C.E.) is a burning cocktail of survival races and battles on wheels.

VARIOUS BATTLE LOCATIONS
Participate in battles of different historical epochs!

THE BEST ENEMY IS THE BEATEN ENEMY
Crazy and dangerous driving is a good thing in this racing game because risks are needed to beat your enemies. Choose a weapon to your liking: missiles, bombs, machine guns, and various electric weapons.

BEST ARENA RACE VEHICLES
Win action-packed races and earn rewards to collect your ultimate off-road race car. Make the most out of the vehicles available to you. You will find American muscle cars, European classics and Japanese drift vehicles! Each car is equipped with everything you may need to inflict the maximal damage to your opponents. Those monsters on wheels will cope with any off-road conditions.

VEHICLES LEVEL-UP SYSTEM
Each vehicle may be leveled up as high as level 30. When a vehicle is leveled up to levels 10, 20 and 30, it gains unique body kits that improve race and battle performance even more.

NO GASOLINE AND OTHER HINDRANCES
Have you ever wondered if the tank is half full or half empty? The positive attitude rules in this action game - the tank is always full. No need to wait for several hours to restore energy for your car to start racing. You can always rush at full throttle without any limits!

THE BATTLE ROYALE RACING GAME - ONE AGAINST ALL
Get prepared to battle for the rank. Many players fight to become the first one and to grab the main reward - the all-time champion title. Upgrade your cars, unlock new ones, upgrade your super skills and perks, upgrade your weapons and win on the road!

MUSIC DESIGNED TO FEEL THE RACING EXPERIENCE 
Enjoy the specially designed music to feel the excitement of the spectacular speed and explosive competition during the races.

REALISTIC 3D GRAPHICS 
You can change the graphics settings to improve the gameplay quality and smoothness. Unique car skins, colorful and vibrant styles of drawings and car stickers!

FOUR RACE GAME MODES 
- Battle Arena – battle royale style racing
- Career – Race career campaign
- Battle Racing - Racing vehicles special mode
- Tournaments - Racing for the greatest rewards.

Play our racing game, upgrade your cars, crush your enemies, win prizes and become the king of survival races! Car shooter in your mobile phone or tablet, always with you!

bluejetty:00178268:ios.description:
Passport Photo · ID Photo Maker is an identity photo utility app that functions as a precise biometric photo booth right from your iPhone camera.
* 99.7% Government Acceptance Guarantee: Built with a strict biometric compliance engine designed to eliminate application delays—the number one cause of passport rejections.
No more traditional photo booths. Our tool applies the exact US background guidelines, auto-cropping and resizing your image instantly for physical forms or the new US Online Passport Renewal (DS-82) portal. The ID photo validator recognizes which biometric photo size (2x2 inch, 3x4, 4x6 cm, 35x45 mm, etc) you need for your document (China visa photo, Canada visa photo, id photos, Green Card, CV photo and other documents) and makes it ready for a print out (e.g. at Walmart, Walgreens, Rite Aid, CVS, Costco, Target or AAA). The automated alignment utility / ID photo dimension scaler adjusts the biometric photo to the exact required size. Take id photo, China visa photo, CV photo or other photo for documents within only 3 seconds!
LOCAL PRIVACY
Your photos remain securely on your device and are never uploaded to external servers. Real-time AI processing handles all biometric verification locally.
FEATURES
* Official Background Isolation: Automatically adjusts the backdrop to meet strict white/off-white government requirements.
* Biometric Verification: Checks alignment, lighting, and facial expressions against ICAO standards before you print.
* On-Screen Capture Guidance: Real-time overlays ensure you take the perfect shot on the first try.
* Direct Printing & Export: Send your compliant documents directly to an AirPrint-compatible device, or download the exact passport layout for instant printing at any local retail photo kiosk. Exporting a standard 4x6 photo print sheet gets you 4 identical passport/visa/ID photos instead of paying at drugstores.
GLOBAL Database of Document Specifications
Our built-in database automatically applies the exact pixel, background, and biometric dimensions for global document types, including:
* United States: Green Card Diversity Visa (DV) Lottery (600x600 px, white/off-white background, fully updated for E-DV 2028 digital registration), US Visa Photo (2x2 inch dimensions), US Driving License, and State ID layout.
* Americas: Brazil 3x4 Foto, Canadian Visa, and Canadian Passport standards.
* United Kingdom: Official UK (900x1200 px digital specifications), UK Driving License, and specific Welsh / Irish Driving License formats.
* Asia & Oceania: Singapore IC Identity Card (400x514 px ICA compliant), Chinese Visa (33x48 mm, light grey background), New Zealand Passport, New Zealand Visa, and NZeTA online system.
* Europe & International: Poland ID Photo (digital and paper), German Visa (45x35 mm Schengen visa standards), Euro Visa, Dubai Visa, and support for India, Australia, Japan, Thailand, France, Malaysia, Nepal, Argentina, Zimbabwe, and more.
INFANT & CHILD Biometric Calibration
Taking a baby identity photo at home is notoriously difficult. Standard biometric algorithms fail on infants due to different facial proportions. Our app contains a dedicated child compliance module specifically calibrated to accurately scale and format photos for newborns, babies, and toddlers to meet official government requirements.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Select Document Specifications: Choose your target document type from our global directory (e.g., US Passport, Schengen Visa, DV Lottery, State ID, Resume).
2. Capture or Upload Image: Align your headshot using our on-screen camera guide.
3. Automated Alignment: The app instantly auto-crops, adjusts dimensions, and verifies biometric positioning.
4. Export & Print: Print instantly at home or download the document sheet to print cheaply at local retail store.
Terms of Use: https://appable.app/legal#terms
Privacy Policy: https://appable.app/legal#privacy

Wood Blocks is a satisfying and relaxing mix of block puzzle and sudoku games. Once you clear a row for the first time, you won't be able to put this down.

- Place block pieces onto the board.
- When you fill in a row, column, or 3x3 sudoku area, the blocks disappear, freeing space for more pieces.

Wood Blocks is an elegant and swift take on a classic puzzle genre.
You can play it anytime and anywhere, so give it a try today!

bluejetty:00185435:ios.description:
Haiti Broadcasting – Haiti’s Voice, Everywhere.
Experience Haiti like never before.
Haiti Broadcasting is the #1 destination for Haitian news, music, live TV, and radio — all in one place. Whether you're in Haiti or anywhere in the world, stay connected to your culture, your people, and your homeland 24/7.
 Features:
 Live Radio: Stream top Haitian FM, AM & online radio stations in real-time.
 Live TV: Watch major Haitian TV channels and shows live from anywhere.
 Breaking News: Get real-time updates on politics, society, and the stories that matter to Haitians.
 Music & Culture: Enjoy the latest Kompa, Rabòday, Gospel, Hip-Hop Kreyòl, and more.
 User-Friendly Interface: Clean, fast, and easy to navigate in both Kreyòl and English.
 Notifications: Stay in the loop with live alerts and show reminders.
 Why Haiti Broadcasting?
This isn’t just an app — it’s a movement. Haiti Broadcasting gives a global voice to Haiti’s local media, bridging the gap between the homeland and the diaspora. Whether you're in Port-au-Prince, New York, Paris, or Santo Domingo — Haiti is always with you.
 Built for Haitians, by Haitians.
From your favorite local stations to hard-hitting national news — this is your all-access pass to everything Haiti. Stay proud. Stay informed. Stay connected.
 Contact & Support
Having trouble with the app? Found a bug? Have suggestions or want to submit your station?
We're here to help!
Email: haitibroadcasting@gmail.com
Phone: +1 (954) 372-5249
Website: www.haitibroadcasting.com
 Download Haiti Broadcasting now and join the revolution of Haitian media.
 Haiti Broadcasting – Haiti’s Voice, Everywhere.

bluejetty:00168047:ios.description:
My Candy Love: New Gen is a free otome game, a romance game where the scenario completely adapts to your choices for a unique love story! Join a community of more than 72 million players around the world and immerse yourself in an adventure where your decisions determine the course of the story, and allow you to experience a unique and personalized romance.
- New episodes are released regularly. 
- Live a passionate story with your Crush in a colorful universe, enhanced by an immersive interface and carefully crafted animations!
- Collect romantic illustrations, exclusive outfits and decorative elements. 
- Becomes an integral part of the community, participate in mini-games with other players or in new events throughout the year. 
Story
- Explore the colorful streets of Amoris, discover in the coolest office in the whole city, and most of all, get to know your attractive coworkers, become friends with them, or even more... Or perhaps you'll let yourself fall for your rival?
- Dive into a captivating and original story, filled with profound and endearing characters.
Bonus +: Discover five unique Crushes and watch your relationship evolve over the episodes!
Gameplay
- Create your own story!
- Make the right dialogue choices to raise your affinity with your Crush!
- Get to know the Crushes by spending time with them and make your choices accordingly. All your decisions will have an influence on your love story. Make your choices, and your story will adapt to them!
- Interact with the community, exchange Hearts and participate in discussions with other players!
- Participate in mini-games, like the Style Contests, where you can showcase your best looks, compete against other players and win rewards.
Bonus +: Find a Special Scene in each episode! A heartfelt and exclusive moment with your Crush, which you can replay at any time via your Library. 
VIP
- Join the My Candy Love: NewGen VIP club!
Discover the VIP subscription and unlock a world of exclusive advantages! What’s up for grabs? More in-game currencies, Jokers, exclusive rooms and outfits, and much more to make your gaming experience easier!
Bonus +: Do you want to be even more classy? The subscription gives you a special VIP profile!
Illustrations
- Discover magnificent illustrations with your favorite characters!
By making the right choices, you will be able to unlock wonderful illustrations that depict significant moments in your story. Find them at any time in your Library!
Bonus +: The skin tone, eye and hair color you choose for your avatar are visible in your illustrations!
Personalize Your Universe
- Enjoy hundreds of clothing items, hair styles, accessories, for thousands of looks!
Dress up your avatar and decorate your room with clothes, items and accessories obtained in the episodes, in the shop, or during special events!
- Also choose your dominant personality! Are you more Sweet, Rebel or Energetic? You decide!
Bonus +: Your pet goose can also be dressed in dozens of different costumes! 
Events
- Throughout the year, take part in events with your Crush. Play exclusive mini-games and unlock new outfits and illustrations!
Bonus +: In addition to seasonal events, there are mini-events on a regular basis! What’s up for grabs? In-game currency, outfits, and more! 
Join us on social media!
Instagram: @beemoov
TikTok: @BeemoovOfficiel
Contact Us:
Questions? Suggestions? Need technical support? Contact us at: support@beemoov.com

bluejetty:00139356:ios.description:
Record Lectures is your ultimate productivity tool, designed to streamline your note-taking and summarization tasks effortlessly. Whether you're in a meeting, a lecture, or a brainstorming session, this app lets you capture and organize your thoughts with ease.
Key Features:
Basic Note-Taking & Summarization: Quickly jot down notes and let the app automatically generate concise summaries. Perfect for capturing key points without the hassle of manually condensing information.
Advanced Organization: Create and manage folders to efficiently categorize your notes. Keep your workspace tidy and find your notes when you need them the most.
Transcription Capability: Convert spoken words into written text with the transcription feature, making it easier to document conversations, meetings, and ideas on the go.
YouTube Integration: Import YouTube links directly into the app and get instant summaries of the content. Ideal for students, professionals, and anyone who needs to quickly extract key information from videos.
Experience the future of note-taking with Record Lectures—where organization meets innovation.
This app is free to download.

bluejetty:00186136:ios.description:
TXST Mobile makes it easy to stay connected with Texas State University—wherever you are. 
Built for students, faculty, alumni, and guests, the official TXST Mobile app gives you convenient access to university tools, resources, and campus information from your mobile device. 
Key features include: 
PERSONALIZED EXPERIENCE: Students and staff can sign in to gain access to advanced features, including an at-a-glance overview of Canvas LMS, billing, and more. 
SCHEDULES: In addition to personalized class schedules and week-at-a-glance view, the app includes quick access to the campus events and athletics calendars. 
WAYFINDING: Campus maps, building info, and live shuttle tracking. 
ATHLETICS: Students can use the app to check in for at athletic events and track their Bobcat Bonus points for athletic events. 
NEWS AND EVENTS: Get the latest scoop on what’s going on at Texas State including news, event calendars, and athletics updates. 
INFORMATION: Quick access to academic resources, campus directories, and more. 
Have feedback or a feature request? Visit the TXST Mobile App site mobile.txst.edu to submit feedback, support tickets, or requests.

bluejetty:00089400:ios.name: Timer - Minimal Timer
bluejetty:00089400:ios.summary: Meet Minimal Timer, your perfect companion for all your timing needs. This easy-to-use timer app helps you stay focused and manage your time well, whether you're working, studying, cooking, or just need a gentle reminder. We've designed it
bluejetty:00089400:ios.description:
Meet Minimal Timer, your perfect companion for all your timing needs. This easy-to-use timer app helps you stay focused and manage your time well, whether you're working, studying, cooking, or just need a gentle reminder. We've designed it to be simple and helpful, so you can do more with less fuss.
Set Timers with Ease:
With Minimal Timer, setting a timer is straightforward and quick. You can easily set your desired duration in minutes or hours using the clear, easy-to-use keypad interface. Simply type in the time you need, and you're ready to go. If you often use the same times, you'll also love our selection of handy presets that get you started quickly. Or, if you need something specific, you can customize your own timers to fit any activity. Minimal Timer is built to be flexible for your everyday life.
Custom Presets:
Create and save your own frequently used timer durations. Whether it's for a 25-minute focus session, a 7-minute workout, or a 30-minute cooking reminder, you can set it once and use it again and again with just a tap. This makes starting your favorite timers super quick and easy.
Custom Alarm Volume:
Adjust your alarm sound to be just right for any situation. Whether you need a loud reminder to get your attention or a quiet chime that won't disturb others, you're in control. This means your timer will always alert you exactly how you want it to.
Ambient Ticking Sound:
If you like to feel time passing, you can turn on an optional, gentle ticking sound. This subtle feature can help you stay aware of the duration and maintain your focus, creating a calm and productive environment without being distracting.
Widgets:
Keep an eye on your timers right from your home screen. Our handy widgets let you see your active timers at a glance, so you're always updated on your progress without needing to open the app. It's a convenient way to stay on track throughout your day.
Subscription & Cancellation:
Enjoy flexible subscription options for premium features. Your payment is charged to your Apple account when you confirm your purchase, and subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. If you start with a free trial, it will switch to a paid subscription unless canceled before the trial is over. You can easily manage or cancel your subscription anytime through your Apple account settings.
Ready to make managing your time a breeze? Minimal Timer is designed for everyone, with a clean look and straightforward features that just work. Give it a try today and enjoy the convenience of a reliable and simple timer tool!

bluejetty:00095415:ios.summary:
Stay connected to your recent health information and your medical provider—anytime, anywhere — all in one app from CommonSpirit.
The app is now available for patients receiving care through CommonSpirit Health associated with St. Luke's Hea
bluejetty:00095415:ios.description:
Stay connected to your recent health information and your medical provider—anytime, anywhere — all in one app from CommonSpirit.
The app is now available for patients receiving care through CommonSpirit Health associated with St. Luke's Health in Texas, CHI Saint Joseph Health in Kentucky, St. Vincent in Arkansas, or CHI Memorial in Tennessee and Georgia.
With the app you can:
● Access the CommonSpirit Patient Portal, which includes access to MyChart
● View recent test results and visit summaries  
● Book, confirm, and reschedule appointments
● Send and receive secure messages with your medical provider
● Pay your bill and review statements
● Track relevant health information, such as weight, through your HealthKit account
The CommonSpirit App is a simple, secure way to access recent health info. There are different CommonSpirit apps available depending on where you receive care. This version is for AR, GA, KY, TN, and parts of TX. For other regions, like CO, KS, or UT, look for “CommonSpirit – CO/KS/UT” in the App Store.
