bluejetty:00016570:ios.description:
Ignite your video content with Infuse – the beautiful way to watch almost any video format on your iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Mac, and Vision. No need to convert files! Infuse is optimized for iOS 27, with powerful streaming options, Trakt sync, and unmatched AirPlay & subtitle support. Gorgeous interface. Precise controls. And silky-smooth playback.
- PLAY MORE VIDEO TYPES
A powerful video player that plays just about anything, including MP4, MKV, M4V and MOV – plus many others. Includes support for HDR, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, plus Dolby and DTS audio.
- STREAM FROM OTHER DEVICES
Browse and play videos stored on your Mac, PC, NAS, Wi-Fi hard drive, apps like Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin, or from cloud services like Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, Box, pCloud, Yandex.Disk, MEGA, Aliyun Drive, and others – no syncing required!
- AIRPLAY & GOOGLE CAST OPTIONS
Stream a wide variety of videos types such as MKV, MP4, M4V, and others over AirPlay & Google Cast with full surround sound and subtitles.
- TRAKT 2-WAY SYNC
Connect with Trakt to sync watched history, submit ratings and post comments.
- OPTIMIZED SUBTITLES POWERED BY OPENSUBTITLES
Bring your own subtitles, or download them on the fly (for free) in virtually any language.

MORE THAN JUST A PRETTY FACE
THE BASICS
- Silky-smooth video player (plays full 4K w/ HDR & Dolby Vision)
- Stream from a Mac, PC, NAS or Wi-Fi enabled hard drive
- Connect with Plex, Emby, Jellyfin, Kodi (XBMC), WMC and other media servers
- Beautiful layout with quick access to video info
- Artwork and metadata added automatically
- Split View & PIP
- Spatial audio
SUPPORTED FORMATS
- Video: 33GP, AVI, AV1, ASF, BDMV, DIVX, DVDMEDIA, DVR-MS, FLV, H.264 (AVC), H.265 (HEVC), ISO/IMG, M4V, MKV, MOV, MP4, MPEG, MTS/M2TS, MXF, OGM, OGV, RMVB, TS, VC1, VIDEO_TS, VOB, VP9, WEBM, WMV, WTV
- Audio: AAC, AC3/E-AC3, DOLBY TRUEHD, DTS, DTS-HD MA, FLAC, MP3, OGG, PCM, WMA
- Subtitles: DVB, DVDSUB, MICRODVD, MPL2, PGS, SMI, SSA/ASS, SRT, SUB, SUP, TIMED TEXT, TXT, VOBSUB, VTT, XSUB
PLAYER FEATURES
- Multiple audio tracks
- Chapters
- Gesture controls
- 8 video zoom options
- Continuous playback
- TV out via HDMI or VGA adapter
- Deinterlacing
EXTRAS
- Folders
- One-click subtitle downloads from OpenSubtitles
- Scrobble plays to Trakt
- Download videos from networked devices
- Drag and drop uploads via web browser
- Get extra onboard storage with SanDisk iXpand and other USB drives
GET MORE WITH INFUSE PRO!

bluejetty:00160025:ios.description:
The Whisker app uses our proprietary WhiskerOS™ software to allow you to remotely monitor and control your WiFi-enabled Whisker device.
Use the Whisker app to monitor, control, and get insights from your Whisker devices—including Litter-Robot and Feeder-Robot—anytime, anywhere.
Works with Litter-Robot 3 Connect, Litter-Robot 4, Litter-Robot 5, Litter-Robot 5 Pro, Litter-Robot EVO, PetTag, and Feeder-Robot.
Litter-Robot features
- Real-time alerts: Know when a cycle starts, pauses, or the drawer needs emptying.
- Litter & waste status: See litter level and waste drawer status at a glance.
- Usage insights: Track trends that help you monitor your cat's routine.
- Remote controls: Adjust cycle delay time, lock the control panel, toggle night light, or schedule sleep mode.
- Multi-robot support: Set up and manage multiple units in one place.
Feeder-Robot features
- Flexible schedules: Create and edit feeding schedules from your phone.
- Snack on demand: Dispense a snack anytime, wherever you are.
- Low-food & issue alerts: Get notified when food is low or if the feeder needs attention.
- Feeding insights: View weekly and monthly trends.
Setup & requirements
- Camera permission for QR code onboarding.
- Wi-Fi: Visible, password-protected IPv4 network. All models support 2.4 GHz; 5 GHz is supported on select Pro models only. Use 2.4 GHz for all others.
- Location Services: Enable during onboarding to help the app find your Wi-Fi network.
Features may vary by device and model.

bluejetty:00033976:ios.description:
Discover the ultimate platform for buying and selling new and used forestry equipment. Whether you’re looking for feller bunchers, log processors, wood chippers, mulchers, tub grinders, sawmills, log splitters, stump grinders, or other logging machinery, ForestryTrader makes connecting with buyers and sellers in the forestry industry fast, easy, and secure.
EXPLORE THOUSANDS OF FORESTRY EQUIPMENT LISTINGS WITH PERSONALIZED SEARCH
Browse a wide array of listings for logging equipment, including tree harvesters, delimbers, and other essential forestry tools, from sawmills to log trucks. Find the perfect forestry machinery to meet your lumbering needs.
Once you’ve narrowed your search, view detailed photos and videos of your desired machinery and its specifications. Contact sellers directly to secure the best deal and explore financing options available through trusted partners, CurrencyFinance & FR8Star.
The ForestryTrader app features advanced search tools that allow you to filter listings by type, make, model, location, condition, cutting width, and other specifications. Save time with personalized search filters to find exactly what you need.
EASILY TRACK FORESTRY EQUIPMENT YOU ARE INTERESTED IN BUYING
Create a private Watch List to save your favorite equipment or post a “Want-to-Buy” ad to let sellers know what you’re searching for. Stay updated with new listings and personalized alerts via email while browsing category pages that are updated daily with fresh inventory.
CONSIGN YOUR INVENTORY FAST
Whether you’re a lumber equipment dealer or an independent seller, ForestryTrader connects you with thousands of qualified buyers actively searching for forestry machinery and accessories.
Consign your inventory with ForestryTrader to reach a global audience. Click the “My Inventory” button in your ForestryTrader app and get transferred to the Sandhills Inventory Management app, your trusted, easy, and cost-effective way to track and manage inventory. Add listings, set prices, upload photos and videos, edit descriptions, and update your listings on the go—right from your iOS device.
CHOOSE THE FORESTRYTRADER APP FOR ALL YOUR FORESTRY NEEDS
Whether you're upgrading your timber fleet or selling equipment, ForestryTrader connects you with a vast inventory of forestry machinery and tools and a large buyer audience.
As part of Sandhills Global, ForestryTrader links you to a network of trusted equipment marketplaces that includes but is not limited to Machinery Trader, TractorHouse, Truck Paper, TreeTrader, NeedTurfEquipment, and other marketplaces, catering to the agriculture, construction, forestry and other industries. Access listings from top manufacturers in the forestry sector, such as Bandit, Morbark, Vermeer, Ponse, Rayco, and Tigercat, with the ForestryTrader app today.
GET THE FORESTRYTRADER APP NOW
Thousands of dealers and forestry professionals trust ForestryTrader to manage their operations. Download the app today to find your next piece of forestry equipment or sell it with ease!

The App's enhanced features, improved functionality and int
bluejetty:00178408:ios.description:
The Land Rover Remote App keeps you in touch with your Land Rover when you're not in your vehicle, delivering greater control than ever before over security and comfort settings. 
The App's enhanced features, improved functionality and intuitive interface affords peace of mind, more efficient journey planning and greater well-being for you and your passengers.
Use the App to remotely:
- Prepare for a trip by checking fuel range and dashboard alerts
- Locate your vehicle on a map and get walking directions to it
- Check if doors or windows are open
- View journey information
- In the event of a breakdown, request Optimized Land Rover Assistance
- Plan future journeys and sync with your vehicle*
- Connect your favorite music and lifestyle applications to your InControl account for use in vehicle.*
For vehicles with InControl Remote Premium, the following additional features are available:
- Check on your vehicle security status and lock/unlock your vehicle if required
- Cool or heat your vehicle to the desired temperature prior to your journey* 
- Locate your vehicle in a crowded car park with 'beep and flash' functionality.
*Availability and function depending on vehicle capability, software and market.
Download the Land Rover InControl Remote App and then log in using your Land Rover InControl username and password to connect to your vehicle. This App requires subscription to one of the following packages fitted to the vehicle:
- InControl Protect
- InControl Remote
- InControl Remote Premium.
For further information, including which models Land Rover InControl is available on, visit www.landroverincontrol.com
For technical assistance, visit the owner's section of www.landrover.com.
IMPORTANT: ONLY JAGUAR/LAND ROVER OFFICIAL APPS MAY BE USED TO ACCESS YOUR VEHICLE OR ITS FUNCTIONS. Official Apps are recognizable as originating from "Jaguar Limited" or "Land Rover" or "JLR-Land Rover" or "JLR-Land Rover" or "Jaguar Land Rover Limited." Unofficial apps are not endorsed in any way by Jaguar Land Rover Limited. We have no control or responsibility over them. Use of unofficial apps may cause security risks or other harm to the vehicle and its functions. JLR will not be responsible under vehicle warranty or in any manner for any loss or damage you suffer resulting from the use of unofficial apps.
Note:
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

베스트셀러, 신간, 오디오북도 최다 보유
가입자 수 1위, 전 국민이 선택한 독서 플랫폼
독서와 무제한 친해지리, 밀리의서재
● 베스트셀러, 신간, 오디오북도 최다 보유
- 매월 1,000권 가량의 신간을 포함. 4,000권 이상 업데이트
- Top100 서점 베스트셀러 중 70% 보유
- 타사 대비 최대 3배 많은 베스트셀러 보유
● 인지도 1위, 오디오북도 역시 밀리의서재
- 압도적인 콘텐츠 수, 요약부터 완독까지 취향껏
- 30분 만에 핵심만 쏙! 부담 없이 듣는 요약 오디오북
- 듣는 순간 몰입되는 고퀄리티 완독 오디오북
- 오디오로 들으면서 전자책도 본다, 두 배로 효과적인 책이 보이는 오디오북
- 염혜란, 허성태 등 셀럽의 목소리 및 저자와 전문가의 해설로 더 이해하기 쉬운 오디오북
● 오직 밀리의서재에서만 즐길 수 있는 독서 콘텐츠
- 새로운 독서 경험 도슨트북, 도서를 읽어드리고 해설까지!
- 오브제북, 언제 어디서나 나만의 공간을 아름답게 채워주는, 새로운 영상형 책!
- 챗북, 대화형 각색으로 독서를 좀 더 쉽고 재미있게!
● 즐거운 독서, 밀리 투데이
- 생동감 있는 배너로 요즘 잘나가는 신간과 베스트셀러 트렌드 파악까지!
- 원하는 메뉴를 바로 찾아갈 수 있는 나만의 즐겨찾기
- 데이터를 기반으로 나에게 딱 맞는 책을 추천
- 팔로우한 서재의 다양한 소식을 한눈에!
● 밀리 완독지수로 아끼는 금쪽같은 시간
- 1,000만 회원의 빅데이터를 바탕으로 책을 완독할 확률 분석
- 도서의 완독률 및 시간을 바탕으로 취향 파악까지
● 작가가 되는 가장 빠른 길, 밀리로드
- 누구나 작가가 될 수 있는 자유로운 글쓰기 서비스
- 내가 추천한 작품이 베스트셀러가 되는 곳
● 새로운 독서 경험, 도슨트북
- 책, 읽어드리고 해설까지!
- 15분 만에 세 번 읽은 것처럼, 도슨트의 해설로 책에 깊이 빠지는 경험
● 우리 집 거실과 내 방을 북카페로! 오브제북
- 언제 어디서나 나만의 공간을 아름답게 채워주는, 새로운 영상형 책
- 책의 분위기를 극대화 해주는 이미지와 사운드!
● 서비스 접근 권한 안내
※선택 접근 권한
- 카메라, 사진 : 프로필 사진 변경, 포스트 작성 시 멀티미디어 파일 업로드 등에 사용
- 알림 : 앱 푸시 알림 전송에 사용
*선택 접근 권한에 동의하지 않아도 서비스 이용이 가능하며, 단 선택 권한 미동의 시 서비스 일부 기능의 정상적인 이용이 어려울 수 있습니다.
*기종 별로 접근 권한 항목 및 용어가 상이 할 수 있습니다.
● 문의사항

bluejetty:00082343:ios.description:
Want to solve the problem of excessive phone memory? Let CleanKoala help you!
►Mobile Memory Suggestion: Want to know how your phone's memory is doing? Just scan your phone's memory situation, and we will conduct a specific analysis and suggest actions for your phone's memory situation. Our suggestions will also vary depending on the phone's memory situation! Can greatly reduce phone memory troubles!
►Clean Koala intelligent function: Click on the Clean Koala cartoon doll, and we will provide you with different product functions! You can use the CleanKoala cartoon doll to achieve different functions: phone memory cleaning, phone health check, function navigation, and in future versions, we will continue to introduce more interesting and practical features, which can only be experienced in CleanKoala!
►Clean up duplicate photos: Have CleanKoala scan your photo library and tell you how many duplicate photos are taking up your memory! You can delete or keep these photos, and CleanKoala can help you achieve it!
►Video management: Is there too much video in the phone? CleanKoala is here to help you! You can batch select the videos you want to delete, or enter the operation page to decide whether to delete or keep the videos by sliding left or right. Two operation methods are designed to help you better clean up your phone's memory
►Similar photo cleaning: There are many photos with similar elements in the phone, such as taking several poses under a background, but leaving them all is too wasteful of memory? We will categorize similar photo groups for you, and you can choose to keep the best results or keep all of them, allowing you to experience the fun of managing photos and reviewing the past!
►Private Album: Concerned about sensitive photos? CleanKoala provides a Private Album feature that allows you to store your private photos securely. Keep your personal moments safe and accessible only to you!
►More features: CleanKoala aims to provide users with a convenient and enjoyable product experience, and we will continue to launch more practical and interesting features in the future!
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NEo767jnQFxDfr4PnyreOlb7NhicTAIbbqKqL92QtMo/edit?usp=sharing
Terms of Use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/19IJ-qcSp8C4Nqn5mSG50GByygQJeISSmUSJU9VpLWAU/edit?usp=sharing

bluejetty:00027221:ios.name: RadarAll Speed Camera Detector
bluejetty:00027221:ios.summary:
Enjoy driving with the best navigator, speed camera detector and real-time traffic information. Forget about fines and drive with peace of mind.
MAIN FEATURES
- 100% legal speed camera detector
- Turn by turn GPS navigation, with lane guid
bluejetty:00027221:ios.description:
Enjoy driving with the best navigator, speed camera detector and real-time traffic information. Forget about fines and drive with peace of mind.
MAIN FEATURES
- 100% legal speed camera detector
- Turn by turn GPS navigation, with lane guidance, spoken instructions, speed limits, and the speed camera detector fully integrated into the navigation
- Automatic route recorder. Shows the total distance and time spent traveling the route, speed at each point and speed cameras you passed. Check the speed you were having when passing speed cameras or anywhere
- Route planner. Create routes in advance to check their speed limits and the speed cameras you will find in them
- Real-time traffic information
- No user account or registration, just open the app and that's it
THE BEST SPEED CAMERA DETECTOR:
- CarPlay
- Warnings only in the direction you are moving
- Mean speed in section speed cameras
- Options to silence the warnings if your speed is OK
- Manual or automatic (depending on your speed) warning distance 
- Automatic speed camera updates
- Voice, sound and vibration warnings, also in your Apple Watch
- Map with real time traffic or view with no map, only with the speedometer
- Sound mixed with what you're listening to on your iPhone, through your car's hands-free kit or iPhone speakers
- Works in the foreground or background (use it alongside other apps)
- Fully configurable, portrait and landscape mode, night mode
- Coverage in most countries, download the app and check the coverage in your area in the map
NAVIGATION:
- Turn by turn navigation integrated with speed camera warnings and traffic map. All in the same screen, no need to use several apps
- Warnings of only the speed cameras with are in your route (configurable). Avoid false positives from nearby roads
- Speed limits when navigating
- Indications of the lanes to follow when changing direction
- Spoken instructions together with speed camera warnings
ROUTES
- Automatic route recorder. Shows the total distance and time spent on the route, speed at each point and speed cameras you passed. Check the speed you were going when passing speed cameras or at any location
- You can configure for how many days the routes will be saved and the minimum distance and duration to save them or disable this function. This data is saved on your device and is not sent anywhere
- Route planner. Create routes in advance to see their speed limits and the speed cameras you will encounter taking into account the direction in which you will pass them
- Launch navigation from a recording or a planned route. The best option at that time will be calculated taking into account the intermediate stops on the route
- TRAFFIC MAP:
- Map with traffic information
- As soon as you open the app, the map is centered in your location and traffic information is shown
- You can keep the map centered in a different location from your current one to watch the traffic in a specific area
APP FOR APPLE WATCH:
- If you open the app on your Watch, it will vibrate with each alert, it works in foreground and background
- Navigation instructions, including lanes to follow
- Launch the detector from the Watch keeping your iPhone in your pocket
IMPORTANT:
- The speed camera detector and navigation use the GPS continuously. Using it in the foreground or background can drain the battery quickly.
- To use the speed camera detector and navigation you need a GPS device: all iPhones have it. iPads with 3G have it but not WiFi ones.
- SCDB provides the speed camera data base.
Terms and Conditions: http://www.littlemousesoftware.com/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: http://www.littlemousesoftware.com/radar-all-privacy

- CarPlay

- Options to silence the warnings if your speed is OK
- Manual or automatic (depending on your speed) warning distance 
- Automatic speed camera updates
- Voice, sound and vibration warnings, also in your Apple Watch

- Sound mixed with what you're listening to on your iPhone, through your car's hands-free kit or iPhone speakers

From above the water to beneath it!
All about fishing! Ace Fishing: Crew!
Fishing knows no bounds in the virtual world.
Embark on an adventure towards the horizon with Ace Fishing: Crew, where you can encounter lifelike fish!
1. Dive into the full fishing experience from surface to seabed within the game!
- Explore diverse regions and encounter various fish species from around the world with realistic 3D graphics.
- Set your sights on catching the fish that inhabit each region. Best of luck in your fishing endeavors!
2. Immerse yourself in the thrilling sensation of real fishing with intuitive controls and specialized haptic feedback!
- Experience the authentic essence of fishing on mobile devices with finely-tuned controls, from casting to maneuvering based on the fish's movements.
- Enhanced vibration feedback intensifies the sensation of the catch.
3. Engage in guild activities with fellow members.

- Collaborate to devise winning strategies and become the most formidable guild.

- Join fishing tournaments and compete against players worldwide using automated controls to showcase your fishing skills.
- Keep an eye on real-time rankings and strive for higher rewards by climbing the leaderboard!
5. Discover the most effective crew member combinations to dominate the stages.
- Experiment with diverse crew members possessing different skills to conquer various regions efficiently!
- Strategy effectiveness varies depending on saltwater/freshwater environments and fish/crew member types.
- Utilize various crew skills to add complexity to your fishing experience,
aiming for big damage or engaging in strategic battles with skills like Stun/Recovery!
6. Prepare delicious dishes using the fish you catch!
- Conduct food research with the fish you catch and increase your research level!
- Providing the crew members with the dishes you make upon departure sets the stage for advantageous battles.

bluejetty:00159825:ios.description:
Bubble Glint：a glowing world of bubbles！
Game Overview
Welcome to Bubble Glint!Step into a heartwarming forest world where bubbles shine, dreams float, and every pop brings joy and surprise.Each shot feels like a dream filled with innocence and delight—and your skill and luck can bring real cash rewards that sparkle with every win.
Core Gameplay
At its heart, Bubble Glint features the classic Bubble Shooter gameplay. Tap to aim, shoot, and match bubbles of the same color to make them pop. The crisp sound and vivid animations turn every pop into pure satisfaction. Relax into the smooth rhythm, enjoy each precise shot, and experience the joy and accomplishment of clearing the board.
Art Style
Bubble Glint embraces a soft, fairy-tale forest aesthetic. Sunlight filters through the trees, a charming house sits among flowers, and the little girl plays in the garden surrounded by floating bubbles. The peaceful forest and bright colors create a gentle, heartwarming contrast. Every scene feels like a delicate storybook painting, glowing with calm and comfort.
Game Value
In Bubble Glint, you’ll find both relaxation and delight in every game. The fun of bubble shooting pairs perfectly with the excitement of real cash rewards. More than just a casual game, it’s a moment of peace wrapped in joy. Watch the bubbles rise, unwind your mind, and let the fairy-tale warmth fill your heart with happiness.

We all like to play Solitaire for free.

We are very excited to for you to use our new concept of a Solitaire ga
bluejetty:00124088:ios.description:
We all like to play Solitaire for free.
We got sick and tired of all the versions of Solitaire out there with Advertisements every second, or every new Solitaire deal.
We are very excited to for you to use our new concept of a Solitaire game which lets you play good old fashioned Solitaire without all those clutter-some pop-up ads and full-screen take-over advertisements.
You can even track your score by the number of moves it takes to win a game and view all your winning games in the scoreboard. Share on with your friends to see who can get the best score!
Customize your Solitaire settings to enable things like:
- Vegas Mode (draws three cards instead of one)
- Customize the Card Table color and App Theme (choose any color in our picker, see it everywhere in the app)
- Reset the colors all back to default
- Right handed mode, move the Deck over to the right side.
- Support for iOS13
- Dark Mode Support
- NEW! Undo Feature In App Purchase
We have an in-app rating widget to make super easy to give us a rating or even full review of our app! Let us know what you think!
Thanks for using our app, please contact our team if you have any feedback or requests for new features! You can also reach out if you want new colors for the app! 
Who can get the lowest score?

The diverse mod
bluejetty:00149994:ios.description:
Balto is an app that allows event organizers to quickly and easily create a personalized app for their participants.
With around twenty configurable modules, Balto offers an accessible alternative to custom-built solutions.
The diverse module library enables the integration of all relevant information for participants directly on the platform, while giving organizers full control over the data. Among the available modules, you’ll find:
- Schedules
- Sports results and rankings
- Menus (food & beverages)
- Partners
- Maps
- Venue layouts
- External links (streaming, forms, resources)
- And much more
In addition to these modules, Balto allows you to send personalized notifications to participants, set up access zones with scanners, and manage module access rights for each participant in real-time.
Having your event on Balto means offering an enhanced experience for all your participants.

bluejetty:00146701:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00146701:ios.description:
Aplicativo DGT Administradora 
Tanto pelo site da DGT quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com a DGT, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente. Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para dgt@winker.com.br

bluejetty:00023795:ios.description:
NEW GAME: Feed the School! Chili Chaos is available NOW! The pranks continue in the cafeteria. Same teachers, same chaos, NEW location! Check it out on the App Store today.
BASH THE TEACHER:
It's time to show the teacher whose the boss of the classroom in this funny school prankster game!
Easy to play: Just tap the teacher, desk or pet.
Discover the teachers reactions and earn upgrades in this hilarious idle clicker school prankster game!
Choose a weapon - will it be a paper airplane, rotten egg, water balloon or catapult? Then take aim and fire! Keep bashing the scary teacher with your selected weapon until you discover all of their funny reactions!
Earn stars for all your pranking and use them to pimp the school classroom - upgrade the classroom desk, buy the teacher new pets, and then bash them with your chosen weapon too!
Prank the teacher and watch as their frustration grows! Disturbing these teachers will lead to some very funny reactions, tantrums and meltdowns! Keep pranking the school teacher until they can take it no more! Will they quit their job? Who will replace them? When a new scary teacher steps in take aim and fire, the pranking fun begins again!
---- UPGRADES ----
36 Weapons:
Upgrade your weapons for increased prankster fun. Use Paper airplanes, rotten eggs, water balloons, catapults and more to prank the teacher.
36 School Desk Items:
Upgrade the teacher’s school desk items and bash them too! Extra desk items for your classroom include a cactus, gong, computer and robot!
36 Teacher’s Pets:
Upgrade the teacher’s pets with funny new animals! Pets to discover include a snake, crab, elephant and octopus!
---- UNLOCK NEW TEACHERS ----
Unlock and prank 15 very funny and scary school teachers. Discover all of their funny and crazy reactions - will they be bothered by aliens, snatched by giant tentacles or dance with cute penguins! Each of the scary school teachers have 12 funny reactions waiting to be discovered!
15 teachers to prank - including:
* Miss Thunderface: Do not disturb this scary teacher unless you are prepared for her thunderous temper tantrums!
* Sergeant Jughead: This scary teacher is ex-military, pranking him is risky business!
* Professor Bumfluff: Tormenting this genius science teacher could lead to a mini meltdown!
* Madame Pudding: Pranking this soft and cuddly teacher may seem cruel - but a prankster must show no mercy!
* The Headmaster: Bashing the headmaster runs the risk of a long spell in detention!
* Dr Trundle: He’s old, he’s mean, he’s fair game!
* Tutor-Bot 3000: Be careful - this futuristic robot teacher is ready to blow a fuse!
* Coach Feeblebones: This wimpy school sports coach is ready for a workout!
* Primitive Pam: A teacher so primitive she still lives in a cave!
* Miss Chimneypot: Handle with care - this teacher is a walking fire hazard!
* Mr Nerdburger: This nerdy teacher is a walking target!
* Monsieur Bristle: Get ready to trigger this art teacher's artistic temperament!
* Nurse Mangler: This school nurse is a classified health hazard!
In this idle clicker school prankster game you will discover loads of mind bending and funny pranks - including deadly traps, dinosaur attacks, stomping feet, magic potions, vortexes and exploding cakes!
---- FEATURES ----
+ Simple to play: Just tap the teacher, desk or pet in this hilarious idle clicker school game!
+ Loads of funny and creative teacher reactions, tantrums and meltdowns to discover!
+ Upgrade your weapons, school desk and teacher’s pets for loads of prankster fun!
+ Tap away to blast the scary teacher and school classroom with your weapons!
+ 15 scary teachers waiting to be discovered - and tormented!
+ Super cute cartoon images with funny sound effects!

bluejetty:00167420:ios.description:
Welcome to Magic School!
You have been appointed as the principal of Magic School!
You must run the school to make it the world's best prestigious magic school!
In this tycoon game, you can grow a cute yet dreamy and mysterious magic school!
- Cute cat students are enrolling to become wizards! You can observe the school life of these cute cats!
- You can turn a small magic school into a world-renowned magic school!
- There are classrooms that teach various magic! What amazing magic awaits?
- Cat Magic School features mysterious yet cute graphics!
- This game is full of dreamy yet relaxing sounds, so you can enjoy it anytime, anywhere~
- "Cat Magic School" is easy for everyone to play! As an idle offline game, the school continues to operate even when you step away for a while!
Running this vast magic school can sometimes present unavoidable challenges.
If the queue is too long and students can't attend classes, try shortening the class duration.
If students are struggling to pass difficult classes, consider hiring excellent teachers.
As the school expands, build classrooms, dormitories, and dining halls to meet the needs of students.
Who knows! There might be exciting adventures awaiting, or secret spaces hidden within the school! Be sure to check it out at Magic School!
Also, run the Cat Snack Bar to provide delicious snacks to students and research various recipes.
The Cat Snack Bar can be an important source of revenue for the school.
Develop special soup recipes and serve them to cat customers!
Different soups will be popular with students.
This game is for:
- Cat owners!
- Those who love cat games and magic!
- People interested in managing and growing a magic school!

bluejetty:00091946:ios.summary:
Welcome to a new era of convenience. Duffl delivers snacks, drinks, and household goods in college communities in 10 minutes. 
Dying for a bag of chips? Maybe an impromptu Yerba Mate? How about that NyQuil when you just don’t want to leave
bluejetty:00091946:ios.description:
Welcome to a new era of convenience. Duffl delivers snacks, drinks, and household goods in college communities in 10 minutes. 
Dying for a bag of chips? Maybe an impromptu Yerba Mate? How about that NyQuil when you just don’t want to leave? Duffl is the world’s most convenient store, and we’ve got your back. Order through the app, dance for 10 minutes, and a fellow student will drop your bag at your door.
You can shop at Duffl and support your community at:
UCLA
USC
UC Berkeley
University of Alabama
Florida State University
University of Central Florida
Boise State University
More coming soon!
What does Duffl sell?
Anything a successful college student might need: snacks, chips, ice cream, fruit, toilet paper, notebooks, toothpaste, and much more. We carry some awesome new brands like Dream Pops, Milk Bar, Guyaki, Simulate Nuggs, Oatly, Snaklins, and others you might not have heard of yet. We promise we also carry all your favorite brands too! We’ve got Takis, Cheetos, Ben & Jerry’s, M&Ms, Celcius, Amy’s, Tide, DayQuil, and so many more for you to choose from. 
How much does Duffl cost?
No hidden fees, no surge pricing, no price-gouging. Our small delivery fee helps us offer a competitive wage to our student workforce, and helps us invest more into empowering the community.
Get free Duffl cash!
After you place your first order, we’ll send you a custom discount code that you can share with your friends. When they use your discount code at checkout, they’ll get $5 off their first two orders and we’ll drop $10 Duffl Cash into your account, it’s our way of saying “you’re amazing!”
Discounts & Promos?!
If you’re a top customer, we’ll add you to our “Thank You Thursday” list where we say thank you by texting you cool promos and big discounts. There’s no limit to how many times you can be on the list, so try to be a top customer every week!
Get involved with Duffl!
We’re hiring students for roles in every community: Admirals to manage and grow the campus store; Captains to pick, pack, and batch our bags; Racers to deliver bags via electric scooters; Supply Sergeants to help keep our store organized; Content Cadets to run the community Instagram page; Squad Members to help us with marketing activations in each community; and Social Media Special Ops to help promote Duffl on Instagram and TikTok. Do any of these sound like a good fit for you? Please apply today! Learn more at jobs.duffl.com.

bluejetty:00168006:ios.description:
Classic Spider Solitaire Relax is a classic card game that allows you to completely unwind and relax! This free card game is carefully designed with various special features that cater to your preferences, whether you're playing on an iPhone or an iPad: landscape/portrait mode, left-handed/right-handed options, quick assistance for card placement, unlimited shuffling when you're stuck, eye-friendly and clear card designs, and much more! Classic Spider Solitaire Relax is dedicated to creating the most relaxing and immersive experience for classic card game enthusiasts.
Classic Spider Solitaire Relax app aims to free you from the hustle and bustle of work or daily life by offering a fresh interpretation of the classic card game. It provides you with a chance to spend some time for yourself, find inner calmness, embrace relaxation, and enjoy personal fulfillment during the card game.
Whether you call it Spider, Spiderette or Spiderwort,, it is an addictive classic card game for all true card game enthusiasts. Apart from stress relief and mood relaxation, Classic Solitaire also helps improve hand-eye coordination, enhance focus, and keep your mind sharp and active!
— Features —
· Customizable Features: Landscape/portrait mode, left-handed/right-handed options, support for both iphone and ipad, no Wi-Fi required, and more convenience!
· Winning Assistance: Adjust difficulty with 1-4 suit games, unlimited intelligent hints and undo, and more relaxing!
· Visual Design: Sleek and elegant interface, clear card designs, large font and eye-friendly theme, diverse backgrounds, and more beautiful!
· Special Gameplay: Daily challenges, daily goals, ranks and titles, limited-time events to collect badges, and more challenges!
— How to Play —
For those who are new to the classic card game:
Playing Spider Solitaire is both easy and enjoyable! Place all the cards in each suit in stacks of descending order. Weave your way as a beginner through 1 and 2 suit games and move up in difficulty as you attempt to tackle 3 and 4 suit games and become a true Spider Solitaire master!
Otium, our team, is dedicated to developing classic and innovative games that bring joy and a sense of personal achievement. "Otium" signifies leisure, relaxation, and tranquility. Attaining a state of leisure through casual gaming is a breakthrough in meeting the demands of daily life. Stay tuned for more upcoming Otium Games!
Join the ranks of millions of card game enthusiasts and embark on a nostalgic journey with Spider Solitaire! Download this free classic card game, Classic Spider Solitaire Relax, on iOS now and indulge in a highly anticipated leisure experience!
You can read our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service at the following locations:
http://ios.classic.solitaire.services/solitaire-privacy.html

Foodie Sizzle – Master the Art of Grilling in a Sizzling Match-3 Adventure! 
Step into the vibrant world of Skewer Sort, where you become the ultimate grill master, crafting mouthwatering skewers in a thrilling match-3 puzzle experience! Strategically arrange juicy meats, fresh seafood, and colorful veggies to create perfect combos and serve up delicious delights.

- Match & Grill: Swap and align three identical skewers to clear them from the grill. 
- Plan Wisely: Use limited moves to complete each level’s unique challenges. 
- Boost Your Skills: Unleash powerful tools like flame boosters and grill flips to overcome tricky obstacles!

Diverse Ingredients: From tender chicken to exotic seafood, every skewer is a feast for the eyes! 
Exciting Challenges: Race against moves, beat tricky layouts, and master special elimination mechanics. 
Power-Ups & Strategy: Think fast, grill smarter—use boosters to turn up the heat when the stakes are high! 
Whether you're a puzzle pro or a grilling newbie, Foodie Sizzle offers a fresh, flavorful twist on match-3 fun. Can you handle the heat and become the ultimate skewer champion? Let the grilling begin!

Cha
bluejetty:00060995:ios.description:
ChallengeRunner Fitness Challenge Logging provides a lightweight interface to the ChallengeRunner employee health challenge platform. This application gives participants access to the fitness challenges they are currently enrolled in. 
ChallengeRunner Fitness Challenge Logging allows participants to view and submit health challenge data and review the challenge leaderboard. 
This application features a simple challenge data logging interface, real-time leaderboards, messaging and comments. Participants may join challenges using links, QR Codes, or challenge codes provided by a Challenge Administrator.
It is now possible for ChallengeRunner to pull steps, active minutes, distance and calories from the Apple Health app. To turn on this functionality, enable the Health Integration switch in Settings and accept the HealthKit privileges when prompted in the ChallengeRunner app. With HealthKit enabled, ChallengeRunner will sync with the Health app whenever the ChallengeRunner app is opened.
NOTE: Most functions require an Internet connection

bluejetty:00178661:ios.description:

• Customize Your Avatar: Create the perfect version of yourself with our extensive customization options. Choose your look and style from a wide range of outfits to express your unique personality.
• Forge Relationships: Interact with intriguing characters who will become your allies, rivals or even your soulmate. Will you play the game of love with a flirtatious twist or are you searching for something deeper and more meaningful?

Flirt with celebrities, become famous, and find your perfect match in Matchmaker! In an unexpected turn of events, you've ended up on a famous reality show. With contestants including a bad-boy singer, a famous Hollywood actor, and your model ex, things are about to get interesting! Are you going to be a flirt that wraps everyone around her finger to win the show, or are you looking for true love? Are you a good girl or a scandal queen? YOU choose what you want to do!
In Billionaire's Darling, you are a normal college girl until you meet billionaire Henry Lockwood. You get an offer to be his fake girlfriend… an offer that sounds too good to be true. Henry is a complicated man and his family is full of secrets… Can you find out the truth? Are his feelings for you real, or is it all just for show? Take part in high society, wear expensive outfits, experience thrilling moments and uncover mysteries, all in one story!
Your new boss is arrogant, but incredibly handsome and charming. How long until the sparks start flying? Find out in Office Affair! Can you keep things professional? Are you going to focus on your law career, or on your gorgeous boss? Or maybe it's your kind-hearted client who caught your eye instead? It's your choice! Be a lawyer superstar, fight for justice, help people, and maybe even find your happy ending! 
But that's just the beginning! With Tabou Stories, new adventures await around every corner. Whether you're seeking swoon-worthy encounters, heart-pounding romance, or thrilling mysteries, there's a story for everyone.

bluejetty:00064731:ios.summary:
The CFCU mobile app allows you 24/7 access to deposit checks remotely from your iPhone or iPad, check account balances, view account history, transfer funds between your accounts or to another CFCU member* and locate branches or ATMs.
You
bluejetty:00064731:ios.description:
The CFCU mobile app allows you 24/7 access to deposit checks remotely from your iPhone or iPad, check account balances, view account history, transfer funds between your accounts or to another CFCU member* and locate branches or ATMs.
You can even manage multiple memberships/accounts that you have with CFCU. Mobile banking is free** with your CFCU membership and completely safe. We use the latest technology to ensure all transactions are private and secure. Once you’ve downloaded CFCU’s mobile banking app, simply enroll and login with your credentials.
Main features include:
Transfers and Loan Payments – Easily and quickly move funds in real-time to and from your CFCU accounts and loans.
View Account Balances and Available Balances – All amounts are quickly displayed in real-time and are easy to read. You can also access transaction details.
Find Us – Locate a CFCU branch or ATM using your GPS enabled locator. It also includes dynamic mapping.
Bill Pay – Allows you to pay bills through your phone or tablet app. Mobile bill pay is integrated with online bill pay so that your information is consistent across platforms.
SMS Text Banking – Allows you to send commands to our short-code and receive real time balance, history and account information via text message.
SMS Text Alerts – Can be either transaction based or personal messages. You even have the ability to set usage alerts where you set the dollar amount thresholds.
Remote Deposit - Allows you to take a picture of your check and securely deposit it to your CFCU account.
*Before making member to member transfers, authorization documentation must be completed.
**Your mobile carrier may assess text messaging and/or web access charges.

bluejetty:00155783:ios.description:
The AVENIR mobile app is designed to enhance your experience at our reformer Pilates studio. With a focus on athletic Pilates, we offer a range of services including group classes, private training, special workshops and events, and teacher training.
Through our mobile app, you can easily browse and book group classes that suit your schedule and preferences. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced practitioner, our classes cater to all levels of fitness and provide a challenging yet supportive environment.
For those seeking personalized attention, our app allows you to schedule private training sessions with our experienced instructors. These one-on-one sessions are tailored to your specific goals and needs, ensuring maximum effectiveness and progress.
Stay updated on our upcoming workshops and events through the app's event calendar. From specialized workshops focusing on specific pilates techniques to exciting events that
promote a sense of community, you'll have access to a variety of opportunities to deepen your practice and connect with fellow enthusiasts.
If you're interested in becoming a Pilates instructor yourself, our app provides information about our teacher training programs. Discover the comprehensive curriculum, requirements, and application process to kickstart your journey towards becoming a certified Pilates teacher.
With the AVENIR mobile app, you can easily manage your bookings, track your progress, and stay connected with our studio community. We are committed to providing you with a seamless and convenient experience, empowering you to achieve your fitness goals through the power of Pilates.

bluejetty:00166689:ios.description:
Transform Communication with Your Dog!
Introducing Dog Talk & Whistle Games — an interactive app designed for fun and engaging interaction with your beloved pet.
Exclusive to iOS, this app offers a variety of entertaining features that help strengthen the bond between you and your dog.
Features:
— Barks & Sound Effects: Play a wide range of dog sounds to express emotions and engage with your pet.
— Dog Training Whistle: Adjustable frequency lets you find the perfect tone to grab your dog’s attention. Ideal for training sessions — from basic obedience to advanced tricks.
— Interactive Games: Fun touch-based games that stimulate your dog’s mind and body; perfect for keeping your pet busy on rainy days or during cozy evenings at home.
— Entertaining “Translator”: Simulates “translations” of dog sounds into funny human phrases — adding humor to your interactions. For entertainment purposes only (see disclaimer below).
Benefits:
— Enhance training sessions with a customizable whistle.
— Provide your dog with mental stimulation and lots of fun.
— A great way to have fun and share hilarious moments with friends.
Download today and take the first step toward a warmer, more connected relationship with your pet!
DISCLAIMER
— The “Dog Language Translator” feature is intended for entertainment purposes only and does not perform real translation of sounds, barking, or any other forms of animal communication.
— All results displayed in the app are humorous interpretations created using pre-recorded phrases, audio clips, and algorithms that have no scientific basis.
— The developers do not claim or imply that the app can understand, recognize, or interpret actual emotions, intentions, or behaviors of dogs. Any similarity between an animal’s behavior and the “translations” shown in the app is purely coincidental and does not reflect real communication.
— By using the app, you acknowledge that all displayed results and phrases should be taken as a joke and not used for making decisions related to pet care, training, or treatment. The app does not replace consultation with veterinarians, dog trainers, behaviorists, or other animal specialists.
— The developers are not responsible for any misunderstanding, stress, or discomfort your pet may experience during app use. It is recommended to use the features in a calm, safe, and friendly environment to avoid frightening your pet.
— Please treat your furry friend with care and respect. Remember that real emotions and behaviors cannot be conveyed through a mobile app. This app is designed to make pet owners smile, add a bit of humor, and make communication with pets even warmer and more joyful.
— By using the app, you confirm that you understand its entertainment nature and agree to all terms stated above.
Terms of Use: https://sdmagroop.eu/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://sdmagroop.eu/privacy.html

bluejetty:00161107:ios.name: SportsPlus
bluejetty:00161107:ios.summary: SportsPlus is a modern and feature-rich sports management software platform for clubs, leagues, schools, governing bodies, tournament operators, recreational departments, sports facilities, teams, admins, staff members, coaches, officials,
bluejetty:00161107:ios.description:
SportsPlus is a modern and feature-rich sports management software platform for clubs, leagues, schools, governing bodies, tournament operators, recreational departments, sports facilities, teams, admins, staff members, coaches, officials, players, and parents. SportsPlus is a mobile-friendly, secure, all-in-one sports platform that allows staff members to handle the registrations, payments, scheduling, team rostering, leagues, tournaments, facility booking, communication, fundraising, tickets, loan items, members, volunteer signup, tryout management, live-scoring, surveys, and the website.
The SportsPlus mobile app is fully integrated with the SportsPlus platform. The mobile app helps the staff with team communication, scheduling, roster management, tryout evaluations, team evaluations, live-scoring, check-in, volunteer management, fundraiser, and facility management. In addition, the mobile app helps players and parents with RSVP, access schedules, managing family members, registration, facility booking, communication, etc.
SportsPlus mobile app helps staff members with, 
 Facility Booking: Open facilities for booking and collect payments online. 
 Team Roster: Manage team rosters and provide access to player details. 
 Team Schedule: Create and manage games, practices, and events with reminders and instant notifications. 
 Availability, RSVP: Updating player's availability. Track, reset, and notify team members. 
 Attendance: Update and manage the attendance of each player for the schedules. 
 Game Lineup: Set up and provide access to the game lineup for the upcoming games. 
 Injury Management: Manage player availability based on the injury status. 
 Team Chat: Communicate with team members in real-time. 
 Team Messaging: Send messages (Email, SMS, Mobile notifications, Online messages) to team members. 
 Task Management: Add tasks and allow team members to volunteer and sign up. Assign tasks to members along with hours. 
 Team Evaluations: Evaluate team players and send reports. Post feedback. 
 Check-in: Allow participants to either self-check-in or check-in with a staff member for facility bookings and lessons. 
 Tickets & Loan Items: Set up game and event tickets. Manage loan items. 
 Resources, Announcements: Upload and share resources, including documents, pictures, and videos. Post announcements. 
 Game Results: If allowed, Update the game score, standings, game recap, and most valuable player. 
 Team Request: Approve or deny the requests to join a team. 
 Admin Controls: Configure accessibility, security, and privacy options. 
 Organization Schedules: Access and manage all the organization's teams and the upcoming game, practice, and event schedules. 
 Customize home screen content..
 Access and manage team attendance, announcements, and resources.
 Tryout Management: Manage and evaluate players. Generate evaluation reports. Place players into teams.
 Live-Scoring: Start the game and record the scores. Optionally record player scores.
 SportsPlus mobile app helps players and parents with,
 Schedules, RSVP: Access team schedules and update the game, practice, or event availability.
 Subscribe to the schedules on their calendar and access the member card.
 Attendance: Access the attendance of the schedule based on past availability.
 Team Chat: Chat with team members in real-time. Share scores, pictures, and messages.
 Team Messaging: Send messages (Email, SMS, Mobile notifications) to the team members.
 Team Roster: Access team member details as permitted by staff.
 Game Lineup: Access the game lineup of the upcoming games.
 Task Management: Sign up for the tasks. Receive reminders.
 Pictures: Upload and share pictures securely and conditionally.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00070702:ios.summary: Embrace the freedom of being a street racer in the dynamic open world of CarX Street. Accept the challenge and become the legend of Sunset City. Realistic races on highways and city streets, plus top-speed drift races from the makers of Car
bluejetty:00070702:ios.description:
Embrace the freedom of being a street racer in the dynamic open world of CarX Street. Accept the challenge and become the legend of Sunset City. Realistic races on highways and city streets, plus top-speed drift races from the makers of CarX Drift Racing 2.
Build the car of your dreams using part tuning that unlocks all the physics of CarX Technology car behavior.
Explore every corner - the enormous world of CarX Street and the exciting car races will leave you exhilarated! Conquer clubs, hit top speed, and drift!
WARNING! You may spend hours playing this game. Make sure to take a break every 40 minutes.
GAME FEATURES
CAREER
- Drive at top speed or drift through turns. The choice is yours!
- Join clubs, defeat bosses, and prove to everyone that you're the best driver in this city!
- Pick out parts for your vehicle and unlock 100% of its potential!
- Buy houses for your cars and assemble collections for every race mode.
- Fuel up with the right gas for the next race at city gas stations.
- Dynamic day/night change. Get behind the wheel at any time of night or day.
REAL-TIME MULTIPLAYER
- Compete with real people in online battles.
- Be first and win all the races in Sunset City.
- Drift down narrow streets or speed highways and discover new performance edges of your car.
IMPROVED CAR TUNING
- A detailed car-building system.
- Swap parts and trick out your car for a specific race.
- Upgrade the engine, transmission, body, suspension, and tires.
- Swap the engine of your unique car.
VISUAL CAR TUNING
- Customize the mirrors, headlights, lights, skirt, bumper, rims, and much more!
- Create a unique look for your car!
THE MOST REALISTIC MOBILE RACING GAME
- Check out the impressive physics and controls that make you the master of your car.
- Admire the modern, high-quality graphics and enormous open world.
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION:
Users with a Premium Account get a range of bonuses and unique privileges:
- 10,000 silver every day
- 2 gold every day
- 3 sets of tires every day
- 50% off on teleporting anywhere in Sunset City
- x2 rewards in Single Races, Delivery quests, and collected Gift Boxes
- -30% time on the timer in Elite Races and Delivery quests
- Free creation of online rooms
- Unique nickname frame in online mode and in profile window
- Unlimited attempts in Elite Races and leaderboards
- Removes level restrictions on cars and parts
Get your Premium Subscription for 7 days, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months. You can cancel auto renewal of your subscription by going to your iTunes account not later than 24 hours before the next billing period.
Your Premium Subscription will be renewed within 24 hours upon expiration of the current Premium Subscription.
Support service
If you find any bugs in the game, please contact our support service.
Email: support@carx-tech.com
DEVICE REQUIREMENTS
This app requires a device with at least 3 GB of memory. You must be connected to the internet for stable gameplay!

bluejetty:00070329:ios.description:
The Bosch Levelling Remote app enables you to conveniently control your Bosch Professional levelling tool via Bluetooth® from your smartphone. Using the app, you can control the laser remotely without having to even touch it, thereby increasing productivity and efficiency in your daily levelling tasks.
The app can be connected to all Bosch Professional levelling tools (line lasers, combi lasers and rotary lasers) which contain a "C" in the name, for example: 
• GCL 2-50 C/CG Professional
• GCL100-80C/CG Professional
• GLL 3-80 C/CG Professional
• GLL3-330C/CG Professional
• GRL 600 CHV Professional
• GRL 650 CHVG Professional
• GRL4000-80CHV Professional
• GRL4000-80CH Professional
• GRL4000-90CHVG Professional
• GLL330-80CG Professional
• GLL 18V-120-33 CG Professional
Main functions when using a GCL or GLL device:
• Conveniently control your combi / line laser by setting the operating mode, turning your tool into standby or changing the laser intensity to optimize the laser visibility or battery runtime. 
• Monitor your tool by checking the battery and device status via the app. 
• Check for potential external influences and calibration intervals to ensure the accuracy of your line laser (available for selected tools)
Main functions when using a GRL device:
• Easily control all main functions of your rotary laser such as setting slope, modifying the rotation speed, or putting your device into standby mode
• Benefit from app-only features like setting up the partial projection (Mask Mode) or creation of Profiles to save and apply the setting you need
• Check the accuracy of your tool and have it corrected automatically
We are very pleased to receive your feedback and improvement suggestions for our application. Simply contact us via app.support@de.bosch.com and let us know if you have any wishes or problems – we are happy to help you!

bluejetty:00017163:ios.description:
Classic Solitaire is the best way to play the classic card games you know & love!
The most popular card game in the world, classic Solitaire, also known as Patience, is great to relax. Train your brain with solitaire classic games. With beautiful cards, fun animations, & free, offline play, Solitaire is the best card game to pass time. With both random & winnable decks & beautiful graphics, Classic Solitaire is one of the most popular games in the world.
Think you have the perfect Solitaire strategy? Try daily challenges or play unlimited solitaire games or winnable solitaire decks! Test your patience & choose between classic Solitaire or Vegas scoring. Try our daily challenges & customize your cards, table, & Solitaire games mode to play your way. 
Classic Solitaire Games Features:
Classic Solitaire card games for seniors
Daily challenges - New card games to play everyday
Offline play - Our classic games are ready for you to play, with or without wifi!
Player statistics
Unlimited hints & undo which help you learn how to play Solitaire
Customizable card & table design
Left-Handed Mode
Winnable Solitaire Deck, fun solitaire card games & classic games puzzle
Full deck solitaire - Enjoy the satisfying challenge of adult card games with our full deck solitaire mode, offering endless opportunities to test your skills and master your strategy
The Classic Solitaire you know & love reimagined for the mobile age
How To Play:
The aim of full deck Solitaire is to expose all the playing cards & move them to the 4 foundation piles which are built in suits from Aces to Kings. In basic Solitaire (also known as Patience) 7 columns are built downward in alternating colors. The aim of the classic Solitaire game is to clear the rows of playing cards into the foundation piles
Classic Solitaire card games can train your brain & improve problem-solving skills! Return to the addictive card puzzle & timeless fun solitaire card games, perfect for players who enjoy engaging adult card games that combine strategy, focus, and relaxation.
Whether you’re a fan of classic games or looking for relaxing adult card games, Classic Solitaire is the perfect choice. Experience the timeless challenge of classic solitaire with smooth gameplay, customizable designs, and endless replayability. Perfect for unwinding after a busy day or keeping your mind sharp, this game brings the traditional charm of the world’s favorite card pastime straight to your device.
Have any suggestions? Let us know at solitaire-support@tripledotstudios.com
Like us on Facebook, share your strategy for Classic Solitaire & find the latest news:
https://www.facebook.com/Solitaire-398627873927679/

bluejetty:00078934:ios.name: Real Car Driving: 3D Car City
bluejetty:00078934:ios.summary:
Prepare to become the master of off-road exploration. We bring you an immersive open-world off-road simulation that will elevate your exploration to new heights.
Ignite your real skills with a Car Driving Traffic Simulator game - where eve
bluejetty:00078934:ios.description:
Prepare to become the master of off-road exploration. We bring you an immersive open-world off-road simulation that will elevate your exploration to new heights.
Ignite your real skills with a Car Driving Traffic Simulator game - where every journey is a thrilling car experience driving through diverse landscapes!
Prepare for a real adrenaline-fueled experience in a Car Driving Traffic Simulator game, where fast speed meets precision in the heart of the bustling city. Navigate through intricate city streets, pushing your limits and your fast speed as you race against time and traffic at top speed on the maps. Explore diverse maps that offer a myriad of challenges and hidden gems waiting to be discovered. Are you ready to conquer the urban jungle and become the master of the road on the maps?
- REALISTIC DRIVING EXPERIENCE: Feel the excitement of realistic race car dynamics as you navigate city car races and drive streets on the mini maps, with each vehicle offering its own distinct handling characteristics in this game.
- DYNAMIC TRAFFIC: Encounter lifelike traffic flow and AI-controlled vehicles that present an additional fast parking challenge during your control endeavors in the driving game.
- MULTIPLAYER ACTION: Engage in exhilarating multiplayer parking races against friends and global competitors, showcasing your racing and parking prowess in real-time showdowns.
- CUSTOMIZATION VARIETY: Personalize your city vehicles with an extensive array of customization choices, from paint schemes to performance enhancements, and craft a fast ride that's uniquely yours with maps, including subway.
- CHALLENGING MISSIONS: Tackle a diverse city drive range of tasks and objectives, from time trials to delivery assignments, and put your car driving skills to the test across various race scenarios, showcasing your racing prowess in real-time showdowns, and striving to emerge as the ultimate master of the subway asphalt in this game.
- EXPANSIVE EXPLORATION: Roam the sprawling racing cityscape, uncovering hidden car pathways behind mountains and secret locales as you race through its bustling car streets with diverse maps in this game, proving yourself as the master of exploration.
- UNIQUE MAPS: Navigate through dynamic landscapes, including bustling urban centers, parking, picturesque countryside drive roads, subway, bike racing, and rugged off-road trails, mastering every terrain and conquering every challenge.
- SUBWAY MODE: Experience the real adrenaline rush of race through subterranean subway networks, evading obstacles and competing against the clock.
- BIKE AND TRUCK RACING: Switch gears and hop on a bike or motorcycle or take command of a mighty truck, each offering unique bike city drive challenges and fast speed rewards.
- PROGRESSIVE SYSTEM: Earn rewards and unlock fresh content fast as you progress through the game to maximize your fast speed when racing, including new vehicles, upgrades, parking,customization options, and drive cars in the city.
Whether you're a novice racer or a seasoned speed enthusiast, the Car Driving Traffic Simulator game offers endless excitement and thrills for every speed demon out there.
Explore the vast world with exciting racing that will make you excited, and offer the perfect opportunity to hone your skills and become a true master of the road maps.
If you need any technical support or would like to send us some suggestions to improve the game, shoot us an email at gamewayfu@wayfustudio.com.

bluejetty:00024274:ios.name: ER Companion
bluejetty:00024274:ios.summary: ER Companion is the complete interactive guide for Elden Ring, the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC and Elden Ring Nightreign. Explore every map offline, track your progress with smart checklists, plan complete builds with exact attack ratings, an
bluejetty:00024274:ios.description:
ER Companion is the complete interactive guide for Elden Ring, the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC and Elden Ring Nightreign. Explore every map offline, track your progress with smart checklists, plan complete builds with exact attack ratings, and look up any weapon, armor piece, talisman or boss in seconds.
INTERACTIVE OFFLINE MAPS
The Lands Between with the underground world, the Realm of Shadow from the DLC and Limveld from Elden Ring Nightreign. All map data works without an internet connection.
- Sites of Grace, Stakes of Marika and map fragments
- Dungeons, evergaols, divine towers and minor Erdtrees
- Bosses, NPCs, merchants and quests
- Golden Seeds, Sacred Tears, Crystal Tears and Larval Tears
- Weapons, armor, talismans, sorceries, incantations, cookbooks and Stonesword Keys
- Filter by type, region, or completion state, and search the whole map instantly
CHECKLISTS AND PROGRESS TRACKING
Tick off bosses, flask upgrades, map fragments, dungeons, weapons, armor sets, talismans, sorceries, incantations and more. Check entries directly from the map popup and see your completion percentage on a dedicated statistics page.
COMPLETE GAME DATABASES
- Every weapon and shield with upgrade paths, scaling and status buildup, including all DLC gear
- Armor sets with defense values and poise
- Talismans, sorceries, incantations, spirit ashes and Ashes of War
- Items, crafting recipes and upgrade materials
- Boss data with locations
BUILD PLANNER AND DAMAGE CALCULATORS
Plan a full character build with every equipment slot, see the exact attack power, defenses and stats for your level, and share builds with a short code. The damage calculators even show your damage against a specific boss, and the summon range calculator and drop locations round out the toolbox.
SYNC AND BACKUP
Your progress syncs automatically via iCloud. You can also export and import a backup file, or move progress to another device with a sync code.
MADE FOR PLAYERS
- Works fully offline, so it is ready even without a connection
- Light and dark theme with several accent styles
- Available in 20 languages
- Optional ad-free unlock
IN-APP PURCHASES
The interactive maps, checklists, enemy data and damage calculators are free. The gear database with the Build Planner, the Items & Recipes section and the Guides can each be unlocked with a one-time in-app purchase, or with an optional subscription that unlocks everything at once. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled.
DISCLAIMER
ER Companion is a third-party, unofficial companion app. The developer is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by FromSoftware, Inc. or Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc. ELDEN RING, Shadow of the Erdtree, Elden Ring Nightreign and all related names are trademarks of their respective owners. All game content is used under fair use guidelines.

bluejetty:00165373:ios.name: Luna - Baby Monitor
bluejetty:00165373:ios.summary: With Luna, you'll always have a baby monitor at hand when you need one. Luna converts two iPhones or iPads into one secure baby monitor with unlimited range. Receive an alarm when your baby cries, listen to the automated audio stream or loo
bluejetty:00165373:ios.description:
With Luna, you'll always have a baby monitor at hand when you need one. Luna converts two iPhones or iPads into one secure baby monitor with unlimited range. Receive an alarm when your baby cries, listen to the automated audio stream or look at live video footage. You can use the app when connected to Wi-Fi or with a 3G or LTE mobile connection. Luna consumes much less battery power and data than other baby monitor apps. Luna is consistently reliable, even when it's running in the background.
RELIABLE, SIMPLE, SECURE
By using the latest technology, Luna offers maximum reliability and security. You'll never miss an alarm again.
CLEVER DESIGN
We've invested a lot of time in creating a sophisticated and beautiful design. That is why Luna isn't just user-friendly, it's also nice to look at. Plus, while Luna is monitoring your baby, it displays all the important features.
INTELLIGENT ECO MODE SAVES BATTERY LIFE AND DATA
Thanks to our unique Eco-Mode, the Luna app uses 4 times less battery power than any other baby monitoring app while also conserving your data usage.
UNLIMITED COVERAGE
Wherever you are,. as long as you have an Internet connection, the Luna app consistently sends you alarms and live audio streams when your child wakes up.
AUDIO AND VIDEO STREAMING
Your Luna parent station automatically receives a live audio stream whenever there's noise in the children's room. Alternatively, you can check the app yourself at any time you like. The video stream will also be activated at any time - without any feedback.
RUNS RELIABLY IN THE BACKGROUND
Luna is a multitasker! As opposed to other baby monitor apps, Luna runs reliably without issues in the background. This frees you up to use your mobile device for other things when you need to.
ADJUSTABLE SENSITIVITY 
Luna will graphically display the background audio level of the last few minutes. The app will also help you to define the right alarm threshold.
ACTIVITY LOG
Luna shows you how long your child has been sleeping and it provides you with a notification record.
ENCRYPTED DATA TRANSFER
We protect your privacy. All data transfers made by Luna are encrypted by SSL. This means that no one else will be able to access your data.
INTELLIGENT CONNECTION MONITORING
You're on the road and the internet connection went down? Don't worry! Luna continuously monitors the connection between the baby station and the parent station and will notifiy you in case of any interruptions. Luna will also try to automatically restore the connection as quickly as possible.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
You will need at least two iOS devices. Make sure that both devices are connected to the internet, and you're good to go!
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Word Tile Puzzle masterfully combines the strategic fun of tile-matching (Mahjong/Match-3 style) with the intellectual thrill of word hunt games. Unlike traditional word games, here you tap letter tiles in the correct order to form words and clear the board. But watch out! Clearing the top layer flips and unlocks the hidden tiles underneath, revealing new possibilities and unexpected challenges!
Brought to you by the creator of Word Serenity, this game offers infinite, non-stop puzzles with 100% original gameplay. It’s the ultimate endless mental workout for word lovers and puzzle fans alike!
HOW TO PLAY:
● Tap & Build: Tap the overlapping letter tiles in order to build valid words.
● Crush & Clear: Successfully formed words will blast away, clearing the tiles.
● Flip & Unlock: Watch the lower layers flip over and activate as the upper tiles disappear!
● Endless Challenges: Keep clearing the boards and unlock an infinite stream of brand-new levels!
GAME FEATURES:
● Innovative & Original Gameplay: The perfect, brand-new fusion of word puzzles and tile-matching mechanics that you've never seen before!
● Layered Strategy: Plan your moves carefully! Clearing one tile unblocks and flips the next layer, adding a deep layer of strategy.
● Infinite Levels to Explore: Never run out of puzzles! Enjoy an endless supply of creative levels that keep your brain sharp forever.
● Brain-Boosting Fun: Exercise your mind, expand your vocabulary, and sharpen your spelling skills in a super satisfying way.
● Powerful Boosters: Stuck on a tricky layer? Use helpful power-ups to blast through the tiles and keep your winning streak alive.
● Beautiful Themes: Unlock gorgeous backgrounds and soothing music as you progress through your infinite journey!
● Daily Rewards & Quests: Complete fun daily challenges and quests to win awesome free gifts every day!
● Relaxing & Stress-Free: No time limits and no pressure—play at your own comfortable pace anytime, offline or online.
● Seamless Sync: Easily sync your game progress between your phone and tablet so you never lose a level.
Whether you want to relax after a long day or give your brain a serious workout, Word Tile Puzzle is your perfect match.
Download now and experience the next evolution of endless word games!

bluejetty:00185255:ios.description:
It’s a dark world out there for a teeny little stickman like you, and it’s about time you light it up. 
Jump, flip and slide from one neon shape to another to make them glow. 
Collect stars as you play to raise your score. 
Just when you start to feel like a stickman boss, things get complicated (or “sticky,” if you will) as you pass levels. Shapes start moving, rotating and even exploding, and lethal spikes become a constant threat to your poor little stickman life. 
If you miss a jump or hit a spike… you fall into oblivion!
Ready to light it up?
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
- Subscribe to unlock 10 new levels every week + 50% off in the shop + 400 gems daily for the duration of the subscription and remove ads.
- VIP membership: A weekly track (for 3.99$/week) after 3-day free trial.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Subscription may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
- By downloading this App you agree to Crazy Labs’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Use at https://crazylabs.com/privacy-policy/ and at https://www.crazylabs.com/terms-of-use/.
- Please consider that this App may include third party services for limited legally permissible purposes.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.

bluejetty:00152249:ios.summary:

In Big Farm: Homestead, you face the challenge of resto
bluejetty:00152249:ios.description:
Welcome to the heart of the Midwest, where vast fields, charming farmsteads, and a deep mystery await! This farming simulator expands the Big Farm franchise with Big Farm: Homestead! 
In Big Farm: Homestead, you face the challenge of restoring the three Townsend family farms; each with its own unique crops, animals, and history. This engaging farming sim is more than just a farming game, it's a story of discovery: once-thriving White Oak Lake, the village's water source, is draining, and pollution is spreading. Someone is behind this disaster, and it's up to you to uncover the truth in this rich farm story!
BUILD & EXPAND YOUR BIG FARM
Your journey in this relaxing simulation game is all about growth. Grow a variety of crops, from golden wheat and juicy corn to specialty Midwestern produce. Harvest plentiful resources daily to sustain your big farm. Raise adorable animals including cows, horses, chickens, and even rare breeds!
Upgrade your barns, silos, and farmhouses to create a thriving agricultural empire. Every piece of equipment plays a part in the prosperity of your farm city as you build your ultimate homestead. It’s the perfect blend of a gentle farming simulator and an exciting farm tycoon experience.
EXPERIENCE TRUE FARMING LIFE IN YOUR VILLAGE
Immerse yourself in the rhythm of village life. Harvest fresh produce, craft delicious goods, and fulfill orders to help local townsfolk. 
Join the community of dedicated farmers who make this farming region so special. This is one of the best farm games for free that lets you live out your dream of successful farming.
SAVE THE LAKE & UNCOVER THE MYSTERY
The lifeblood of these farms - the beautiful White Oak Lake - is vanishing. Who is behind it? Follow a captivating story, interact with interesting characters, and solve the game's mystery before it’s too late!
MEET FARMING CHARACTERS
Form friendships, unlock new storylines, and work with other farmers in the village to rebuild the Townsend legacy. Your family and friends are integral to your journey in this warm-hearted farm story.
MEET FARMING CHARACTERS
Form friendships, unlock new storylines, and work with other farmers in the village to rebuild the Townsend legacy. Your family and friends are integral to your journey in this warm-hearted farm story.
COMPLETE QUESTS & EXPLORE NEW ADVENTURES
Take on exciting farm challenges, seasonal events, and hidden treasures as you expand your farming skills! Embark on an adventure that transforms your small plot into a bustling, dream big farm.
The future of the Townsend's farms and the lake rests in your hands. Can you restore the farms, save the water, and uncover the secret behind the destruction?
Start your American farming simulator adventure today in Big Farm: Homestead, the game that turns farming into a thrilling harvest adventure! 
Experience the joy of harvest land and build your dream farm village simulator in one of the top free farming games available. This farm story is your chance to build a legacy, not just a ranch!

bluejetty:00018352:ios.description:
Con l’app Smart Banking - BPER Banca la tua esperienza di banca si arricchisce di nuove funzionalità, disegnate a partire dalle tue necessità, per darti ciò di cui hai bisogno ogni giorno.
Per te, a portata di smartphone, conti, carte, prestiti, mutui e investimenti. Ti bastano pochi secondi per fare bonifici, anche istantanei, ricaricare prepagate e telefono. Paghi anche i bollettini postali, PagoPa e le deleghe F24, che puoi inquadrare con la fotocamera.
In più con la scrivania virtuale Smart Desk puoi consultare, firmare le tue pratiche e inviare nuovi documenti senza andare in filiale.
Tra le funzionalità:
 • Bonifici, bollo auto e moto, ricariche, Bollettini e F24 (anche ordinari)
 • PagaPoi, per la rateizzazione delle spese su conto corrente
 • Hey BPER per prendere appuntamento o dialogare in tempo reale con i nostri consulenti online in chat, al telefono, in videochiamata, anche in condivisione schermo
 • Assistente virtuale per supportarti nell’utilizzo dei servizi digitali Smart
 • Conto e carta Teen per i ragazzi dai 13 ai 17 anni
 • Polizza veterinaria UniSalute 4ZAMPE
 • Polizza odontoiatrica UniSalute Sorriso
 • Servizi per la salute Medico Online e Pediatra Online
 • Prestito personale, con evetuale abbinamento della polizza assicurativa
 • Richiesta di carte di debito, prepagate e carte di credito direttamente dall’app
 • Controllo, attivazione e gestione della sicurezza delle tue carte (codice Key6)
 • Sezione Investimenti con possibilità di sottoscrivere piani di accumulo
 • Autenticazione sulle Casse Smart tramite app
 • Finanziamenti
 • Questionario MiFID
 • Aggiornamento del documento d'identità con una foto
 • Scrivania virtuale Smart Desk
 • Donazioni per beneficenza
 • Sezione dedicata alle polizze assicurative con dettagli sulle coperture attive ed estinte degli ultimi 13 mesi
 • Aggiornamento del Questionario di Adeguata Verifica direttamente dall’app
 • Nuova sezione Lifestyle con accesso a Priceless: vantaggi ed esperienze esclusive per clienti con carta Mastercard
 • Richiesta anticipo delle fatture e degli incassi POSper clienti Business
 • Acquisto SmartPOS Mini o SoftPOS per clienti Business senza andare in filiale
 • Chiamata certificata, per riconoscere se la telefonata arriva dai nostri Consulenti o se può essere sospetta, tutto grazie a una notifica in app (per utilizzare la funzionalità e proteggere le chiamate della banca da tentativi di frode è necessario fornire il consenso di accesso ai registri delle chiamate)
Potrai autorizzare tutte le tue operazioni in modo veloce e sicuro grazie a Smart PIN, impronta digitale o riconoscimento del volto.
ⓘ L’app è gratuita e disponibile per i clienti delle banche del Gruppo BPER Banca.
Se vuoi disporre pagamenti, assicurati di avere un profilo dispositivo. Per maggiori informazioni contatta la tua Filiale.
