bluejetty:00091625:ios.description:
Give VoRide a try!
How does it work?
VoRide is a microtransit service that provides on-demand rides for people in Volusia County. 
To reserve your ride: 
Request a ride departing from your current location
Enter your destination
Get picked up by a VoRide van
How long will I wait?
Wait times vary. Track your reserved vehicle in real-time using the VoRide app.
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
AFFORDABLE.
Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices. Enough said. 
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your community a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
Questions? Reach out at support-voride@ridewithvia.com or give us a call +1 386-210-9861 . Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00084056:ios.description:
Introducing ChatNow AI: Your Intelligent AI Chatbot for Modern Life
In a world where technology enhances every part of our daily routines, ChatNow AI brings you an innovative platform designed to simplify and improve everyday tasks. More than just an assistant, ChatNow AI is a powerful tool to help you tackle anything from conversations to professional advice. Whether it's managing school assignments, writing emails, or exploring health-related queries, ChatNow AI is here to streamline your experience.
AI-Driven Conversations
ChatNow AI uses advanced conversational algorithms to provide engaging and intuitive interactions. It supports GPT 4, DeepSeek, Claude from Anthropic, Grok from xAI, Google Gemini, Mistral, Llama, GPT-4, GPT 5, GPT5 and GPT-o1. With its human-like responses and personalized approach, it feels like you're speaking to an expert who understands your needs.
Writing Assistance Made Easy
Need help drafting an essay or crafting a professional email with AI Chatbot? ChatNow AI offers a suite of writing tools to generate well-structured, compelling content with just a few inputs, making sure you shine in every scenario.
Smart Homework Help
For students, ChatNow AI changes the way you approach learning. It provides step-by-step assistance across a wide range of subjects like math, science, and literature, turning complex concepts into simple, understandable solutions.
Health and Legal Insights
Need advice on a medical or legal question? While not a substitute for professionals, ChatNow AI offers preliminary insights from its AI tools to guide you toward your next steps.
Multilingual Translation
Communicate seamlessly across different languages with ChatNow AI’s translation capabilities. It’s perfect for international travel or global business, ensuring clear communication in any language.
Boost Your Productivity
ChatNow AI handles the small yet time-consuming tasks that slow you down. Whether it’s managing your calendar, drafting emails, or helping you stay organized, it frees you to focus on what matters most.
Dynamic Conversations

bluejetty:00015231:ios.name: Fire-Trucks Game for Kids FULL
bluejetty:00015231:ios.summary:
Full Version *This game includes full access, no additional purchases required.*
Do you love fire trucks and dream of being a heroic firefighter? Then It’s time for some fire trucks fun with the Firefighter Games for Kids App! This ente
bluejetty:00015231:ios.description:
Full Version *This game includes full access, no additional purchases required.*
Do you love fire trucks and dream of being a heroic firefighter? Then It’s time for some fire trucks fun with the Firefighter Games for Kids App! This entertaining and informative app was designed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their philosophy of learning through play. With over 30 fire truck games and sounds this app will get everyone excited about playing with fire trucks and firefighters! 
Firetruck Sounds
The sounds of sirens is what thrills aspiring firefighters the most, and with the fire truck sounds you get to hear all sorts of different sirens and fire trucks! The interactive sound pages have several other sounds as well, and it’s fun to tap everything on the page and see it respond. Fire trucks galore and sirens… what aspiring firefighter could ask for more? 
Firetruck Rescue Driving Game
Hop in the fire truck and get ready for some fun driving! In the Firetruck Rescue Game you’ll be driving into different creative fun worlds like a cave, a forest, and a snowy wonderland. And what do firefighters do best? Put out fires and rescue animals and people! So as you drive in the different worlds you’ll be putting out things that are on fire and also jumping up to rescue different animals and pets. When you collect the right amount of animals you’ll be rewarded at the end with a fun animation and sound page including the sounds of what you just helped rescue. It’s fire truck fun to the max and perfect for everyone who wants to be a hero!
Hide and Seek Rescue Game
Enter six different worlds where something is on fire and rescue the animal or people that are hiding on the page. For example the cabin in the forest is on fire and the little bear cub is hiding, when you find him he will hide again for four more times until the firetruck puts out the fire. It's a truly fun and engaging game for all aspiring firefighters!
Firefighter Flashcards
Being a firefighter is exciting and also very interesting! It’s an age old profession and there is lots you didn't know about how firefighting first started and other interesting facts about all the special equipment they use. With the Firefighter Flashcards you’ll be learning the names of all the equipment including the best part- a firetruck! And you’ll also be learning facts about the equipment and the firefighters themselves that are sure to not only entertain but educate as well. 
Counting Books
With the Firefighters Counting book and the Christmas Counting book your aspiring hero's can learn how to count to 12. These books are interactive and will say the numbers when you tap them... it’s true learning through play!
Firefighter Number Games
Numbers are fun, and playing with addition and subtraction in the Firefighter Numbers Game will get you excited! And the best part is you’ll be adding and subtracting with fun firefighter equipment, and puppies and, of course, firetrucks. With 3 different levels you can start out with easier equations, and then build your way up to subtracting in the 3rd level. It’s engaging math fun, and is sure to entertain while you’re learning.
Sound the fire truck sirens and have a awesome time playing with firetrucks and firefighting equipment, and numbers in the Firefighter Games for Kids App, where learning through play encourages your little ones to have fun while sharpening their knowledge about firetrucks and numbers. If your little one loves fire trucks and sirens this is the app for them!

bluejetty:00071194:ios.name: Can you escape Undersea Villa
bluejetty:00071194:ios.summary: Can you escape Undersea Villa is a free 3D escape room game set in a resort villa floating on a tranquil sea. Gather the hidden clues, find items, solve mystery puzzles, and escape. With Hint 1, Hint 2, and the answers, even beginners can p
bluejetty:00071194:ios.description:
Can you escape Undersea Villa is a free 3D escape room game set in a resort villa floating on a tranquil sea. Gather the hidden clues, find items, solve mystery puzzles, and escape. With Hint 1, Hint 2, and the answers, even beginners can play with confidence.
The shimmering surface of the water, the gentle breeze blowing across.
A resort floating on the tranquil sea, a series of riddles to solve.
Will you be able to collect the hidden clues and escape from here?
Please enjoy a relaxing time surrounded by the beautiful sea. Explore the resort, search for the clues hidden inside, and find your way out.
■ An escape room game anyone can clear
The difficulty is set for beginners to intermediate players. Hint 1, Hint 2, and the answers are provided, so even if you've never played an escape room game before, you can play casually and clear it all the way to the end. Look closely, think it through, and enjoy the moment when everything clicks.
If you love mystery games, puzzle adventure games, or hidden object games, you'll feel right at home. Tap every place that catches your eye, collect items and hints, and use them to get the keys and open the way out.
■ Observation and a flash of inspiration
Tap any place you're curious about—you may find an item or a hint. Make full use of everything you find to get the keys. In this point-and-click escape game, sharp observation and a sudden flash of inspiration are what lead you out. Piece the clues together like a detective, one by one.
■ Keep the clues you want to see again
Found a clue you'll need later? You can save it and look back at it whenever you like, so you don't have to remember every detail or go back and search again. It's a small help that makes solving the mysteries of the resort more comfortable.
■ Hints and answers when you need them
Stuck on a puzzle? Check Hint 1 first, and if you still need help, Hint 2. The answer is there too, so you never have to give up halfway. Use as much help as you like and enjoy the mystery at your own pace.
■ A calm time surrounded by the sea
The water's surface shimmers, and a gentle breeze blows across the resort. Between puzzles, take a breath and enjoy the peaceful air of the open sea. This escape game is made for a slow, relaxing moment.
■ Play anytime
Your progress is saved automatically, so you can play a little during a short break and pick up where you left off later. Or settle in on the weekend and aim to escape all at once.
■ Features
・Difficulty for beginners to intermediate players
・Hint 1, Hint 2, and answers
・Save clues to review later
・Autosave
・Free to play
■ How to Play
・Tap the place you are interested in
・You will get items and hints
・Make full use of them to get the key
・Observation and a flash of inspiration are important
■ Recommended for
・Beginners trying an escape room game for the first time
・Fans of room escape games, mystery games, and brain games
・Players who enjoy point-and-click adventures and finding hidden items
・Anyone looking for a relaxing puzzle game to play in short breaks
・Lovers of the ocean and seaside resorts
■ More escape games from ArtDigic
ArtDigic creates 3D escape games set in beautiful villas, seaside houses, and resorts around the world. If you enjoy Undersea Villa, look for our other escape room games and continue your journey from one mystery to the next.
Can you escape from the resort floating on the tranquil sea?
Enjoy your relaxing time surrounded by the beautiful sea.

bluejetty:00180555:ios.description:
Export your Apple Health data to CSV or GPX - back it up, open it in Excel or Google Sheets, or analyze it with AI. HealthExport Remote syncs in the background and works with Claude, Codex, and any LLM through an open-source CLI. End-to-end encrypted - we never see your data.
Key Features:
- Manual Exports: Export your health data to CSV, PDF or GPX files manually in the app while tailoring the configuration to your needs (desired data types, time period, aggregation, etc.)
- Automated Exports: Health data export can be automated using Apple Shortcuts for seamless integration into your daily routines.
- HealthExport Remote: Access your health data remotely from your computer through a secure and customizable web dashboard. Synchronization with the web app happens effortlessly without the need to open the app on your phone. Your data is end-to-end encrypted for ultimate privacy.
Your privacy is our priority - we don't collect or share your health data with anyone.
Categories of Health Data:
- Aggregation based types - Export can be aggregated by minutes, hours, days, months, or years
- Record based types - Export contains all entries from the Health app
- Workouts and Workout Routes
-----------------------------
Aggregated data types:
-----------------------------
Activity:
- Apple Watch stand hours
- Distance cycling
- Distance downhill snow sports
- Distance swimming
- Distance walking / running
- Exercise time
- Flights Climbed
- Stand time
- Step count
- Swimming stroke count
Energy:
- Active energy burned
- Basal energy burned
Heart rate:
- Heart rate
- Resting heart rate
- Walking heart rate
Nutrition:
- Caffeine
- Calcium
- Carbohydrates
- Cholesterol
- Energy consumed
- Fat saturated
- Fat total
- Fiber
- Iron
- Magnesium
- Potassium
- Protein
- Sodium
- Sugar
- Vitamin A
- Vitamin C
- Vitamin D
- Water
Wheelchair:
- Distance wheelchair
- Wheelchair push count
-----------------------------
Record based data types:
-----------------------------
Audio exposure:
- Environmental sound levels
- Headphone sound levels
Blood:
- Blood glucose
- Blood pressure (Diastolic)
- Blood pressure (Systolic)
- Insulin delivery
Body:
- 6 minute walk test
- Alcoholic beverages
- Body fat percentage
- Body mass
- Body mass index
- Body temperature
- Handwashing
- Height
- Lean body mass
- Mindfulness
- Medications
- Oxygen saturation
- Physical effort
- Respiratory rate
- State of Mind
- Time in daylight
- Tooth brushing
- VO2 Max
- Waist circumference
- Walking asymmetry percentage
- Walking double support percentage
- Walking speed
- Walking steadiness
- Walking steadiness notification
- Walking step length
- Wrist temperature
Cycling:
- Cadence
- Functional threshold power
- Power
- Speed
Diving:
- Underwater depth
- Water temperature
Heart rate:
- Event: High heart rate
- Event: Irregular heart rhythm
- Event: Low heart rate
- Heart rate

- Resting heart rate
- Walking heart rate
Reproductive health:
- Basal body temperature
- Cervical mucus quality
- Intermenstrual bleeding
- Menstrual flow
- Ovulation test result
- Pregnancy test
- Progesterone test
- Sexual activity
Running:

- Power
- Speed
- Stride length
- Vertical oscillation
Sleep:
- Time asleep
- Time awake
- Time core
- Time deep
- Time in bed
- Time REM
-----------------------------
HealthExport Remote lets you visualize your health data on a customizable dashboard accessible from a browser on your computer. You can also perform remote CSV exports on the website. Health data is automatically synced to the service multiple times per day in the background, so there is no need for opening the app on your phone anymore. The data is end to end encrypted between your phone and your browser. HealthExport Remote requires a subscription payment due to monthly fees associated with running the service.
Remote Service EULA: https://healthexport.app/terms/remote.html

bluejetty:00158066:ios.description:

bluejetty:00117647:ios.description:
You can heal by feeding dogs and watching cute things!
Get a cute dog, Lucky, Rack, and various dogs!
When the dog grow up, they help Lucky fight ghosts together.
You can dress them in cute clothes, too!
# Good food is eaten automatically if you stay still.
# Bad food can be hit by touching the screen when it gets close.

# The ghost attacks Lucky after a certain period of time.
# Raise Lucky's level in the store with the star coin you got after defeating the ghost.
- A stronger Lucky can hunt a stronger ghost.
# If you collected Gem, you can meet the dog through the dog basket!
- When you feeding milk to your dog , Lucky gets stronger, too!
- When the dog grows up, it can combine with Lucky and Rack to fight!
- Dress your dog in cute clothes!
# Game Tip!
- The more you keep the combo, the more star coins you get.
- Angel buffs cover up one mistake.

bluejetty:00088421:ios.description:
GO Club is a highly rated health and fitness app that focuses on simplicity and building daily habits.
→ ⁠Core Features: 
It combines automatic step tracking with smart water reminders, aiming to keep you active and hydrated without overwhelming you with data.
→ ⁠⁠Design: 
The app is known for its clean, minimalist interface (often referred to as "Liquid Glass") that avoids cluttered charts in favour of a simple, visually pleasing experience.
→ Widgets & Apple Watch: 
It includes useful home screen widgets and a dedicated Apple Watch app, making it easy to check your progress at a glance.
→ Recognition: 
It was a finalist for the 2025 App Store Awards, highlighting its quality and user appeal.
If you are looking for a straightforward, beautifully designed app that tracks both steps and hydration, GO Club is an excellent choice.
Sometimes the tiniest habits are the most important and also the easiest to neglect. That’s where GO Club helps.
Benefits of walking more & staying hydrated
• Reach your daily step goals
• Build healthier habits
• Improve energy, mood & focus
• Support weight management
• Stay active and hydrated every day
GO Club is a simple and motivating step counter and water reminder app that helps you build healthier daily habits. Track your steps, monitor your hydration, stay consistent with reminders, and reach your fitness goals one day at a time.
Whether you’re walking for fitness, weight loss, or simply trying to stay active, GO Club makes it easy to monitor your daily progress. Set personalised step goals, track your water intake, build streaks, and stay motivated with beautiful insights and widgets.
Don’t let a busy schedule get in the way of your health. GO Club helps you stay on track with smart reminders that encourage you to move more and drink water regularly throughout the day. Small actions repeated consistently can lead to meaningful improvements in your overall well-being.
Walking is one of the simplest ways to improve your health. Daily walking can help increase physical activity, boost energy levels, improve cardiovascular health, support weight loss goals, and reduce sedentary time. Staying properly hydrated helps maintain focus, supports physical performance, and contributes to overall wellness.
GO Club features:
• Accurate step tracking and pedometer functionality
• Daily step goals and progress monitoring
• Water intake tracking and hydration reminders
• Smart notifications to keep you moving and hydrated
• Activity history and health insights
• Daily, weekly, and monthly progress tracking
• Streaks and achievements to stay motivated
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Apple Watch support
• Personalised goals and reminders
• Beautiful and easy-to-use interface
Premium Features:
• Advanced statistics and insights
• Additional widgets and customisation options
• Unlimited activity history
• Exclusive themes and app personalisation
• Enhanced goal tracking tools
• Future premium features and updates
• AI Smart Walking Plans
• Golden Hour Time Slots 
GO Club Premium is available as a monthly or annual subscription. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions through your App Store account settings.
Start building healthier habits today with GO Club. Track your steps, stay hydrated, stay consistent, and become the healthiest version of yourself.
------------
Need Help?
For questions, feedback, or bug reports, contact us at support@gosteps.club or reach out on social media at @goclub_app.
Follow us to stay updated on what’s coming next in GO Club. Instagram and Twitter @goclub_app 
------------
Important Info: 
Your subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of your billing period. Manage subscriptions through your iTunes account.

→ https://www.goclub.app/terms/

bluejetty:00182655:ios.description:
The dawn of a new hero!
A thousand years ago, a great battle ensued between two dragons, one gold and the other silver, where they were sealed away. However, the real tale begins many centuries later after the Silver Dragon reawakens, and launches an assault on a frontier village in the far north.
There, a royal knight by the name of Lucas serves as a guard after being relegated to the rural and much isolated location by the King. Yet, little does he know he is, in fact, a descendant of the hero, Alaric, who once sealed the Gold and Silver Dragons in human form. Nonetheless, when tragedy strikes, he soon finds his place, and after teaming up with a band of unlikely companions, sets out on an adventure to save the world.
Features
- Make a return to the golden age of RPGs!
- Intuitive controls & retro graphics!
- Unlock the growth plates to power up characters!
- Change and master jobs to use more abilities!
- Plenty of subquests and extra content!
- Challenging dungeons full of gimmicks and formidable opponents!
- Fight various enemies and complete the Enemy Guide!
- Play the Lottery to win strong equipment!
- Character's appearance changes depending on their job!
- Splendid BGM from the renowned game composer Ryuji Sasai!
* The game can be played in its entirety without the need for in-game transactions.

bluejetty:00062057:ios.description:
Discover the richness of the Church with the Catholic Liturgical Calendar app—your essential companion for the 2026 liturgical year and beyond.
Never miss a Holy Day of Obligation or a beloved Saint’s feast. Whether you are looking for today’s Mass readings or planning for future seasons, this app provides a dynamic and easy-to-use experience for every Catholic.
Key Features:
1. Daily Mass Readings: Access the full scripture readings for every day of the year.
2. Saint of the Day: Learn about the lives of the saints and their daily inspirations.
3. Dynamic Calendar: View the start and end dates for all Catholic seasons:
 a. Advent: The 4 Sundays leading to Christmas.
 b. Christmas: Celebrating the Nativity of our Lord.
 c. Lent: A season of preparation and penance.
 d. The Triduum: Deep reflections for Good Friday, Holy Saturday, and Easter Sunday.
4. Holiday & Feast Finder: Quickly locate Holy Days and Feasts for any year on the go.
5. Liturgical Colors: The app reflects the official colors of the Church (Purple, White, Green, Red) to match the altar and vestments.
Why choose this Liturgical Calendar? Calculated dynamically for each year, our app ensures that moveable feasts like Ash Wednesday and Easter are always accurate. It’s designed for simplicity and spiritual growth, keeping you connected to the Universal Church.
Coming Soon: We are currently working on adding more prayers, and working multi-language support to serve the global Catholic community.

* View your settlements
* Compresses document image(s) for fast transmission and minimal data plan usage
* Allow multiple documents to be scanned & sent together
* No-hassle automatic app updates
* myPilot app Integration with Proximity Awareness technology
* CAT Scale app Integration

bluejetty:00164214:ios.name: StressTracker: AI Stress Check
bluejetty:00164214:ios.summary:
------------Designed for Apple Watch Users
Stress Self-Assessment Tailored for Apple Watch Users: It analyzes your heart data and displays your current psychological stress levels, as well as your mental, emotional, and physical states. Wi
bluejetty:00164214:ios.description:
------------Designed for Apple Watch Users
Stress Self-Assessment Tailored for Apple Watch Users: It analyzes your heart data and displays your current psychological stress levels, as well as your mental, emotional, and physical states. With your watch, it's a great tool for stress self-assessment, monitoring, and recording, as well as detecting stress.
------------Measure Psychological Stress Anytime
When wearing your Apple Watch, it automatically generates HRV (heart rate variability) data. The Stress Self-Assessment App analyzes HRV data, combined with resting heart rate, age, and other factors, to provide a comprehensive stress assessment level. This process requires no intervention, but you can also use mindfulness apps or ECG apps on your watch for quick psychological stress tests and monitoring, obtaining HRV values and psychological stress status.
------------Multi-Dimensional Full-Cycle Data
 We provide multi-dimensional, full-cycle psychological stress data charts, allowing you to intuitively understand changes in stress trends and psychological pressure over longer periods. This includes weekly, monthly, and yearly stress trend charts, stress frequency statistics, stress period statistics, stress scatter plots, and more. We offer comprehensive psychological stress data charts to help you clarify the root causes of stress, manage emotions, and improve mental health.
------------Intelligent Psychological Stress Reminders
With stress reminders, you can timely perceive changes in your psychological stress status. When new HRV data is generated, the Stress Self-Assessment App automatically sends a notification to your watch or phone, reminding you to pay attention to your psychological stress status and maintain good physical health.
------------Automatic Health Check-Ins
Leveraging powerful Apple Health integration, we combine seven health habits including steps, sleep duration, mindfulness duration, hydration, hand washing, standing time, and energy burn. This helps you easily understand these data points, promoting robust physical health and a pleasant inner state.
------------Privacy and Security
We understand your personal health data is sensitive. Stress Self-Assessment only directly reads data on your device via the Apple HealthKit API, and all your data is stored locally.
------------------------------------------------------------
Advanced Membership Subscription Explanation: 
By becoming an advanced member of Stress Self-Assessment, you unlock all paid features, enjoy free updates for future advanced functionalities, and a commitment to ad-free service.
Upon Purchase Confirmation and Payment: Your subscription will be automatically renewed via your iTunes account. Apple iTunes will charge you within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, extending the subscription period upon successful payment. To cancel the renewal, manage auto-renewal in iTunes/Apple ID settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. During the trial period, if not canceled, your iTunes account will be charged and the trial period unused will be forfeited upon subscription purchase. This service allows you the choice to cancel, and if not canceled, it will automatically renew for the next billing period.
User Agreement: https://fish.iibear.com/policy/
Privacy Policy: https://fish.iibear.com/private/
Disclaimer: Data and statements from the Stress Self-Assessment App do not constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment for any individual or patient case. They should not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. If you experience any discomfort, whether physical or psychological, seeking timely medical attention is recommended.

bluejetty:00122229:ios.description:
#1 game in 80 countries. Loved by millions of skateboarders all over the world.
"True Skate is clearly something special" - 4.5/5 - Touch Arcade review.
True Skate™ is the closest feeling to real-world skateboarding, with a decade long evolution as the ultimate skateboarding sim.
True Skate™ is the Official Mobile Game of Street League Skateboarding.
PURE PHYSICS CONTROLS
Use your fingers like you would your feet on a real skateboard. Flick the board to make it react exactly how you would expect & drag your finger on the ground to push.
- Play with one finger, mind skate with 2 fingers, or play with 2 thumbs, now with Gamepad! The skateboard reacts instantly as foot & finger, thumb or stick feels truly connected whether pushing, popping, flipping or grinding.
- True Axis's instant & unified physics system listens for swipe, position, direction and strength from the player & processes how the skateboard should respond in real-time. So the same flick in two different points of the skateboard will react very differently.
- Literally any trick is possible with TRUE CONTROL of the skateboard, so if you can dream-it, you can do-it!
SKATEPARKS
Begin at the Underpass, a beautiful skatepark to get lost in with ledges, stairs, grind rails plus a bowl, half pipe & quarter pipes. NEW! Complete Park Objectives to earn keys to unlock 10 Fantasy skateparks for free. Enter & complete events to shred over 20 real-world spots including; The Berrics, SPoT, Love Park, MACBA, & SLS Championship Courses from 2012.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR SKATER AND SETUP
Customize your skateboard with decks and grips from Santa Cruz, DGK, Primitive, MACBA Life, Grizzly, MOB, Independent, Knox, Creature, Nomad, Capitol, ALMOST, Blind, Cliche, Darkstar, Enjoi, Zero & more. Customize your wheels & trucks.
NEW COMPLETES! OG players can choose legacy completes including Realistic Mode or try a range of new completes designed for street, park, vert and more.
EDIT YOUR REPLAY
True Skate™ is about nailing the perfect line; timing, strength, precision, angle, late corrections all make a difference. Edit Replays with a fisheye lens that can shake on impact. Insert keyframes on the timeline to blend between cams. Select from;
- 5 preset Cams.
- Custom Cam with FOV, distortion, distance, height, pitch, pan, yaw & orbit options.
- Tripod Cam with auto, fixed, & follow options.
DIY
All DIY objects are now in the Shop! Check back weekly for sales and new object drops. Unlock objects via park and event missions. Create the park of your dreams.
COMMUNITY
Compete in Global Leaderboards, or connect with your mates via Challenges & games of S.K.A.T.E or join SANDBOX.
SANDBOX is a subscription service that enables players to create & play your True Skate™ experience:
- Custom board stats & graphics.
- Create your own spot, including the gravity! 
- Or choose from tons of incredible Community-Made; Skateparks, DIYs, Boards, Skins, & Apparel.
PLAY SECOND SCREEN
Play with your iOS device or Gamepad as your controller and enjoy True Skate™ in landscape mode on the Big Screen! 
- Connect your iOS device to an Apple TV (or AirPlay compatible smart TV), via wi-fi, or via cable using a Lightning Digital AV Adapter.
- Pair your Gamepad with your iOS device via Bluetooth.
Note: An internet connection is required to access some features.
Terms of service can be found at http://trueaxis.com/tsua.html
Privacy Policy can be found at https://trueaxis.com/tsspp.html
Subscriptions will renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to players iTunes account settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.

bluejetty:00062654:ios.description:
Observe the International Space Station in the sky above you and find out where human-made satellites are right now with SATELLITE TRACKER by STAR WALK! 
MAIN FEATURES 
- Real-time satellite tracking
- The most outstanding satellites
- Satellite flyby timer & pass predictions
- Hand-picked passes & customizable location
- Fly-with-satellite view
- Satellite orbit over Earth
Enjoy the easy and comfortable real-time satellite tracking with SATELLITE TRACKER!
► Select a satellite from the list and see its current location in the sky in real-time or track satellite live orbiting Earth. You can track the most famous and brightest satellites, SpaceX’s Stalinks, communications and weather forecasting satellites, and much more!
► At the top of the main screen, the flyby timer counts the amount of time left until the next flyby of the selected satellite over your location. Tap the down arrow to open the list of passes that will be visible from your location in the nearest future.
► Get precise predictions when satellites are visible in the sky above your location. The list of passes allows you to set any alert (one or more) for the satellite's pass that you’d like to witness.
Switch between the app’s modes (Globe view, Satellite View, and Sky view) by tapping the round icons at the bottom of the screen.
-> Choose Satellite View to enjoy the 3D image of a satellite flying over Earth with the real speed and location. 
-> Globe view allows you to see a satellite’s trajectory around the Earth's 3D model and on the Earth’s map.
-> Find the satellites in the sky by following the arrow pointer with the Sky View mode.
The app contains ads. The ISS is available by default.
With SATELLITES LIVE subscription, you get an instant ad-free access to tracking satellites live orbiting over Earth and in the sky, the timer for the next appearance, and alerts about the nearest flybys.
SATELLITES LIVE is a renewable subscription with a 1-week FREE trial that gives you access to content from within the app on an ongoing basis. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account. At the end of each subscription duration (1 month), the subscription will automatically renew until you choose to cancel it, and your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours before the end of the current period. Users can manage their subscriptions in their account settings on the App Store.

## gomoney: Pay. Split. Track. Schedule
Welcome to gomoney, your one stop app for financial solutions beyond regular banking. 
gomoney was created with the purpose ofto addressing all the challenges you face with regular banking in Nigeria, making the banking process seamless and simplified. 
We have built the bank you deserve, designed to meet all your banking needs with no extra charges. You get to explore unique features such as enriched transactions, split bills, scheduled payments and transfers, payment links, stash and more. Let gomoney manage your finances for you while you focus on other things.
Open a gomoney account in less than 3 minutes and join ****thousands of Nigerians enjoying easy, convenient and secure banking with zero hidden fees.
**Why you should use gomoney;**
- Open an account for free within minutes.
- Enjoy swift transfers in less than a minute.
- Keep track of your money with real-time alerts on all your account activities
- Understand your financial habits with categorised and personalised spending reports.
- Split group payments and shared bills
- Schedule one-off or recurring gym, electricity, data, or any payments you've committed to
- Save and withdraw for free. No extra charges
- Request a gomoney card online and get it delivered to your doorstep.
- Buy airtime and data seamlessly.
- Live in-app customer support : Chat with actual humans
**You also get:**
- 24/7 safety for your money
- Downloadable receipts and detailed spending reports
- Stamped account statements
- Virtual and physical debit cards that work
- Personalised security options (tell us exactly what to look out for)
- Tech to help manage all your future payments stress-free
- Secured savings and more!
**Ready to experience better banking?**
As long as you're 18+, you can open an account with us anytime! All you need is your phone and number. Download the gomoney app and begin a journey of financial ease!
Gomoney is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) and all deposits are insured by the Nigerian Deposit Insurance Corporation (NDIC).
**Need more info?**
Visit our website- [https://gomoney.global/](https://gomoney.global/home/), check out our FAQs- https://gomoney.global/faqs/ or shoot us an email: gomoneysupport@gomoney.global

Screen Recorder - Capture It is a reliable, and easy-to-use stream creator and screen recorder. With Screen Recorder App , you can livestream your screen to YouTube, Facebook and Twitch and record screen videos. Screen Recorder Appr makes it easy to livestream and record content from your screen, like games, live shows, sports, and more.
Free Screen Recorder in FULL HD
* Screen Recorder App supports recording game screen in the highest quality, 1080p, 12Mbps, 60FPS. Of course, you can record screen with adjustable resolution(240p to 1080p), quality, and FPS(15FPS to 60FPS).
Game Recorder with no Time Limit
* This Screen Recorder App is also a convenient game recorder and screen capture tool. It helps you capture screen, record screen and record gameplay video without recording time limit.
Screen Video Recorder with no Watermark
* Still find a screen capture tool without watermark? Download this video recorder to capture screen in a cleaner way. If you want to capture screen, record screen or take a screenshot efficiently, it is a must-have screen recorder.
Screen Recorder with Sound
* Want to record gameplay, video tutorial with sound? This powerful screen recorder with sound is your best choice. It will record your voice fluidly and clearly.
Screen Recorder with Facecam
* Screen Recorder with Facecam helps you record your face and reaction in a small overlay window. It can be dragged freely to any position on the screen and customized to any size.
Screen Recorder with Audio
* It is also a well functional screen recorder with audio, screen recorder with sound. Download this fantastic screen recorder with audio to record your own video now.
RECORD
• One tap to start recording your entire screen (requires iOS 12)
• For iOS 11, we provide easy to follow video tutorials to get you setup fast
• Record everything: games, video tutorials, apps
VIDEO FACE CAM REACTIONS
• Add FaceCam Reactions to your recordings
• Add reactions to your favourite YouTube videos!
• Personalize your reaction by setting the reaction shape, position and size
• Camera Roll videos are supported
AUDIO COMMENTARY
• Record audio only commentary for your videos
VIDEO EDITOR
• Trim your video
• Video filters
• Adjustable playback speed
• Change canvas and background color
• Rotate
ORGANIZER
• Organise your recordings in one simple application with easy access
SHARE
• Save directly to camera roll
• Share and export your recordings to other apps, via email or AirDrop. You can also export your recording to your computer via WiFi or any other app for more specialized video editing.

You can add video reaction to your recordings so your audience can watch you while you play your favourite game, or when simply recording an app demonstration (Perfect to show your friends how to complete a task, or how to achieve that perfect score in a game).
The combinations are endless, just download and try for yourself.

This app specializes in training sound games with video.
You can do the things you need to do to improve your score: memorize the chart, memorize the rhythm, and think about how to move your fingers.
For example, to practice, you can do the following

- Play full combo videos that others have uploaded to YouTube and learn the rhythm by touching the judging line.

bluejetty:00022832:ios.name: Thermo Watch for Nest & Ecobee
bluejetty:00022832:ios.summary:
Apple Watch, Nest Thermostat, and Siri. Together at last.
＊ The app has Siri Voice shortcuts for seamless Siri control of your Nest, from the iPhone, Watch, iPad, and HomePod. It fully supports Apple Watch 5G/LTE, and can work when the iPh
bluejetty:00022832:ios.description:
Apple Watch, Nest Thermostat, and Siri. Together at last.
＊ The app has Siri Voice shortcuts for seamless Siri control of your Nest, from the iPhone, Watch, iPad, and HomePod. It fully supports Apple Watch 5G/LTE, and can work when the iPhone is not around - as long as the watch itself has internet access (either 5G/LTE or WiFi).
＊ The app lets you monitor and control HomeKit thermostats like Ecobee, and functions largely the same with them as it does with Nest, except for the Siri Shortcuts functionality which is not needed with HomeKit. It lets you see your thermostat info on the Watch complications, and control it using the iOS widget.
_____________
• Using Siri voice shortcuts you can control many aspects of your Nest, such as instant activation of heating or cooling, setting the temperature by saying how many degrees you want to set, increasing/decreasing the temperature, and setting the Home/Away state. Thanks to Thermo Watch, It's all finally just one casual "Hey Siri" away, all with informative visual and verbal feedback.
• From the watch face, tap on the Thermo Watch complication to open the app. Spin the Digital Crown, or Swipe up/down to adjust the temperature. You can start adjusting the moment the app opens.
• On your iOS device you can see the thermostat info on the home screen widget. You can start/stop heating or cooling directly from the middle and large size widgets, or you can just open the app. Again, you can start adjusting the moment the controls appear.
• From your Apple TV, open the app, and swipe up/down on the remote to change the temperate.
The app is fully functional with the initial purchase. In-app purchases are available only for tipping the developer.
The app will let you know with a chime and a tap, that the thermostat has received and applied your command.
Monitor your Thermostats and Home/Away status right from the watch face, using complications that update in the background, without having to launch the app.
You can use Siri on your iPhone, Watch, iPad, or HomePod to control any of your thermostats. Record phrases that make most sense to you, such as "Start Heating" or "Make it Cooler". If you have multiple thermostats you can control them individually, by saying for example "Start Heating Upstairs" or "Start Cooling the Living Room".
Visit https://thermowatch.net/siri website for the detailed instructions of Siri operation.
Set Geofence around your home to reliably set the Home and Away state when you come and go.
The app supports multiple thermostats in multiple homes - just swipe left and right on your Watch screen to access them, or see them all at the same time in the iOS Widget and the app. Fahrenheit and Celsius are both supported.
Beyond that, you can press and hold the Watch screen for additional functions, like switching to a heating or cooling mode, setting the away status, seeing the temperature sensors, or turning the fan on and off.
While the app's minimalist looks betray the simplicity of its operation, what they don't show is the amount of planning, design, development and refinement that went into it, ensuring it becomes something that is enjoyable to use and experience.
Thermo Watch does not collect any of your data. Your login information, thermostat settings, and any activity - all of it flows exclusively between your devices and Nest. Author of Thermo Watch does not receive any of it, at any point.
This app and its developer are unaffiliated with Google Inc. or Google Nest. Nest is a trademark of Google Inc.

bluejetty:00036873:ios.summary:
Calling all card collectors, organizing your PSA-graded collection is now easier than ever. The free PSA Set Registry companion app lets you upload card images and compete for the best sets from your iPhone or iPad.
From vintage to modern
bluejetty:00036873:ios.description:
Calling all card collectors, organizing your PSA-graded collection is now easier than ever. The free PSA Set Registry companion app lets you upload card images and compete for the best sets from your iPhone or iPad.
From vintage to modern trading cards, the PSA Set Registry companion app offers an extensive list of sets to choose from, allowing you to quickly add your baseball cards, football cards, hockey cards, non-sports cards, tickets and unopened packs to the app.
Stay organized and edit your collection’s information by uploading images, adding your purchase dates, purchase prices, current trading card values, comments, notes and more. 
Did you sell a card from your collection? No problem! Simply change its status from “active” to “sold” and add the buyer’s name, sale date and sold price! Stay organized as you buy and sell your PSA-graded cards.
Improve your trading card, ticket and unopened pack collecting experience with an extensive features list:
· Add cards, tickets and packs to your collection with the Quick Add feature by scanning the cert verification code with your iPhone or iPad.
· Scan a PSA-graded collectible’s barcode to determine if it will upgrade your set using the “What If?” function
· Manage your collection & review set rankings and completion percentages
· Compare your sets with other users within the PSA Set Registry
App requires internet connection to use.
For more information on this and other PSA apps, visit http://www.psacard.com/apps.

bluejetty:00060789:ios.description:
eVoice provides a simple, reliable virtual phone system that brings your entire business communication together in one app. Equip your team with multiple local or toll-free phone numbers and create multiple extensions, all managed from any smartphone or tablet.
Are you an entrepreneur, freelancer, or consultant seeking to professionalize your communications and streamline your business operations? The eVoice app transforms your existing device into a powerful mobile business line, allowing you to manage client interactions, stay connected with colleagues, and scale your business with ease.
With eVoice, you can start making and receiving calls from your new business number in minutes, with no complicated setup or additional hardware required. It’s a reliable communications solution that runs seamlessly on your existing devices, so your business is always with you, wherever you are.
EVOICE FEATURES:
Connecting Your Business to Every Opportunity
- Your Business, In Your Pocket: Put complete control of your business communications at your fingertips. Our plans let you harness multiple numbers and extensions for your whole team, who can access the app anytime, anywhere.
- Customizable Caller Settings: Take your business on the go with flexible call settings that can reroute your calls directly to the app anytime, anywhere.
- Organized Voicemail Management: Get all business voicemails sent directly to the app with full text transcription. You can quickly scan messages on the go while keeping your work and personal communications distinct.
- Call Handle with Ease: Instantly decide where calls go: send them to voicemail, forward them to any external number, or select your custom schedules that automatically route calls based on your business hours.
Local, Vanity and Toll-Free Phone Numbers
- Create localized, vanity, and toll-free phone numbers that fit your business.
- Export your existing phone number for a smooth transition
- Set up any new numbers to scale your business with ease.
No Cellular Data Needed
- VoIP technology lets you make and receive calls and texts no matter where you are.
- Say goodbye to cellular data expenses with eVoice’s WiFi calls
- Seamlessly send and receive text messages using your eVoice business number with the Elite Plus plan.
Boost Productivity
- Access Phone Contacts: Easily call and text your existing phone contacts directly from within the eVoice app.
- One Address Book for Your Whole Team: Import and share contacts across all users and extensions to give your team seamless visibility and a single source of truth.
- Track the Full Journey of Every Call: Review call logs to see at a glance whether a call was answered by a specific user, forwarded to an external number, or sent to voicemail, so you always know the outcome.
All plans have a 30-day Money Back Guarantee if you are not satisfied with our services. 
Elite
Monthly: $14
Yearly: $144
Elite Plus
Monthly: $21
Yearly: $228
Please note that some features may require additional services.
NEED SUPPORT?
We’re here to help at https://evoice.zendesk.com/ or tap Settings -> Help Center from within the app.
Your cellular provider may prohibit or restrict VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol) on their network. It’s your responsibility to check with your cellular provider about their VoIP functionality, and any additional charges it may incur. eVoice is not responsible for any additional cellular charges that may occur as a result of using the eVoice service. 
The eVoice app cannot be used for emergency calls (911).
Users who send SMS/MMS to U.S. numbers must complete a registration process after purchase, as required by U.S. mobile carriers. Business messages sent from unregistered numbers may be subject to non-delivery by mobile carriers. eVoice does not provide refunds or credits due to issues with messaging from unregistered numbers. Please visit https://try.evoice.com/10dlc-faq/.
Privacy Policy: https://www.evoice.com/privacy/

An idol making simulation game, Idol Queens!
Produce your own idols in the way the real k-pop idols are produced!
● The most realistic idol making game
Train your idols just like the real k-pop entertainment agencies do!
Be a producer, recruit and train trainees, and manage the agency as a business executive!
Expand your company internationally with your management strategy and produce a million-selling artist!

The idols you produce will appear on the stage in 3D!

Put cute dresses on your idols, dye their hair, and mix and match accessories!
Each part can be freely changed! Make your idol a fashionista!
● Decorate the dormitory for your idols
Make a room where your idols can stay cozy.
The furniture items affect the idols. They help the idols release their stress and relax their minds.
Also, you can have your friends over in the dormitory.

Enjoy the real-time network pvp with other users!
Your rank is determined based on the regional score.
Various rewards are distributed based on the rank!
● So many events to enjoy!
Other than training, there are many things need to be done for your successful idol producing and agency management.
Make an album, create a streaming channel for gaming/restaurant reviews/cooking, manage the merchandise store (pop up shop), do the promotion test and fandom quest to complete the missions
and raise the affinity of the idols while gaining the stockholder's trust!

bluejetty:00121574:ios.description:
Every night is a different show. Now you can watch all of them.
LivePhish is the official streaming home of Phish and the only place to watch every concert live, replay sets on demand, and access the complete official archive. For more than two decades, LivePhish has been the direct connection between the band and the fans who follow every note.
LivePhish With is the new, complete Phish experience:
Now, every Phish concert is streamed live in 4K (where available), every night of the tour. On-demand replay access will be available (availability windows may vary), so you can go back to that second-set jam the morning after. Plus:
-The complete official lossless audio archive: every show since 2002.
-Exclusive releases from the Phish Archives. 
-Select archival concert video, with more on the way.
Every Phish livestream is exclusive to LivePhish With members. One subscription covers every show and no more buying individual streams.
LivePhish keeps you connected through the full audio archive and exclusive Phish Archives releases.
LivePhish With
 $149.99/year · $24.99/month
Annual rate locked for the first year of membership. Renews automatically at the then-current member rate unless canceled. 
LivePhish
 $99.99/year · $9.99/month
LivePhish Subscription Payment and Auto-Renewal Terms
LivePhish offers auto-renewing monthly and annual subscriptions to stream music from the LivePhish catalog.
Two subscription types are available, each with two tiers: monthly (30 days) and annual (365 days). All subscriptions auto-renew.
A LivePhish monthly subscription is $9.99 per month and the yearly subscription is $99.99 per year. A LivePhish With monthly subscription is $24.99 per month and the yearly subscription is $149.99 per year.
Payment will be charged to the iTunes Account at the end of your trial period if applicable, otherwise at the time of your purchase.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Accounts will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. 
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the users Account Settings after purchase.
LivePhish Terms of Use - https://www.livephish.com/terms.aspx
LivePhish Privacy Policy - https://www.livephish.com/privacy.aspx

apple-macos:1514427173.description:
Bibino is the ultimate baby monitoring app for modern moms, dads, and caregivers, transforming two devices - smartphones, tablets, or computers - into a comprehensive baby monitoring system. Keep a watchful eye on your baby with video and audio capabilities, and ensure their comfort by soothing them with your voice or calming lullabies. With the flexibility of WiFi and mobile data, Bibino offers you unlimited reach, wherever you may be.
Key Features of Bibino Baby Monitor App
● Seamless Device Integration: Transform two devices into a unified baby nanny cam
● Audio-Visual Monitoring: Watch and listen to your baby's every sound and movement
● Motion Detection: Assess your baby's state of calmness
● Unlimited Reach: Monitor your baby with WiFi and cellular data
● Remote Comfort: Soothe your baby from afar with your voice
● Customizable Sensitivity: Adjust the microphone sensitivity on the baby's device to your preference
● Real-Time Notifications: Stay informed about your baby's status
● Multi-Parent Connection: Link multiple parent devices to one Baby Station
● Enhanced Visibility: Utilize the Night Light feature for better monitoring in low light conditions
● Review Past Monitorings: Access and replay previously recorded sounds and videos
To unlock some of these features, you may need to purchase Bibino Premium, which offers a free trial.
WHAT MAKES BIBINO THE #1 BABY MONITOR?
Hear & watch over your baby
With video and audio monitoring, you can hear your baby remotely and see everything that's been going on in the baby's room. With Bibino, you always have your baby under surveillance.
Video recording
Capture and keep precious moments of your baby during monitoring. Take photos and record short videos of your baby when monitoring to keep all memories.
Unlimited reach with WiFi and mobile data
With Bibino nanny cam, you are not limited by the distance. The app works over WiFi and mobile data, which makes Bibino perfect when traveling with the baby, as each device can be connected to a different network.
Simple to set up
All you need are two devices - phones, tablets, or computers, and Bibino app. Place one device in the baby's room to monitor your little one and keep the second device with you.
Traveling with the baby
Bibino is a must-have for any parents when traveling with their babies. With Bibino, you don't need to carry extra hardware devices to monitor your baby. Bibino baby monitor is always one tap away, and with WiFi and mobile data, the app works where other baby monitors fail.
Enhance audio with Every Noise
When you're not sure what the sound you just heard was, Bibino can temporarily sensitize the audio so you can hear everything clearly.
Soothe your baby remotely
When your baby starts to wake up, you can soothe your little one back to sleep remotely with Bibino app through two-way video and audio.
Play your little one a lullaby
Choose from a variety of lullabies and soothing sounds (white noise, household sounds, and more) to lull your baby to sleep. Project a soothing image on the baby's device and control the volume and time of the lullabies remotely.
History from past monitorings
Bibino records noises, videos, or photos from each monitoring. You can also replay recorded sounds from the monitoring.
Connect multiple parents' devices
With Bibino, you can monitor one Baby Station from multiple Parent Stations. This way, both parents can watch over their baby at the same time.
Upcycle your older phone or tablet
Do you have an older device lying around? Reuse your older phone or tablet as the Baby Station and give it a new meaning. No need to purchase expensive hardware baby monitors when you can recycle and reuse devices you already have. By upcycling your older devices, you have a reliable baby monitor at your fingertips.

apple-macos:6824733348.name: Stop the Monkey: Food Cravings
apple-macos:6824733348.description:
Stop the Monkey keeps you company in the moment a food craving hits. Open it, tap one button and take a short pause: a 3-minute game, guided breathing and a simple way to see the craving for what it is, a thought.
Price and free trial
Try it free for 3 days, once per Apple Account. Then 4.99 USD a month or 34.99 USD a year (the App Store shows the price in your currency). Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends, and the subscription renews automatically each month or year until you cancel. To avoid being charged, cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.
Why a game
Cravings often come with vivid mental images of the food. Several studies, most of them small and in a lab, suggest that keeping your attention and visual memory busy with another task can lower a craving's strength for a while. In one of them, at the University of Plymouth (2015), 31 university students reported their cravings several times a day for a week. The 15 who played a falling-blocks puzzle game for 3 minutes after each report felt their cravings 13.9 points weaker on average, on a scale of 0 to 100. The study covered cravings of all kinds, not only food, and it measured how strong the craving felt, not what people ate or their weight. Stop the Monkey is inspired by these ideas. Its own games have not been tested in a study.
How a pause works
1. Tap the big button when a craving shows up.
2. Play for 3 minutes. There are seven simple games: Colors, Pictures, Pairs, Maze, Jumps, Slide and Silhouettes. Choose one or let the app pick.
3. Breathe with a gentle guided rhythm, slower or faster, or just observe your breath without a rhythm.
4. Check in: how is the craving now? If it is still there, the app shows your plan first, then other ideas to fill the moment.
5. Note what set it off: stress, boredom, tiredness, hunger, seeing or smelling food, or something else.
6. Look at the thought: say to yourself, out loud or quietly, "I'm having the thought that I want to eat."
What's inside
- Seven simple 3-minute games
- Guided breathing at the pace you choose, or just observe your breath
- My plan: one action you choose ahead of time for when a craving stays
- My craving log: note your cravings in your own words and see them week by week. It is for getting to know yourself, not for judging yourself.
- Reminders at the times you choose
- What science says: the studies behind each step, with links to the originals
- Original music composed for this app
- English, Spanish and Portuguese
Private by design
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your log, plan and settings stay only on your phone.
What the studies do and do not show
The last step comes from acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT). In a small study with 137 people trying to eat less chocolate, those who used this kind of technique for 5 days ate less chocolate from a bag they carried than those who used relaxation. It was only about chocolate, and it has not been tested with this app.
The breathing is a pause to calm down. The one study we found on slow breathing and food craving (65 students) saw no difference in craving, so we do not claim that it reduces cravings.
Important
Stop the Monkey is not a treatment and does not replace a professional. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition or eating disorder. If food or eating is hard for you, or you often feel out of control with food, please talk to a healthcare professional.
Terms of Use: https://www.stopthemonkeyapp.com/en/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.stopthemonkeyapp.com/en/privacy.html
